scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We are looking for adventurers who are super curious and extremely brave.
Join us for a wonderful adventure!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我们正在寻找好奇心旺盛且极其勇敢的冒险者。
加入我们，一起踏上精彩的冒险之旅吧！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a knowledgeable person, right? Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嘿，你看起来是个见多识广的人，对吧？对我的故事感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You're a real adventurer.
Good for you!
You won't regret it.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你真是个真正的冒险者。
真不错！
你不会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I usually send adventurers to
newly found places for research.
It's quite challeging, as nobody's ever been to these places.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我通常派遣冒险者去新发现的地方进行考察。
这相当具有挑战性，因为从来没有人去过这些地方。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The missions are quite dangerous,
so only those who are courageous
are qualified for the challenge
of this mission.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
任务相当危险，
所以只有那些勇敢的人
才有资格接受
这项任务的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I'm not sure that you're strong enough, but you seem brave. How about going to the kingdom receptionist? He should be in the first room of Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我不确定你是否足够强大，但你看起来很勇敢。不如去见见王宫的接待员吧？他应该在普隆德拉王宫的第一间房间里。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
From what I've heard about this place... It's not a new continent.
I don't know where it is.
Hmm... Inside of the sky?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
据我所知这个地方...它不是新的大陆。
我不知道它在哪里。
嗯...是在天空之中吗？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Could just be a rumor,
but I don't know exactly.
It's not my business.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
可能只是谣言，
我也不太清楚。
这不是我该管的事。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway, I'm supposed to inform many adventurers about it.
There's no time to waste!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
总之，我本该通知许多冒险者这件事。
没时间浪费了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Huh, I thought you were a real adventurer. You're missing a big opportunity. You're definitely not brave. Absolutely not!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
哈，我还以为你是个真正的冒险者呢。你错过了一个大好机会。你绝对不够勇敢。完全不够！

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
If we'd had the initiative over Schwarzwald, we could take advantage over them! But we lost the opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
如果我们能在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德占据先机，就能对他们形成优势！但我们失去了这个机会。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Though we are allied with them, that's nothing more than a formality.
We will take advantage over them.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
虽然我们与他们是盟友，但这不过是形式上的。
我们将利用这一点来占上风。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Do you know what we are here for? These are the things that help to have control over multiple countries and get to know their magic.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
你知道我们在这里的目的吗？这些东西有助于控制多个国家并了解它们的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Whatever. Though the things are not useful to us, we'd better destroy them, to prevent them from being used by others.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
算了。虽然这些东西对我们没什么用，但我们最好还是销毁它们，以防被他人利用。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Anything except things which are not found on Rune-Midgarts... keep them hidden. Just let us know of whatever you are holding.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
除了那些在卢恩·米德加兹找不到的东西...请把它们藏好。只要让我们知道你手里有什么就行。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
...Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
...你有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Hm... The boss had you come to me,
to talk about the issues? Ok!
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
嗯...老板让你来找我，
谈谈那些问题？好吧！

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
So, everything is going well?
You're allied with Schwarzwald?
They will join with you.
I know this.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
那么，一切进展顺利吗？
你和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德结盟了？
他们会加入你们。
我知道这一点。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Hm....ok.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
嗯...好吧。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
You are all going, forward through
the dimensional rift...
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
你们都要一起出发，
穿过次元裂缝...

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Good. It's started.
We also need to be preparted to not
let ourselves be convinced to turn over.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
很好，已经开始了。
我们也需要做好准备，
绝不能被说服而倒戈。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
We are so-called 'allies',
so we can't take advantages over
each other in public, but we can do
it secretly.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
我们所谓的“盟友”，
在公开场合不能互相占便宜，
但私下里可以。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
The Schwarzwald... they are all
snobs. I know what they did.
They'll try to get what they can
with little or no work. I know
their dirty tricks.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德...他们全是势利眼。
我知道他们干了什么。
他们总想不劳而获，坐享其成。
我了解他们那些下三滥的手段。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
We shouldn't loose anything to them,
no way! We are not as powerful as
most of them.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
我们绝不能在他们面前示弱，
绝对不行！我们的实力不如他们中的大多数。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
We only have a strange dimensional
rift in our reserves, but nothing
else... Only we are about to trick
them, to win over them!
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
我们储备中只有一个奇怪的次元裂缝，
除此之外别无他物...但我们即将欺骗他们，
从而战胜他们！

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
You are a member of our alliance.
Always be careful not to get lost.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
你是我们联盟的成员。
务必小心，不要迷路。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Thanks for reporting to us.
We are better prepared.
Good job. You can go now.
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
谢谢你的汇报。
我们准备得更充分了。
干得好，你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Alliance Manager]
Do you have any business here?
scripts.translation:
[联盟管理员]
你在这里有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
If we have absolute power, we wouldn't have to get along with Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
如果我们拥有绝对的力量，
就不必和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德以及阿鲁纳菲兹和睦相处了。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I don't know when Satan Morocc will attack us, and whether we're powerful enough to detect him.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我不知道魔王梦罗克什么时候会袭击我们，
也不知道我们是否有足够的力量去猎鹰寻敌。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
We couldn't avoid cooperating with them. We don't have many choices left.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我们无法避免与他们合作。
我们已没有多少选择了。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
So we will take advantage over them in secret, in this dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
所以我们将在这个次元裂缝中，
在私下里占他们的便宜。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
If we'd have had more power,
we wouldn't be like this now.
Strength is most important.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
如果我们拥有更多的力量，
现在就不会这样了。
力量是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Why have you come again?
You'd better go to Schwarzwald to register.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你怎么又来了？
你最好去修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德登记。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
What? You came to here to convey a story? Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
什么？你来这里是想传达什么消息？说吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Move to the side. There's a Manager who is dealing with all of us, and is involved in international relations here on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
请让一下。这里有一位管理员负责处理我们所有人的事务，
并参与米德加尔特的外交关系。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
直接和他谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go there.
You can get nothing from me.
Let's rush to
^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000, which is the original place for the three kingdoms...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
直接去吧。
从我这里你什么也得不到。
让我们赶紧去^FF0000里希塔乐镇^000000，
那是三王国的发源地...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I've heard of you.
You've finished the tests from the Promotional Staff?
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
我听说过你。
你已经通过了宣传人员的测试？

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
You are definitely brave enough to venture to this new land.
I will now appoint you to detect and have adventures in Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你绝对有勇气探索这片新土地。
我现在任命你去阿什-真空地带进行猎鹰寻敌和冒险。

scripts.text: Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation: 阿什-真空地带？

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Hm. That's the code name of the place where you will have your adventure. Frankly, we don't know exactly what it is, but we call it 'Ash-Vacuum'.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
嗯。那是你即将开始冒险的地方的代号。老实说，我们也不确切知道那是什么，但我们称它为“阿什-真空地带”。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Believe it or not,
it's definitely true.
So listen carefully.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
信不信由你，
但这绝对是事实。
所以请仔细听。
拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Ash-Vacuum... is a living place... that's totally different from where we are living now.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
阿什-真空地带...是一个活着的地方...与我们现在生活的地方完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
It's an unknown place.
We don't know what's there,
or who is living there.
It's beyond our guess.
Nobody knows.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
那是一个未知的地方。
我们不知道那里有什么，
也不知道那里住着谁。
这超出了我们的猜测。
没有人知道。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Only the brave, like you, deserve to go there. There will be many dangerous things around you, but you must explore it on behalf of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
只有像你这样勇敢的人，才配去那里。那里会有许多危险的东西围绕着你，但你必须代表米德加尔特去探索它。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Hmm......

[Recruiter]
Anyway, I am sure that there are many opportunities for fame and fortune there...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
总之，我确信那里有很多获得名声和财富的机会...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
First, you should go to ^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000 to register for the United Midgard Alliance. I believe they are meeting at the Rekenber Corporation Headquarters...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
首先，你应该去^FF0000里希塔乐镇^000000注册加入米德加尔特联盟。我相信他们正在雷根贝勒总部开会...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
You can get a detailed guide, better than me, there. Go there and find him...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
在那里你可以得到比我更详细的指南。去那里找到他...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I've done what I can. Go there, and get to it!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
我已经尽力了。去吧，开始行动！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Remember, go to ^FF0000Lighthalzen^000000, then follow the directions of the guide there.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
记住，去^FF0000里希塔乐镇^000000，然后听从那里向导的指示。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go there!
And listen carefully
about your mission!
I'm done here...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
就只是去那里！
仔细听
关于你的任务！
我说完了...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
What're you doing here?
Just go to ^FF0000Aldebaran^000000, and find the ^FF0000Promotional Staff^000000. As I advised you, you'd better save time.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你在这里做什么？
直接去^FF0000亚尔达班^000000，找到^FF0000宣传人员^000000。正如我建议你那样，你最好节省时间。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Brave ones! Come to me!
Real brave people!
Would you mind trying a challenging mission?
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
勇敢的人！来找我！
真正的勇敢者！
你们愿意尝试一个具有挑战性的任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I am a recruiter looking for brave people in Prontera! My goal is to recruit the bravest adventurers for this mission.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
我是普隆德拉的一名招募员，正在寻找勇敢的人！我的目标是为这个任务招募最勇敢的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Would you like to join?
This is always open to you.
I know, you're super curious.
Just try whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你想加入吗？
这对你来说总是开放的。
我知道，你非常好奇。
随便尝试你想做的任何事。

scripts.text: Yes, I am interested.
scripts.translation: 是的，我感兴趣。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Oh! Yes! You're quite curious!
You're a real adventurer.
A genuine desire for adventure.
Ok! Let me start by telling you the story of the mission!!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
哦！是的！你非常好奇！
你是一名真正的冒险者。
对冒险有着真正的渴望。
好吧！让我先给你讲讲这个任务的故事！！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
All of this of course, the Promotional Staff can tell you, but they're not that reliable. So, let me explain to you. Just listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
当然，宣传人员也可以告诉你这些，但他们不太可靠。所以，让我来向你解释。请仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Um... There's not that much to tell you...
...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
嗯...其实也没什么好说的...
...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
The point is that we want someone who is curious and brave, to go to new places. And I choose you!!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
总之，我们需要一个充满好奇心且勇敢的人，去探索新的地方。我选中你了！！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
This is a special place among unknown places. Quite special! I can't tell you much just now. Just believe me that it is truly uncommon!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
这是未知之地中一个特别的地方。非常特别！我现在不能告诉你太多。请相信我，那里真的不寻常！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
So, now, let me test you.
Once I get you qualified,
I will tell you everything.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
那么，现在，让我测试一下你。
一旦你通过了资格考核，
我会告诉你一切。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go to the ^FF0000Promotional Staff^000000 in Aldebaran and get permission. They can judge you more carefully than me. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
直接去艾尔戴巴找^FF0000宣传人员^000000申请许可吧。他们能比我更仔细地评估你。去吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
They will take care of everything, if you say that you've been sent by the Recruiter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
如果你告诉他们你是普隆德拉的招募员派来的，他们会处理一切。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Time is zeny, just go.
As soon as you visit the Promotional Staff, you will be allowed to travel to the unknown land.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
时间就是Zeny，快去吧。
只要你拜访了宣传人员，就可以前往那片未知的土地了。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Are you seriously enjoying your adventures? You're not that curious.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你真的很享受冒险吗？你看起来并不怎么好奇。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Just go about your business!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
快去忙你的事吧！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
-Muttering and complaining...-
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
-低声抱怨着...-

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Did you try out for the test, or are you already enjoying your adventures?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你是来参加考试，还是已经在享受冒险了？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Just visit the ^FF0000Promotional Staff in Geffen^000000. You have no business with me anymore. Bless you. I wish you a safe adventure.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
直接去吉芬找^FF0000宣传人员^000000吧。你和我已经没有关系了。祝福你。祝你冒险旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Don't forget to bring... ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000.
Got it? ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000!
Let me know once you got them.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
别忘了带上... ^FF0000300个杰勒比结晶^000000。
记住了吗？^FF0000300个杰勒比结晶^000000！
拿到后告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey! Let me know once you collect all of them.
Don't disturb me anymore. I'm a busy man... What a waste.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嘿！收集齐了告诉我一声。
别再打扰我了。我很忙...真是浪费。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hm? Did you bring all of them?
No! It's quite an annoying job
I'm impressed that you managed to do such a menial thing to bring 300 Jellopy!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嗯？你都带来了？
不！这可是个麻烦的差事。
你能完成收集300个杰勒比结晶这种琐事，我很惊讶！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You have guts kid!
You're a good-willed person!
Ok, you win!
You pass!!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
真有胆量，小孩！
你是个心地善良的人！
好吧，你赢了！
你通过了！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Adventurers like you
are not common
A hard-boiled soldier!
Stronger than me!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
像你这样的冒险者
并不多见
是个硬汉士兵！
比我更强！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Now can you go to the
Promotional Staff in Geffen?
He will test you again.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
现在你能去
吉芬找宣传人员了吗？
他会再次测试你。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You know this isn't an easy quest.
You resolved to carry it out, didn't you?
Brace yourself for it.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你知道这可不是个简单的任务。
你下定决心要完成它，对吧？
做好心理准备。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway you did the first step.
Bless you!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
不管怎样，你迈出了第一步。
祝福你！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We want the adventurers who are super curious and extremely brave. Join us for a wonderful adventure!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我们需要好奇心极强且无比勇敢的冒险者。加入我们，开启精彩的冒险吧！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a well-versed person, right? Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嘿，你是个见多识广的人，对吧？对我的故事感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: I have something for you.
scripts.translation: 我有东西给你

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
For me??
I hate annoying stuff.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
给我？？
我最讨厌这种麻烦事了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ahh... I sensed that I would get your request.
The recruiter sent you here to get tested?
Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
啊...我就知道会有人来找我。
是招募员派你来接受测试的吗？
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ah! They always push me,
to suffer from so much work
I live a hard life!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
啊！他们总是给我施压，
让我承受这么多工作，
我活得真辛苦！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
My job is testing if you are strong and brave enough for this adventure.
What a bother!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我的工作就是测试你是否足够强壮和勇敢，以胜任这次冒险。
真是烦死了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I will accept you if you bring me ^FF0000300 Jellopy^000000.
I believe that you can bring them to me.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
如果你能给我带^FF0000300个杰勒比结晶^000000，我就接受你。
我相信你能把它们带给我。
准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Just go ahead and hunt monsters, or whatever and collect 300 jellopies.
Then we can go forward.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
去猎杀魔物，或者做点别的，收集300个杰勒比结晶。
然后我们才能继续。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Did you take the test?
Or are you already enjoying your adventure?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你接受测试了吗？
还是说你已经开始享受你的冒险了？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You didn't visit ^FF0000Izlude^000000, did you?
Or do you have any business in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你还没去过^FF0000依斯鲁得岛^000000，对吧？
或者你在吉芬有什么事要办？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
^FF00001 Ruby!!^000000.
Don't you forget it!
Hurry up! Time is zeny!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
^FF00001颗红宝石！！^000000
别忘了这个！
快点！时间就是Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Wow, you brought a genuine Jewel.
You are absolutely qualified.
I can tell these things.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
哇，你带来了一颗真正的宝石。
你绝对合格。
我看得出来。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Am I exaggerating?
It's true that you're
considerably strong.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我是不是夸张了？
但你确实
相当强大。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ok! My job is done.
Good job!!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
好！我的任务完成了。
干得好！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Next step is Izlude!
You can get tested by the Promotional Staff there.
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
下一步是依斯鲁得岛！
你可以去那里找宣传人员接受测试。
快点！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The unknown place...
It is a very dangerous place so you must go through these tests before we can send you....
We're pretty picky.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
那个未知的地方...
那里非常危险，所以在你出发前必须通过这些测试....
我们很挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I hope you can do it!
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
希望你能做到！
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The one you should bring me is
^FF0000Emerald^000000. Can you get it?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你需要给我带的是
^FF0000绿宝石^000000。你能拿到吗？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You brought it so soon!
You're a real adventurer!
I will accept this Emerald as evidence.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你这么快就带来了！
你真是名符其实的冒险者！
我会收下这颗绿宝石作为证明。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
This isn't something I wanted to keep for myself.
You know that, right?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
这并不是我想自己留下的东西。
你知道的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Next bring me ^FF00001 Ruby^000000.
I can't judge you with only one jewel.
So I need one more stone.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
接下来给我带^FF00001颗红宝石^000000。
光凭一颗宝石我无法判断你。
所以我还需要一颗石头。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Please bring me a Ruby.
As I mentioned, this is the second request.
I will wait until you bring me a stone again.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
请给我带一颗红宝石。
正如我提到的，这是第二个要求。
我会等你再次带石头给我。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We are recruiting adventurers who are strong and curious. Try your life at something more challenging.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我们正在招募强大且充满好奇心的冒险者。去挑战更艰难的事物吧。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a knowledgeable person, right? Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嘿，你看起来是个见多识广的人，对吧？对我的故事感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: The Staff in Aldebaran sent me.
scripts.translation: 是艾尔戴巴的职员派我来的。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Oh he did?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
哦，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ok, I guess that it's time for the second part of your test.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
好吧，看来是时候进行你测试的第二部分了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I need you to gather some stones for me.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我需要你为我收集一些石头。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I will accept you if you bring ^FF00001 Emerald^000000.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
如果你能带^FF00001颗绿宝石^000000来，我就接受你。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Just bring me ^ff00001 Emerald^000000.
That isn't hard for you right?
Then we can go forward.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
只要给我带^ff00001颗绿宝石^000000就行。
这对你来说不难吧？
那样我们就能继续前进了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I bless you for your future! May it be full of happiness!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我祝福你的未来！愿它充满幸福！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
The test is done!
If you have any other business, go to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
测试结束了！
如果你还有其他事，请去宫殿。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You don't look that strong.
Nothing but skin and bones!
Not reliable.
You should level up more before
considering this adventure.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你看起来并不强壮。
瘦骨嶙峋！
不可靠。
你应该再提升等级，
再考虑这次冒险。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I don't need adventurers who are
body-builders... but at least
someone not so little!!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我不需要那些
肌肉发达的冒险者...但至少
不能这么瘦小！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Wow! You are considerably
stronger than before!
Let me see...
You look different!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
哇！你比之前
强多了！
让我看看...
你看起来不一样了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Ok, it's done!
You seemed a sore weak of a soul,
but now, you're quite stronger than
before. Great! You will do!!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
好吧，结束了！
你看起来像个虚弱的人，
但现在，你比之前强多了。很好！你会成功的！！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We have quite high expectations to meet.
Though the new place is dangerous,
no need to check thoroughly
anymore.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我们有相当高的期望标准。
虽然新地方很危险，
但不再需要彻底检查了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
It's not a hell-hole!
Ukk!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
那里不是地狱！
呜！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway, just go back to the
Recruiter. I will forward to him
that you passed all the steps. Good
job, friend!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
总之，回到招募员那里吧。我会告诉他
你通过了所有步骤。干得好，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Bless all of your heart,
for your great future!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
愿福佑你的心灵，
为了你光明的未来！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We are recruiting adventurers
who are quite strong and curious.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我们正在招募
强大且充满好奇心的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hey, you're a knowledgeable adventurer. Are you interested in my story?
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嘿，你是一位见多识广的冒险者。
你对我的故事感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: I have something for you.
scripts.translation: 我有东西给你

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Um, you're the one sent to be tested, correct? You are in the right place. I'm the Promotional Staff in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嗯，你就是被派来接受测试的人，对吧？
你找对地方了。我是依斯鲁得岛的宣传人员。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I guess you're qualified enough to go... I think no more testing is needed.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我想你的资格已经足够了...
我觉得不需要再进行更多测试了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
I think you're good enough!
No more testing!!
Ok! You pass!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我觉得你足够优秀了！
不需要再测试了！！
好的！你通过了！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
We have quite high expectations to meet.
Though the new place is dangerous,
no need to check thoroughly right now.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
我们有相当高的期望标准。
虽然新地方很危险，
但现在不需要彻底检查了。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
It's not a hell-hole!
Ukk...
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
那里不是地狱！
呜...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Anyway, just go back to the recruiter.
I will forward to him that you passed all the steps.
Good job, friend!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
总之，回到招募员那里吧。
我会告诉他你通过了所有步骤。
干得好，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
May Freya bless you,
for your great future!
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
愿弗蕾雅保佑你，
为了你光明的未来！

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
You don't look that strong.
Nothing but skin and bones!
Not reliable.
I can't let you pass.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
你看起来并不强壮。
瘦骨嶙峋的！
不可靠。
我不能让你通过。

scripts.text:
[Promotional Staff]
Please level up a little more. I
can't accept that you're strong
enough. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[宣传人员]
请再提升一点等级。
我无法接受你足够强大。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Welcome! You've arrived at Lighthalzen, which is the base of three kingdoms.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
欢迎！你已抵达里希塔乐镇，
这里是三个王国的基地。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You have to register your name. Go to the 2nd floor in Rekenbereu on the northwest side.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
你必须登记你的名字。
去西北侧的雷肯贝鲁二楼。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Be careful not to lose your way!
scripts.translation:
[向导]
小心不要迷路！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Welcome! You've arrived at Lighthalzen, which is the base of three kingdoms.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
欢迎！你已抵达里希塔乐镇，
这里是三个王国的基地。

scripts.text: -At this spot, it's possible to overhear something. Listen carefully through the wall...-
scripts.translation: -在这个位置，有可能听到一些动静。仔细透过墙壁听...-

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You're a good buddy!
But...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你是个好伙伴！
但是...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
We can't avoid this...
You know better than I!
We can't go through this,
in this current status.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我们无法避免...
你比我更清楚！
以我们目前的状态，
我们无法度过这一关。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I did all I could do...
Please...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我已经尽力了...
拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
......

[{0}]
There's no avoiding it.
Ok, I need to try.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
无法回避了。
好吧，我必须尝试一下。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You are ready to try this...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你准备好尝试了...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Oh! My friend...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
哦！我的朋友...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Nothing can be controlled anymore... Am I trying this...?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
一切已无法控制...我这是在尝试吗...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Peace for the three kingdoms...?
Isn't it impossible...?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
三个王国的和平...？
这难道不可能吗...？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Are you sure that
you can do that?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你确定你能做到吗？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Nothing shall prevent me from doing my duty. Nothing!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
没有什么能阻止我履行职责。什么都没有！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Sikaiz is a kind and upright person. But he can't be cautious about everything. It could cause serious problems.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
西凯兹是个善良正直的人。但他不可能事事谨慎。这可能会引发严重的问题。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
So that's why I am here for him. I always worry about him...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
所以我才在这里守护他。我总是为他忧心...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I don't know what I would do if something were to happen...
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我不知道如果发生什么意外，我会怎么做...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
......

[Sikaiz]
Please come to me ASAP.
I hope you play an active part.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
请尽快来找我。
我希望你能积极参与。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We all expect you to make the biggest impact.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我们都期待你能发挥最大的作用。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Only thing you should do is write down your name and show me your great face
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你只需要写下你的名字，并让我看看你那张伟大的脸

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I already accept you. Just write down your name here. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我已经接受你了。就在这里写下你的名字吧。请。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Don't you know your own name?
Write it again.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你不知道自己的名字吗？
再写一遍。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ok. I got your name, {0}. Great name! Registration is done!
You've become a member of the three kingdoms!
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
好的。我记下你的名字了，{0}。很棒的名字！注册完成！
你已成为三个王国的成员！

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
All done.
Go to the field Officer of Schwarzwald. He should be in the banquet hall of this building downstairs.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
全部办妥了。
请去修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德找军官。他应该就在这栋楼下的宴会厅里。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Only thing left for you is to go to the Officer to say that you are leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你现在只需要去找军官，告诉他你要离开了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
As soon as you tell him,
come back to me again.
You are not the only one expecting this great challenge. I am too.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
告诉他之后，再回来找我。
期待这场伟大挑战的并不只有你，我也一样。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I believe you can do it!
It would bear watching you.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我相信你能做到！
我很期待看到你的表现。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
See you then.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
到时候见。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You came back!
Fast learner!
I love that you're a member of my alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你回来了！
学得真快！
很高兴你是我们同盟的成员。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Our preparations will soon be complete.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我们的准备工作很快就要完成了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We will surely share all our information with the three kingdoms, and study them.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我们一定会与三个王国共享所有情报，并加以研究。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Definitely, you are the one to face all the trials and tribulations.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
毫无疑问，你就是那个要面对所有试炼与磨难的人。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The important thing is that we need to share all the current information relevant to this place.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
重要的是，我们需要共享所有与这个地方相关的最新情报。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I advise you,
if you get friendly with
the creatures in there,
that's a kind source to know.
I'll believe you.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我建议你，
如果你能与里面的生物
建立友好关系，
那将是一个很好的情报来源。
我相信你。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Let's conclude.
You need to investigate and report to us as much as possible. That's not that tough.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
总结一下。
你需要尽可能多地调查并汇报给我们。这并不难。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Don't worry so much.
We will support you.
As we can.
So I will tell you the last step to becoming a member of the alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
别担心。
我们会支持你。
尽我们所能。
所以，我要告诉你成为同盟成员的最后一个步骤。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
In ^FF0000Cheshrumnir in Rachel^000000,
there is a Manager.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
在^FF0000拉赫的瑟斯隆尼勒^000000，
有一位管理员。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You already met someone like that from Rune-Midgarts. So no more explanation is needed.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你在卢恩·米德加兹已经见过类似的人了。所以不需要再多解释了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ok, so we should talk about
the tasks we should go through.
These are about it...
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
好的，那么我们应该谈谈
我们需要完成的任务。
大概就是这样...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Hey, sorry for interrupting you. I also have information to send to Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
嘿，抱歉打断你们。我也有情报要发给阿鲁纳菲兹。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
We're in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我们很赶时间。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Hey! You hear that? Sorry I'm sure that you've got many things to do. Can I request one more thing? I can't deal with it myself.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
嘿！你听到了吗？抱歉，我知道你有很多事要做。我能再请求一件事吗？我自己处理不了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I feel like I am forcing you, but I hope to get your help. Go to the ^FF0000Cheshrumnir Guard^000000 in Rachel and deliver Munkenro's message for me.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我觉得我在强迫你，但我希望能得到你的帮助。请去拉赫找^FF0000切什鲁姆尼尔卫兵^000000，帮我转达蒙肯罗的信息。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
It's the same mission you did for Rune-Midgarts, so it shouldn't be that hard. I hope you can do it.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
这和你在卢恩·米德加兹做过的任务一样，应该不会太难。希望你能顺利完成。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You did it already?
You are a quick worker.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你已经完成了？
你的动作真快。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Anyway, I promised to tell you about the three kingdoms... This is kind of a long story, so please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
总之，我答应过要告诉你关于三个王国的事... 这有点长，请仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The adventurers for Ash-vacuum! The alliance for the three kingdoms! Rune-Midgarts, Schwarzwald, Arunafeltz!
Three kingdoms united for one thing!
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
为了阿什真空！三个王国的联盟！卢恩·米德加兹、修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德、阿鲁纳菲兹！
三个王国为了同一个目标而联合！

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Frankly, there's a Dimensional Rift in the Sograt desert, so they can inspect it themselves, but it's not that good of a place to inspect the rift's magic well.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
说实话，苏克拉特沙漠里有一个次元裂缝，他们自己也可以去检查，但那里并不是检查裂缝魔力井的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We are a little bit better in magic, but not that much developed in science as compared with Schwarzwald, and not as wise compared with Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我们在魔法上稍微强一点，但科技不如修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德发达，智慧也不如阿鲁纳菲兹。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So we need to get help from other countries, because the Ash-vacuum is quite a profitable place. That is why we made the Alliance to get into the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
所以我们需要其他国家的帮助，因为阿什真空是一个非常有利的地方。这就是我们建立联盟进入阿什真空的原因。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The three kingdoms were enemies before. Fortunately, it's going well now. It's fine.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
这三个王国以前是敌人。幸运的是，现在情况还不错。没问题。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
This alliance is a first step for peace among the three kingdoms. You know they are all for themselves, so this needs harmony. That's the one thing to pursue, as head of an alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
这个联盟是三个王国和平的第一步。你知道他们都只顾自己，所以需要和谐。作为联盟的首领，这是唯一需要追求的目标。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Honestly, I am also forced by my kingdom, to further our own interests and not others.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
老实说，我也被我的王国施压，要求我进一步追求我们自己的利益，而不是别人的。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
But the most valuable thing is the unity. Not each kingdom's interest. If we spoil the greatest plans, it's too regrettable.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
但最有价值的是团结。不是每个王国的利益。如果我们破坏了最伟大的计划，那就太遗憾了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Though I belong to Schwarzwald, I need to balance the three kingdoms, as a leader... so I can't support my kingdom too much over the others.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
虽然我属于修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德，但作为领袖... 我需要平衡三个王国，所以我不能过度偏袒我的王国。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Anyway, I believe that my friend can assist me well.
Though he is from another kingdom, he's supported me thus far.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
总之，我相信我的朋友能很好地协助我。
虽然他是来自另一个王国的人，但他一直支持我。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
He's the man to my left.
We call him Munk.
His real name is... Munkenro.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
他是我左边的那个男人。
我们叫他蒙克。
他的真名是... 蒙肯罗。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
He is a kind of manager for Schwaltzvald and he is the main contact point of the kingdom's people, since he's quite closely in communication with them.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
他是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的一种管理员，也是王国人民的主要联系人，因为他与他们沟通得很密切。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
That's enough talk about the three kingdoms. Now, let's move on to the next stories.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
关于三个王国的话就说到这里。现在，让我们继续下一个话题。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Go to Prontera in Rune-Midgarts and find the Manager there. Tell him that the Alliance is doing well and that we are entering the rift.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
去卢恩·米德加兹的普隆德拉，找到那里的管理员。告诉他联盟进展顺利，并且我们正在进入裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So, what do you want to know more of? You already know about the Ash-Vacuum. Is there anything else you'd like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
那么，你还想知道什么？你已经知道关于阿什真空的事了。还有什么你想让我告诉你的吗？

scripts.text: The three kingdoms...
scripts.translation: 三个王国...

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ah, I need to tell you about the alliance, but first, may I ask something?
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
啊，我需要告诉你关于联盟的事，但首先，我可以问个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I need to report its status to the managers in Rune-Midgarts. I can't do it right now. May I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我需要向卢恩·米德加兹的管理员汇报情况，但现在无法离开。能请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
It's not that difficult. Just tell them to prepare for the trip to the Dimensional Rift. It's quite easy, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
这并不难。只要告诉他们为前往次元裂缝的旅程做准备即可。很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We're running out of time, so I will answer you when you come back. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
时间不多了，等你回来我再回答你的问题。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Whew......

[Sikaiz]
You come to be registered as an adventurer? Then I'm the one to talk to. I am Sikaiz, the head of the United Midgard Alliance.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你是来登记成为冒险者的吗？那你找对人了。我是西凯兹，米德加尔特联合联盟的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You come here from Prontera? Then you have been sent by the Recruiter. Didn't he tell you about the stories? Maybe he thought that I would tell you everything.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你是从普隆德拉来的？那你应该是招募员派来的。他没有告诉你那些故事吗？也许他觉得我会把一切都告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I can tell you, but, he's so obstinate. So many kinds of people are living in this world, but quite few are as obstinate as him.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我可以告诉你，但他太固执了。这个世界上有各种各样的人，但像他这么固执的却很少。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The registration is also important now, but I will tell you about our status here. May I begin?
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
登记现在也很重要，但我会先告诉你我们在这里的情况。我可以开始讲了吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Ok. Let me tell you about the Ash-Vacuum. It's quite a long story. So please bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
好的。让我给你讲讲阿什真空。故事有点长，请耐心听我说。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
^FF0000Ash-Vacuum^000000....
This isn't the world of mortals.
Then what is it...
Nobody knows.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
^FF0000阿什真空^000000....
这不是凡人的世界。
那么它是什么...
没有人知道。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Now, we only know that there are living beings there, and that they are not approachable by everyone.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
现在，我们只知道那里有生物存在，而且并非所有人都能接近它们。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
The name, 'Ash-Vacuum', is so we can identify it easily.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
“阿什真空”这个名字，只是为了方便识别它。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
You're probably wondering how we got there...
The answer lies with Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你大概会好奇我们是怎么到达那里的...
答案与魔王梦罗克有关。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Can you imagine?
Why did Satan Morocc
run away from there???
That's the important thing.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
你能想象吗？
魔王梦罗克为什么从那里逃跑了？？？
这才是关键所在。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
He made a gate to run away, by himself. It's very unlike him.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
他独自打开了一扇门逃了出来。这非常不像他的作风。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
But he did make some mistakes. He left an opened gate. Nobody knows if it was intentional... or maybe...
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
但他犯了一些错误。他留下了一扇打开的门。没人知道这是故意的...还是说...

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We call the dimensional rift:
Time-Gap of Dimension.
Who knows what secrets lie in that world beyond.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我们将这个次元裂缝称为：
次元时间裂隙。
谁知道那个世界之外隐藏着什么秘密。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So we've inspected it.
And there's not much info to get from it. We can't guess if it's from the past... or the future... Even WE don't know where it is.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
所以我们调查了它。
但从中获取的信息并不多。我们无法判断它是来自过去...还是未来...甚至我们也不知道它在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
That's the place!
Ash-Vacuum!
We are all in this together!
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
那就是那个地方！
阿什真空！
我们都在同一条船上！

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Is that enough?
Though I am the head of the Alliance, I don't know much else about it. That's why we are all here. To do some research.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
这些够了吗？
虽然我是联盟的领袖，但我对它的了解也不多。这就是我们都在这里研究的原因。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Anyway, I told you about Ash-Vacuum. What I know about it all. Though you still don't know much about it, that's all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
总之，我已经把关于阿什真空我知道的一切都告诉你们了。虽然你们对它的了解依然有限，但我能说的就只有这些了。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
If you have any other questions, you can still ask me...
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
如果你们还有其他问题，尽管问我...

scripts.text:
- The man standing in front -
- is delivering a speech. -
- Let's listen. -
scripts.translation:
- 站在前面的那个男人 -
- 正在发表演讲。 -
- 让我们听听吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
I, Sikaiz, make it a point that we should pursue the great development of the Midgard continent with the research of the newly discovered Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我，西凯兹，在此郑重提议：我们应当通过对新发现的阿什真空的研究，推动米德加尔特大陆的伟大复兴。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
So we must not fight for own interests, we must not forget the mission. We are all together on this, to go through all the same trials.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
因此，我们绝不能只顾私利，更不能忘记使命。我们同舟共济，将共同经历所有的考验。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
This mission shouldn't be for each kingdom's interest alone. If we are not strongly allied for our mission, we will not succeed in discovering the unknown places of Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
这项使命不应仅仅为了某个王国的利益。如果我们不能为了使命而紧密结盟，就无法成功探索阿什真空中的未知之地。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
Now we should think we are all belonging to the Midgard continent. That's home for all of us.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
现在，我们应该意识到我们都属于米德加尔特大陆。那是我们共同的家园。

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
We will leave for Ash-Vacuum, through the dimensional rift soon.
You all should be relaxed about completing this mission. If there are more adventurers to register, let them come to me.
scripts.translation:
[西凯兹]
我们将很快通过次元裂隙前往阿什真空。
请放轻松，去完成这项使命吧。如果有更多冒险者想要登记，让他们来找我。

scripts.text:
- The speech has ended. -
- Let's move on. -
scripts.translation:
- 演讲结束了。 -
- 让我们继续前进吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Sikaiz]
......

[Guard]
You're not allowed to enter.
All of you are instructed to go to the Time-Gap of Dimension on Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
禁止入内。
你们所有人都被指示前往卢恩·米德加兹的次元时间裂隙！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You've come here
to register as a member of the three kingdoms?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你们是来这里登记成为三国联盟成员的？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are not allowed
to enter.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
禁止入内。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just go there.
This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
就待在那里吧。
这是限制区域。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Enter.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
请进。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You're not allowed to enter.
All of you are instructed to go to the Time-Gap of Dimension on Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
禁止入内。
你们所有人都被指示前往卢恩·米德加兹的次元时间裂隙！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just go there.
This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
就待在那里吧。
这是限制区域。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Will you go to the dimensional rift right now?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
您现在要前往次元裂隙吗？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you want,
I can send you to the Time-Gap of Dimension.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
如果您愿意，
我可以送您去次元时间裂隙。

scripts.text: Send me there.
scripts.translation: 送我过去

scripts.text: I will go there myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok, I will send you to the dimensional rift. Once you get there, just find the head of the alliance.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
好的，我将送您前往次元裂隙。到达后，请找到联盟的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are something of an adventurer... Ok. I got it...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
看来您是个不错的冒险者... 好的，我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Once you get there, just find the head of the alliance.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
到达那里后，请找到联盟的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You've come here
to register as a member of the three kingdoms?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你们是来这里登记成为三国联盟成员的？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Enter.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
请进。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You are not allowed
to enter.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
禁止入内。

scripts.text: -Munkenro and Sakaiz don't seem to be getting along very well anymore.-
scripts.translation: -蒙肯罗和西凯兹似乎相处得不太融洽了。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Hm, ok!
That's right.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
嗯，好的！
没错。

scripts.text: -You should probably head over to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -您最好前往莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，并找到那里的卫兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
The heads of the alliance, Sikaiz and Munkenro...
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
联盟的领袖，西凯兹和蒙肯罗...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
They have different values,
so that sometimes causes conflict, but nothing serious has happened so far.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
他们的价值观不同，
这有时会导致冲突，但到目前为止还没有发生严重的事情。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Friendship is the most valuable in this world.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
在这个世界里，友谊是最宝贵的。

scripts.text: -You're still here? You're a member of the alliance now so you should head to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -您还在这里？既然您现在是联盟成员了，就应该前往莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，并找到那里的卫兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I know we are all to go to the dimensional rift. That's why we are allied strongly. But we gather here... so far from there...
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我知道大家都要去次元裂隙。正因如此，我们的联盟才如此紧密。但我们聚集在这里... 离那里那么远...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I think we'd better gather in Prontera on Rune-Midgarts, where I am living.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我觉得我们最好在卢恩·米德加兹的普隆德拉聚集，我就住在那里。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Or just warp for commuting.
I would hope so.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
或者干脆用传送来通勤。
我希望是这样。

scripts.text: -I'm sure they'll settle their little dispute somehow. You should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -我相信他们会以某种方式解决他们的小分歧。您应该前往莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，并找到那里的卫兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Whoosh...
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
呼...

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I am concentrating now!!
Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我现在正在集中精神！！
别担心！

scripts.text: -Maybe Munk is a better leader instead of Sakaiz. Anyways you should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -也许蒙肯罗比西凯兹更适合当领袖。无论如何，您应该前往莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，并找到那里的卫兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
The head of the alliance, Sikaiz... doesn't look healthy.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
联盟的领袖，西凯兹... 看起来不太健康。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
But his upright eyes
are quite reliable.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
但他坚定的眼神
相当可靠。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Munkenro looks so willing to do anything for success. As well as he also seems flexible...
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
蒙肯罗看起来为了成功愿意做任何事。而且他似乎也很灵活...

scripts.text: -I'm so bored!!! You should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there. It's probably less boring there than it is here-
scripts.translation: -我好无聊啊！！！你应该去莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，找到那里的卫兵。那里应该比这里没那么无聊。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I am almost dying of boredom!
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我快无聊死了！

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
So boring!
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
好无聊啊！

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I am not in a good mood.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我现在心情不太好。

scripts.text: -We haven't even started and we're already bickering. Just ignore the politics and head to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -我们还没开始就已经在争吵了。别管那些政治斗争，去莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，找到那里的卫兵吧。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Three kingdoms for world peace...
Will it be successful?
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
为了世界和平的三个王国...
这会成功吗？

scripts.text: -You shouldn't stay around here and listen to all the complaining. You should be heading to the dimensional rift next to Morocc and find the Guard there-
scripts.translation: -你不该留在这里听这些抱怨。你应该去莫洛奇旁边的次元裂隙，找到那里的卫兵。-

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
Why is there so much complaining?
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
为什么有这么多抱怨？

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I'm going along for the benefit of my country.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
我是为了国家的利益才参与的。

scripts.text:
[Member of Alliance]
I wonder if the managers are all talk.
scripts.translation:
[联盟成员]
不知道那些管理员是不是只会说空话。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
With blessings from the Goddess Freya! We three kingdoms will know success! It's all we want. ...Khkhkhkh...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
在女神芙蕾雅的祝福下！我们三个王国一定会成功的！这是我们所期望的。...呵呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
What brings you here, if you won't worship Freya? Just go away.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
如果你不崇拜芙蕾雅，来这里做什么？快滚。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Hm, you've come here to report the status of the alliance? Ok, let me listen.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
嗯，你是来汇报联盟状况的吗？好吧，让我听听。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Hm, everything is going well
and almost prepared for a good start... Hm-hmm...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
嗯，一切进展顺利，
几乎已经为良好的开端做好了准备... 嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
I hate to meet people from Rune-Midgarts, but I can't avoid it.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
我不喜欢见到来自卢恩·米德加兹的人，但我无法避免。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
We're all together for this mission now... They would sacrifice for Freya.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
我们现在为了这个任务聚在一起... 他们会为芙蕾雅牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Now you can go back.
Just say I received the report of the status well.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
现在你可以回去了。
就说我收到了状况汇报。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Goddess Freya, keep us forever!!
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
女神芙蕾雅，永远保佑我们！！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Ash-Vacuum...
It will be mine soon...
Khkhkh!
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
阿什-真空...
很快它就是我的了...
呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Officer]
Why don't you go back there?
Are you afraid to go back?
Khkhkh!
scripts.translation:
[军官]
你为什么不回去？
你不敢回去吗？
呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Officer]
Just go back to the meeting room.
Your allies are there together.
Khkhkh!
Nevermind.
Bye.
scripts.translation:
[军官]
快回会议室去吧。
你的盟友都在那里。
呵呵呵！
算了。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
So why do you come to me?
What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
那你为什么来找我？
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Got any business?
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
I think not.
You come to tell me that you're leaving for the mission.
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
我想不是。
你是来告诉我你要出发去执行任务的吧。
我猜得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
You were sent by Sikaiz...
Right?
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
你是西凯兹派来的...
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Ok, I got your report.
Just go back there.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
好，我收到你的报告了。
快回去吧。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Just do your best
...or whatever you do...
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
尽力就好
...或者随你怎么做...

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Just return there. Good job.
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
快回去吧。干得好。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Sikaiz isn't understandable...
I can't help it...
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
西凯兹真是让人难以理解...
我也没办法...

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
His voice for peace is
only his own way.
Three kingdoms for one mission...
No peace...
We even get no advantage.
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
他口中的和平
只是他的一己之见。
三个王国为了同一个任务...
没有和平...
我们甚至得不到任何优势。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
We can't leave them as they are now. Though I am the leader among them, I'm just a figurehead.
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
我们不能任由他们这样下去。虽然我是他们中的首领，但我只是个傀儡。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Is there any way to change their ways?
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
有没有什么办法能改变他们的做法？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
If they changed,
we wouldn't get in trouble.
But he is not compromising.
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
如果他们改变了，
我们就不会陷入麻烦。
但他不肯妥协。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
So what??
We wouldn't get our interests,
and just do nothing for ourselves?
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
那又怎样？
我们得不到利益，
难道就什么都不做吗？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
There's always Munkenro.
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
还有蒙肯罗。

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
So what...?
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
那又怎样...？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
As honest as Sikaiz...
As flexible as Sikaiz...
But easy to go over him...
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
像西凯兹一样诚实...
像西凯兹一样灵活...
但很容易越过他...

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
We can't cut him out,
so just take the lead from Munkenro. It's easier!
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
既然不能把他排除在外，
那就听从蒙肯罗的领导吧。这样更轻松！

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
Oh!!
That's a good idea.
Anyway...
Some visitors are coming.
Let's talk about it later.
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
哦！！
这是个好主意。
不管怎样...
有访客要来了。
我们稍后再谈。

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Um, what's your business?
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
嗯，你有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Officer A]
For our own interest,
we need to abandon other kingdoms.
scripts.translation:
[军官 A]
为了我们自身的利益，
我们需要放弃其他王国。

scripts.text:
[Officer]
Why don't you go back there?
Are you afraid to go back?
Khkhkh!
scripts.translation:
[军官]
你为什么不回去？
你不敢回去吗？
呵呵呵！

Bye.

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
Um, what's your business?
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
嗯，你有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Officer B]
The most important things are money and power. If we don't get at least one, we're just like the slummy poor.
scripts.translation:
[军官 B]
最重要的是金钱和权力。
如果我们得不到其中至少一样，
我们就和那些贫民窟的穷人没什么两样。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ah, you are a member of the alliance that discovered the dimensional rift? Welcome. Everything is prepared. Just enter and find the camp when you pass through the rift.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
啊，你是发现次元裂缝的联盟成员吗？
欢迎。一切准备就绪。
只需进入裂缝，穿过它就能找到营地。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The new head of the alliance, Munkenro, will direct all of us.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
联盟的新首领蒙肯罗将指挥我们所有人。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Then you will pass.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
那么你可以通过了。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, sure.
scripts.translation: 是的，准备好了。

scripts.text: Please wait.
scripts.translation: 请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just tell me once you are ready. I will let you pass right away.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
准备好了就告诉我一声。
我会立刻让你通过。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You're not allowed to enter here.
If you have any business, just ask the guard behind me, or just leave.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你不允许进入这里。
如果你有事，就去找我身后的卫兵，或者离开。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you the new adventurer?
If you're going to the other side of the rift, the head of the alliance will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你是新来的冒险者吗？
如果你要去裂缝的另一边，联盟的首领会指引你过去。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
He should be near the center of the Gorge. He is stronger than the former one, so be careful with your words.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
他应该在峡谷的中心附近。
他比前任更强，所以说话要小心。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you want to run away from here, just let me know, I will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
如果你想从这里逃跑，告诉我一声，我会指引你。

scripts.text: Escape.
scripts.translation: 逃跑。

scripts.text: Nah.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok.
Follow me, I will let you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
好的。
跟我来，我会带你出去。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Ok, just go ahead for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
好的，那就随你便吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you new here?
You look like you need to find the head of the alliance. You can find him near the center of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你是新来的吗？
看起来你需要找联盟的首领。
你可以在次元裂缝的中心附近找到他。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Just right there.
There's a pillar of stone.
Very close!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
就在那里。
有一根石柱。
非常近！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Are you ready to discover Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你准备好探索阿什-真空了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, of course!
scripts.translation: 是的，当然！

scripts.text: Please, wait...
scripts.translation: 请等一下...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I wish you good luck!
I hope you are successful in your adventures in Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
祝你好运！
希望你在阿什-真空的冒险中一切顺利！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
(...I just follow your lead!)
(I remember you're strong-willed.)
(Though I am guilty,)
(I will do my best.)
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
（...我只是跟着你的脚步走！）
（我记得你意志坚定。）
（虽然我有罪，）
（但我会尽力的。）

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Go prepare.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
去准备吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I am the head of the Three Kingdoms Alliance. You've come here for the discovery of the dimensional rift. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我是三国联盟的首领。你是为了发现次元裂缝而来的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Um. You're the one that
did some favors before...
Your name is {0}?
I remember you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
嗯。你是之前帮过忙的那个人...
你的名字是{0}？
我记得你。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Sikaiz retired from his position urgently. I am his replacement.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
西凯兹紧急辞去了他的职位。我是他的继任者。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You don't need to know in detail all about it now. That's not important to you. Is it?
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你现在不需要知道所有细节。那对你来说并不重要，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You are here for the discovery of the dimensional rift. I can't send you there right away. I know that you've passed your tests, but that's the past. You have not been tested by me. ~
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你是为了发现次元裂缝而来的。我不能马上送你去那里。我知道你通过了之前的测试，但那是过去的事了。你还没有经过我的测试。~

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
So you need to be tested again. I don't have too much time to test you now. So let's just do a short test.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
所以你需要重新接受测试。我现在没有太多时间测试你。所以我们就做一个简短的测试吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Now the soldiers here will start to attack you... If you survive, I will approve of you. Just do it in good time.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
现在这里的士兵们将开始攻击你...如果你能存活下来，我就会认可你。只要在限定时间内完成即可。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
This can prove that you're strong enough. That's the minimum test I can perform.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
这可以证明你足够强大。这是我所能进行的最低限度的测试。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Once you get ready,
just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
准备好后，
告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Are you ready??
Let's start!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
准备好了吗？
开始！

scripts.text: Ready!!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！！

scripts.text: Please, wait...
scripts.translation: 请等一下...

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Ok, just have a good adventure.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
好的，祝你冒险愉快。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
If you are too late,
it will be considered as a failure, so come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
如果你太迟了，
将被视为失败，所以请快点回来。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
If you hesitate,
it means you fail.
I will give you one more chance. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
如果你犹豫了，
那就意味着你失败了。
我再给你一次机会。去吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You're quite shrewd...
How come you passed the test
before? I can't believe this.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你相当精明...
你是怎么通过之前的测试的？
我简直不敢相信。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I will give you one more chance.
Don't make any mistakes again.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我再给你一次机会。
别再犯错了。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Once you get ready,
just let me know,
to start!
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
准备好了就告诉我，
我们开始！

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
We are testing the other adventurers, so unless you have any business with me, visit me later.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我们正在测试其他冒险者，
如果你没有别的事，请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Good! You did a good job!
Though we didn't get enough time to test, I think it's almost perfect.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
很好！你做得不错！
虽然时间不够，没能进行完整的测试，
但我觉得已经接近完美了。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
You can feel I am too strict... I'm just doing what I need to do as head of the Alliance.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
你可能觉得我太严格了...
我只是在履行作为联盟首领的职责。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
If I can't manage the alliance well, I will feel guilty, that I am not doing Sikaiz's job any justice. Anyway, I will do my best.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
如果我管理不好联盟，
我会觉得对不起西凯兹的期望。
无论如何，我会尽力的。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
Huh? I'm just whining.
You don't need to hear this.
Just forget it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
啊？
我只是在发牢骚。
你不用听这些。
忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Munkenro]
I will let you go there.
Let me know once you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[蒙肯罗]
我会让你过去的。
准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you the new adventurer?
If you're going to the other side of the rift, the head of the alliance will guide you there.
scripts.translation:

不，请忽略我刚才说的话。
......

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
You seem to live hard all the time...
scripts.translation:
[卢卡斯]
你看起来总是过得很辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Lucas]
The motherland constantly
sends us people...
Is that passage safe?
scripts.translation:
[卢卡斯]
祖国不断向我们派遣人员...
那条通道安全吗？

scripts.text:
[Davi]
Ahhh, my body...
I walked too much...
and my body hurts.
scripts.translation:
[达维]
啊，我的身体...
走得太多了...
浑身都疼。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
Wawa, what is this~
Hey, is that for me?
scripts.translation:
[扬]
哇哇，这是什么~
嘿，是给我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Jan]
Ahhh, it's exciting~
I love it.
scripts.translation:
[扬]
啊，好兴奋~
我好喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
I want to unwrap it right now~
Please tell the Instructor
I'm grateful~
Uhuhu.
scripts.translation:
[扬]
我现在就想拆开它~
请告诉指导员
我很感激~
呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
Why hasn't the product
that I ordered one month
ago come yet?
scripts.translation:
[扬]
为什么我一个月前订购的
商品还没到？

scripts.text:
[Jan]
I really wanted it.
I really love it~~
scripts.translation:
[扬]
我真的好想要。
我超级喜欢~~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is... it~~?

[Jan]
It, it's a secret...
scripts.translation:
[扬]
这...这是个秘密...

scripts.text:
[Jan]
The more I study around here,
the more I find strange things.
scripts.translation:
[扬]
我在这附近研究得越多，
就发现越多奇怪的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jan]
It seems to stimulate my
passion as a scientist?
scripts.translation:
[扬]
这似乎激发了我
作为科学家的热情？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Gerard?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是杰拉德吗？

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Yes, I am.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
是的，是我。
你找我有事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Instructor Lugen sent
me for an errand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
指导员 鲁根派我
来送个东西。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Ah! Supplies.
The supplies that ran out.
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
啊！补给品。
就是那些用完了的补给品。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
I am so hungry that
I was considering
going back to the camp.
I really appreciate this.
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
我饿得正考虑
要不要回营地。
真的太感谢你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...
You ran out of supplies, but
you didn't go back to the camp?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
你的补给品用完了，
但还没回营地吗？

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Yes.
This place is really interesting
and I don't want to leave at all.
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
是的。
这里真的很有趣，
我一点都不想离开。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Please tell the instructor that
I won't be back for some time.
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
请告诉指导员，
我还会在这里待一段时间。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Hhhh, I am starving.
When will the supplies come?
It is killing me...
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
呼，我快饿死了。
补给品什么时候能到？
真的快把我折磨死了...

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
Hu, I am full now.
Time to continue on
with the exploration!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
呼，我吃饱了。
该继续
探索了！！！

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
I was born in a desert
and have never seen
a field so green.
So, to study here.
is very interesting.
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
我出生在沙漠，
从未见过
如此翠绿的田野。
所以，在这里研究
非常有意思。

scripts.text:
[Gerard]
By the way... is this a
mushroom or a tree?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉德]
顺便问一下...
这是蘑菇还是树？

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Hhh, I am cold...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
呼，好冷...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Alberto, take this.
The Instructor sent
me on an errand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿尔贝托先生，拿着这个。
指导员派我
来送个东西。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
I finally got it.
My coat...sniff.
It's freezing here.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
终于拿到了。
我的外套...吸溜。
这里冷得要命。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Sniff...
- rustling sound -
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
吸溜...
- 窸窸窣窣的声音 -

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Ah, I am sorry but...
My hands are so cold
that I cannot open it.
Can you open it for me?.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
啊，不好意思...
我的手冻僵了，
打不开。能帮我打开吗？

scripts.text:
- rustling sound -
- Opening someone -
- else's stuff makes -
- me feel strange. -
scripts.translation:
- 窸窸窣窣的声音 -
- 打开别人的东西 -
- 让我感觉有点奇怪。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here it is.
Hopefully it'll warm you up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你。
希望能让你暖和一点。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Yes I really appreciate it.
It makes me feel alive.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
真的非常感谢。
我感觉自己活过来了。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
Please tell the Instructor
that I am still alive.
Sniff.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
请告诉指导员，
我还活着。
吸溜。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
It's so cold here~~
the wind chills me to the bones~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
这里好冷~~
风冷得刺骨~

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
I am still cold even
with this heavy coat.
I need to order more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
穿着这件厚外套
我还是觉得冷。
我得再订几件衣服。

scripts.text:
[Alberto]
What are these weird
structures set up
here and there?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔贝托]
这里到处都竖着
这些奇怪的结构
是什么？

scripts.text:
[Alix]
Huu, I made this and
this is really great.
When I am back
to the motherland,
I will open a shop for it!!
scripts.translation:
[阿利克斯]
呼，这是我做的，
真的很好吃。
等我回到祖国，
我要开个店卖这个！！

scripts.text:
[Alix]
Have you had it?
My chocolate pie!!!
This food is a real miracle!!
scripts.translation:
[阿利克斯]
你尝尝看？
我的巧克力派！！
这食物简直是奇迹！！

scripts.text:
[Biolay]
Sob...
Where is she?
scripts.translation:
[比奥莱]
呜呜...
她在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Biolay]
I was just wandering
around Morocc and
became faint. then
I found myself here.
scripts.translation:
[比奥莱]
我刚才在莫洛奇
四处游荡，
然后晕倒了，
醒来就发现自己在这里。

scripts.text:
[Biolay]
I want to go back to my house.
scripts.translation:
[比奥莱]
我想回家。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
- rustling sound -
- You find a branch -
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙声 -
- 你发现了一根树枝 -

scripts.text:
- Break! -
- Bomb, bomb~~ -
- You got the branch. -
scripts.translation:
- 咔嚓！ -
- 轰，轰~~ -
- 你拿到了树枝。 -

scripts.text:
- Break! -
- Bomb, bomb~~ -
- This branch is decayed. -
scripts.translation:
- 咔嚓！ -
- 轰，轰~~ -
- 这根树枝已经腐烂了。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is useless.
I need to find others...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这没用。
我得去找别的...

scripts.text:
- rustling sound -
- There's nothing useful. -
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙声 -
- 这里没有什么有用的东西。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -
- barracks are broken. -
scripts.translation:
- 营地的柱子 -
- 断了。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -
- barracks are broken. -
- You'd better go out and -
- find the materials to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 营地的柱子 -
- 断了。 -
- 你最好出去 -
- 找些材料来修好它。 -

scripts.text:
- There are broken posts. -
- Unless they are fixed soon, -
- the barracks will collapse. -
scripts.translation:
- 这里有断掉的柱子。 -
- 如果不尽快修好， -
- 营地就会倒塌。 -

scripts.text: Attach the tree bar.
scripts.translation: 安装树枝

scripts.text: Tie it with the vines.
scripts.translation: 用藤蔓绑住

scripts.text:
- You attach the tree bar -
- to the broken post -
scripts.translation:
- 你将树枝 -
- 固定在断掉的柱子上 -

scripts.text: - You tie the broken post -
scripts.translation: - 你绑住了断掉的柱子 -

scripts.text: - It seems that it's fixed -
scripts.translation: - 看起来修好了 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Oh! Now you need to
knot it and finish it.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
哦！现在你需要
打结并完成了。

scripts.text: Knot it.
scripts.translation: 打结

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: - You tie a perfect knot -
scripts.translation: - 你打了一个完美的结 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
And this post should be knotted.
Then please do it to that post.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
这根柱子需要打结固定。
请帮那根柱子也处理一下。

scripts.text: - You decide to leave -
scripts.translation: - 你决定离开 -

scripts.text:
- The branches slide down. -
- You failed to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 树枝滑了下来。 -
- 你没能修好它。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
...
Why aren't you helping?
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
...
你为什么不帮忙？

scripts.text:
- You fix the broken post -
- with the vines. -
- It seems that you-
- need more branches. -
scripts.translation:
- 你用藤蔓修好了断掉的柱子 -
- 但看起来还需要更多的树枝。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
This post is repaired.
Please do the same thing
on the other posts.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
这根柱子修好了。
请对其他柱子也做同样的处理。

scripts.text:
- The post tied by the -
- vines seems unsteady -
- but my repair is perfect. -
scripts.translation:
- 用藤蔓绑住的柱子看起来不太稳 -
- 但我的修复很完美。 -

scripts.text:
- The posts of the -

- 断了。 -

scripts.text:

- barracks are broken. -
- You'd better go out and -

scripts.translation:

- 断了。 -
- 你最好出去 -
- 找些材料来修好它。 -

- Unless they are fixed soon, -
- the barracks will collapse. -
scripts.translation:
- 这里有断掉的柱子。 -
- 如果不尽快修好， -
- 营地就会倒塌。 -

- to the broken post -
scripts.translation:
- 你将树枝 -
- 固定在断掉的柱子上 -

scripts.text: - You tie the broken post -
scripts.translation: - 你绑住了断掉的柱子 -

scripts.text: - It seems that it's fixed -
scripts.translation: - 看起来修好了 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Oh! Now you need to knot it and
finish it.
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
哦！现在你需要打结并完成了。

scripts.text: Knot it.
scripts.translation: 打结

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: - You tie a perfect knot -
scripts.translation: - 你打了一个完美的结 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
Ohhh!!!!
The broken posts are perfectly fixed!
scripts.translation:
[迭戈]
哦！！！！
断掉的柱子完美地修好了！

scripts.text: - You decide to leave -
scripts.translation: - 你决定离开 -

scripts.text:
- The branches slide down. -
- You failed to fix it. -
scripts.translation:
- 树枝滑了下来。 -
- 你没能修好它。 -

scripts.text:
[Diego]
...
Why aren't you helping?
scripts.translation:

...
你为什么不帮忙？

- It seems that you-

scripts.translation:
- 你用藤蔓修好了断掉的柱子 -
- 但看起来还需要更多的树枝。 -

scripts.text:
- The post tied by the -

- but my repair is perfect. -
scripts.translation:
- 用藤蔓绑住的柱子看起来不太稳 -
- 但我的修复很完美。 -

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Who... Who are you?
Are you from the other
side of the space gap?
Say, are you a scholar,
soldier, or village
representative?
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者]
你...你是谁？
你是来自空间裂缝另一边的吗？
请问，你是学者、士兵，还是村庄代表？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Oh, I'm sorry.
You don't have to tell
me if you don't want to...
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者]
哦，抱歉。
如果你不想说，就不必告诉我...

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Who... Who are you?
Are you from the other
side of the space gap?
Say, are you a scholar,
soldier, or village
representative?
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者]
你...你是谁？
你是来自空间裂缝另一边的吗？
请问，你是学者、士兵，还是村庄代表？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Oh, I'm sorry.
You don't have to tell
me if you don't want to...
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者]
哦，抱歉。
如果你不想说，就不必告诉我...

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
Please go ahead and do
what you have to do.
Oh, me? Don't worry.
I'm fine by myself.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者]
请继续做你需要做的事吧。
哦，我吗？别担心。
我一个人没问题。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Monster Scholar]
I'm Rumis Block, and
I'm working here on behalf of
the monsternomics academy
from the Schwarzwald Republic.
Botanist Terris Block is
my older twin brother.
scripts.translation:
[怪物学者]
我是鲁米斯·布洛克，
我代表修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的怪物经济学学院在此工作。
植物学家泰瑞斯·布洛克是我的双胞胎哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
This place is freezing. Not only
that, it's deserted and too
quiet... Everything around us is
watching and threatening us.
You know, I didn't want to
come here...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
这里冷得要命。不仅如此，这里荒无人烟，太安静了...周围的一切都在注视着我们，威胁着我们。
你知道吗，我本来不想来这里的...

scripts.text: How did you get here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么来到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
In fact, none of us
wanted to come here.
I mean, no one knows
what kind of danger lurks
in this unknown world.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
其实，我们谁都不想来这里。
我是说，没人知道这个未知世界里潜伏着什么样的危险。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
It was my brother Terris who
wanted me to come along.
He was selected first as the
botanist of the continental
expedition. He had to drag me
here 'cuz I didn't want to come.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
是我哥哥泰瑞斯让我一起来的。
他首先被选为大陆探险队的植物学家。因为他不想一个人来，所以硬把我拖到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I guess he didn't want to be
alone in this world far away
from civilization. Instead, he
decided to drag me here and
force me to join the expedition
so he doesn't feel lonely!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我想他是不想在这个远离文明的世界里独自一人。于是，他决定把我拖到这里，强迫我加入探险队，这样他就不会感到孤单了！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
What's with that dirty look?
Why, do I sound like
someone blaming someone
else for the misery in his life?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你那嫌弃的眼神是怎么回事？
怎么，听起来像是我在把生活中的不幸怪罪给别人吗？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm telling you, it's the truth.
There are people that want 
to escape the expedition by
getting themselves sick on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我告诉你，这是事实。
有些人为了逃避探险，故意让自己生病。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I know it's too late to
complain now, but...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我知道现在抱怨已经太迟了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Every day I pray to God to
let me go back home safely.
That's the only thing that
keeps me going. Everything
around here is watching me.
It's suffocating, you know?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
每天我都祈祷上帝能让我平安回家。
这是支撑我活下去的唯一动力。
这里的一切都在注视着我。
令人窒息，你知道吗？

scripts.text: When do you go back?
scripts.translation: 你们什么时候回去？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
That's the problem.
We Specialists are required
to submit our study reports
to the expedition's leaders.
We are here to explore
and study this world.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
这就是问题所在。
我们专家必须向探险队首领提交研究进度报告。
我们在这里是为了探索和研究生这个世界的。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm sure the management will
tell me when to go back, but
I don't expect it to be any time
soon. It'll be at least after
I submit my report.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我相信管理层会告诉我什么时候能回去，
但我预计不会很快。
至少也要等我提交完报告之后。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I must tell you,
I hate this place!
It gives me the creeps!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我必须告诉你，
我讨厌这个地方！
它让我毛骨悚然！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Yes, I'm a monster scholar
But I've been afraid of creatures even when I was on the Midgard Continent...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
是的，我是一名怪物学者，
但即使是在米德加尔特大陆时，我也害怕生物...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
No, but can't you see?
This place is totally new to me,
and everything is so unknown...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
不，难道你看不到吗？
这个地方对我来说完全陌生，
一切都那么未知...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I may be a monster scholar,
but I'm afraid...
Of many things...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我可能是一名怪物学者，
但我害怕...
害怕很多东西...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
The president of United
Midgard Corporation has
asked me to find some
monsters that are edible.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
联合米德加尔特公司的总裁
要求我寻找一些可以食用的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
But look outside. Look!
Do you see Mandragoras
hiding in the icy bushes?
Those are called ^3131FFNepentheses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
但看看外面。看！
你看到藏在冰草丛中的曼陀罗魔花了吗？
那些叫做^3131FF猪笼草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Aren't they quite savage-
looking and intimidating?
They look as if they
want to sting me with
those sharp thorns!
Argh...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
它们看起来不是很野蛮、很吓人吗？
它们看起来好像想用那些尖刺
刺我一样！
啊...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'd rather starve to
death than study
those dangerous and
grotesque monsters!
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我宁愿饿死，
也不愿研究那些危险且怪异的魔物！
我不会走出我的帐篷。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Not ever.
No one can dare
venture through
such a threatening
environment!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
永远都不会。
没人敢涉足
如此充满威胁的环境！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
Not ever.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我不会走出我的帐篷。
永远都不会。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm scared of this place.
But I'm not going to ask
my brother for help
He hates me.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我害怕这个地方。
但我不会向哥哥求助，
他讨厌我。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
If a Nepenthes
approaches me
with a smile and
speaks to me kindly...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
如果一只猪笼草
微笑着靠近我，
并且温柔地与我对话...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
*Sigh* I sound crazy, don't I?
...This is why I didn't want
to leave my lab...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
*叹气* 我听起来很疯狂，对吧？
...这就是为什么我不想离开我的实验室...

scripts.text: Show loot from Nepentheses.
scripts.translation: 查看猪笼草的掉落物

scripts.text: Scold him.
scripts.translation: 责骂他

scripts.text: Comfort him.
scripts.translation: 安慰他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, take a look here...
These Nepentheses aren't
any more brutal or grotesque
than the ones back home.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你看这里...
这些猪笼草
并不比家乡的
更凶残或可怕。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...What's this?
Isn't this from
the Nepentheses?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...这是什么？
这不是
猪笼草掉落的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right!
I took care of them.
It was easy, haha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错！
我处理掉了它们。
很简单，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I can't believe you really
took care of them! Tell me,
who are you really?
Are you a soldier?
Captain? Or agent?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
真不敢相信你
真的处理掉了它们！告诉我，
你究竟是谁？
是士兵？
船长？还是特工？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I'm just a wandering
adventurer. I've come here
to challenge this new place
and to help people out~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我只是一个
流浪的冒险者。我来这里
是为了挑战这个新地方，
并帮助人们~

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I... I see.
I've heard about adventurers
that have made positive
impacts on Midgard.
You're one of them, huh?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我...我明白了。
我听说过
对米德加尔特
产生积极影响的冒险者。
你也是其中之一，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...That's great!
I think I've finally found
a silver lining. God has
sent me a savior.
And I think that's you!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...太好了！
我想我终于
看到了一丝希望。神
派来了救世主。
我想那就是你！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Please, don't say you
don't want to help me.
Can't you see that.
I'm shivering in fear?
Please help me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
求求你，别说
你不想帮我。
难道你看不见吗？
我吓得发抖？
请帮帮我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
As I told you earlier,
I have an elder twin
brother, Terris Block...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
正如我之前所说，
我有一个年长的双胞胎
哥哥，特里斯·布洛克...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
He's a botanist. He's
extremely strong and
extroverted, unlike me.
I think he hates me because
I represent weakness, and
he is the complete opposite.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
他是一名植物学家。他
非常强壮且
外向，不像我。
我想他讨厌我，因为
我代表着软弱，而
他恰恰相反。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Oh, that's not what I wanted
to say. I wanted to show my
discovery regarding the
Nepentheses to my brother.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...哦，这不是
我想说的。我想
向哥哥展示我
关于猪笼草的发现。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I need a Nepenthes specimen,
but I don't have the tools to
make one, my luggage is still
on transfer. And it's not like
I've packed enough tools, so...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我需要猪笼草标本，
但我没有制作标本的工具，
我的行李还在
转移中。而且
我也没带足够的工具，所以...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
To make my specimen tools,
I need ^3131FF1 Empty Bottle,
5 Holy Waters, and
30 Sticky Mucus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
为了制作标本工具，
我需要 ^3131FF1 个空瓶，
5 瓶圣水，以及
30 份粘稠液体^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
You know what I'm.
asking here, don't you?
Help me, help me, please.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你知道我
在请求什么，对吧？
帮帮我，帮帮我，求你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You call yourself a monster
scholar, and yet you're afraid
of practicing your expertise.
You're nothing but a coward.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你自称怪物学者，
却害怕实践你的专长。
你不过是个胆小鬼。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I can take your criticism,
but I can't hide my true feelings.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我可以接受你的批评，
但我无法隐藏我的真实感受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Come on, you're a respected
monster scholar. You'll find
that the monsters in this world
aren't that different from the
ones in Midgard. Why don't
you see for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜托，你是一位受人尊敬的
怪物学者。你会发现
这个世界的魔物
与米德加尔特的那些
没什么不同。为什么
不亲自去看看呢？

scripts.text:
- Rumis didn't seem -
- to be convinced. -
- He shook his head in refusal. -
scripts.translation:
- 鲁米斯似乎 -
- 并不信服。 -
- 他摇头拒绝了。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'm not going to go
outside of my tent.
Not ever.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我不会走出我的帐篷。
永远都不会。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Thank you.
you've brought the materials.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
谢谢你。
你带来了材料。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
While you were collecting the
materials, I've sent out soldiers
to catch a few Nepentheses.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
在你收集材料的时候，
我已经派士兵去
捕捉了几只猪笼草。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Nepenthes looks extremely
similar to Mandragora on
the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
猪笼草看起来
与米德加尔特大陆的
曼陀罗魔花
极其相似。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Both of them must share the
same ancestor, but apparently
Nepenthes has evolved to
become stronger and more
aggressive due to this
barren environment.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
它们一定拥有
共同的祖先，但显然，
猪笼草在这种
贫瘠的环境中
进化得
更强壮、更具攻击性。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I wonder how the ancestors
were scattered over
two different worlds...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我想知道祖先们
是如何分散到
两个不同的世界的...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Maybe they went through
the World Tree Yggdrasil?
Maybe it came along with
other creatures such as
Satan Morocc and traversed
through time and space.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
也许它们穿过了
世界树 尤克特拉希尔？
也许它们伴随着
魔王梦罗克等其他生物，
穿越了时间和空间。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
The characteristics of this species are...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
这个物种的特征是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh, where are my manners?
I'm sorry if I bored you by
talking academic nonsense...
Let's talk about something
else, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
哦，我的失礼了。
抱歉让你听我
讲这些学术上的废话...
我们聊点别的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Do you think...
My brother will be happy to
see this Nepenthes specimen?
You know, Nepenthes is a
plant monster, and that's
my brother's specialty.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你觉得...
我哥哥看到
这个猪笼草标本
会高兴吗？
你知道的，猪笼草是
植物魔物，
这正是我哥哥的专长。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Please deliver this specimen to Terris Block
He's near the expedition camp.
No, you won't have to sit through my brother's reaction... If it's bad.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
请把这个标本交给特里斯·布洛克。
他在探险营地附近。
不，你不用留下来听我哥哥的反应...如果反应不好的话。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
- You have received a-
- Nepenthes Specimen -
- from Rumis Block. -
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
- 你从鲁米斯·布洛克那里 -
- 获得了一个 -
- 猪笼草标本 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
To make my specimen tools,
I need ^3131FF1 Empty Bottle, 5 Holy Waters, and 30 Sticky Mucus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
为了制作我的标本工具，
我需要^3131FF1 1个空瓶、5瓶圣水，以及30份粘稠液体^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
You know what I'm asking here, don't you? Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你知道我在要求什么，对吧？
提前谢谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Did you deliver the Nepenthes Specimen to my brother Terris?
He's at the east of the camp.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你把猪笼草标本
交给我哥哥特里斯了吗？
他在营地的东边。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Welcome back.
Oh, you don't have to tell me what my brother said,
because someone from his side already came by. His report really impressed management, huh?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...欢迎回来。
哦，你不用告诉我哥哥说了什么，
因为他那边已经有人来过了。他的报告让管理层印象深刻，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Yes, that's my brother......
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
是的，那是我哥哥......
