scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Anyways, one of the soldiers that captured Nepentheses for me has given me some interesting information.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...总之，为我捕捉猪笼草的
其中一名士兵
给了我一些有趣的信息。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Over the eastern bridge, he found a new type of monster.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
在东边的桥上，
他发现了一种新的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
According to his description, the monster is suspected to be a member of the long-haired Cat family. I'd like to see it with my own eyes, but...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
根据他的描述，
这种魔物疑似是
长毛猫家族的成员。
我想亲眼看看，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
As you know, I'm not yet ready to face any types of monsters in this world...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你知道的，
我还没有准备好
面对这个世界的
任何类型的魔物...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Can you escort me while I'm studying that species?
Please, I'm begging you!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
在我研究那个物种的时候，
你能护送我吗？
拜托了，我求你了！

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Wow, thanks!
Then I'd better pack my stuff right away...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
哇，太感谢了！
那我得赶紧收拾行李了...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
It won't take long. Can you please go wait for me over the eastern bridge?
Don't... Don't go too far from the bridge!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
不会花太久的。你能去东边的桥上等我吗？
别...别离桥太远！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh.........

[Rumis Block]
I'll pack my stuff and follow you. Can you please go wait for me over the rightward bridge?
Don't... Don't go too far from the bridge!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我会收拾好东西跟上你的。你能去右边的桥上等我吗？
别...别离桥太远！

scripts.text: - Rumis is hurriedly packing his stuff. -
scripts.translation: - 鲁米斯正在匆忙地收拾行李。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
......
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
......

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Apparently, an extremely intelligent creature inhabits Ash Vaccum.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
据说，在阿什·瓦库姆栖息着一种极其聪明的生物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
An explorer went over the rightward bridge to find some wood. In the darkness, something really big rushed at him from far away.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
一位探险者过右边的桥去砍柴。在黑暗中，一个巨大的东西从远处冲向他。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
When he came back to his senses, there was nothing but a tricorn hat left on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
等他回过神来，地上只剩下一顶三角帽了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
The tricorn is woven in a way that was never introduced to Midgard, and its materials are also unidentifiable.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
这顶三角帽的编织方式从未在米德加尔特出现过，其材质也无法辨认。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Does it mean another race of human resides here? Would they be fairies or something else?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
这意味着这里还居住着另一个人类种族吗？会是精灵还是其他什么？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
What if they've detected us and tried to drive us away... Wah!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
如果他们发现了我们并试图驱赶我们...哇！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Even thinking of them send chills down on my spine! Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge?
I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
光是想想就让我脊背发凉！你能去检查一下右边桥尽头居住的是什么种族吗？
我想知道他们对我们是否友好。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Welcome back. Did you find out about them?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
欢迎回来。你查明他们的情况了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, let's see...

[{0}]
The owner of the tricorn hat
is a monster called...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这顶三角帽的主人
是一种叫做...的魔物

scripts.text: ^FF0000Tatacho^000000

[{0}]
{1}...? I don't think that was the name...

[{0}]
The size of Tatacho is about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哒哒乔的大小大概是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tatachos are usually sitting on the ground, but they roll around if their body temperature goes down too low because of the cold weather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哒哒乔通常坐在地上，但如果天气太冷导致体温过低，它们就会在地上打滚。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
About that tricorn hat, I've concluded, based on my opinion about their appearance and their movement patterns, that it is not active or productive at all:
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
关于那顶三角帽，根据我对它们外貌和运动模式的观察，我得出的结论是：它们完全不具备主动性和生产力：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are not intelligent enough to produce a sophisticated hat like that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它们的智力不足以制作出如此精致的帽子。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
......
You now sound like me... I guess I've stained you with my academic manner of speech. Oh, I'm not saying it is bad, but...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
......
你现在的说话方式听起来像我...我想我让你沾染了我的学术腔调。哦，我不是说这不好，只是...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Anyways, according to your conclusion, the hat must have been given to them by someone else, or they could have picked it up after another creature dropped it.
Thank you for such valuable information.
It's enough to write a report.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
总之，根据你的结论，这顶帽子一定是别人送给它们的，或者是它们捡到了其他生物掉落的帽子。
谢谢你提供了如此宝贵的信息。
这足以写一份报告了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I should make a brief report and then submit it to management. Hopefully, a new monster scholar after me will do a better job in actually studying them.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我应该写一份简短的报告并提交给管理层。希望在我之后的新怪物学者能更好地研究它们。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
There are many cold places in my country, the Schwarzwald Republic, but none are as cold as this place. This weather is freezing my senses, dulling my passion toward my studies.
I shall go back home faster than anyone else in this camp. I'm tired of this world...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
在我的祖国修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国，有很多寒冷的地方，但没有像这里这么冷的。这天气冻僵了我的感官，也磨钝了我对研究的热情。
我会比营地里的任何人都更快回家。我受够了这个世界...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...{0}, I thank you so much for helping me despite my self-centered behavior.
I really appreciate it
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...{0}，非常感谢你在我如此自私的情况下还帮助我。
我真的非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'll repay your favor as soon as I go back home.
I hope you'll make yourself known in Ash Vacuum with your great accomplishments.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
等我回到家，我会报答你的恩情。
希望你在阿什能凭借伟大的成就声名远扬。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge? I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你能去检查一下右边那座桥尽头居住着哪些种族吗？我想知道它们对我们是否友好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Rumis! Take a look at this!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鲁米斯先生！请看这个！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Oh, hello.
I'm extremely frustrated. I feel helpless because I wasn't able to go back home last time...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...哦，你好。
我非常沮丧。因为上次没能回家，我感到很无助...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've found this horn from a monster in the Splendide Area.
That monster was very mysterious, and its body was covered with grass.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在辉煌领域从一只魔物身上发现了这只锹形虫。
那只魔物非常神秘，身体上覆盖着草。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Ho... Covered with grass?
...I know you're excited, but that doesn't sound interesting to me. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
哦...覆盖着草？
...我知道你很兴奋，但这听起来并不有趣。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Let me take a look at the horn.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
让我看看这只锹形虫。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Uhmm...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Huh...?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
咦...？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...This is remarkable.
...This horn looks very similar to that of the Hillsrions that inhabit the Manuk area.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...这很了不起。
...这只锹形虫看起来非常像栖息在马努克地区的丘陵狮的锹形虫。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I wonder if they're related,
or if this is an evolved Hillsrion.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我想知道它们是否有亲缘关系，
或者这是一只进化后的丘陵狮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, and there's the possibility of mutation caused by the environment.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，还有可能是由环境引起的变异。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...What do you mean?
Are you saying the monster has been mutated by environmental causes?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...你这是什么意思？
你是说魔物是因为环境原因发生了变异吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, that's possible, isn't it? Haha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这也有可能，不是吗？哈哈！

scripts.text: - You told Rumis what you've heard from Botanist Terris: some plants are already showing signs of mutation. -
scripts.translation: - 你告诉了鲁米斯你从植物学家泰瑞斯那里听到的事：有些植物已经出现了变异的迹象。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh, that's interesting.
If such a device really exists, it's possible to cause abnormal growth to monsters by injecting them with special energy.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
哦，这很有趣。
如果这种装置真的存在，那么通过注入特殊能量，确实有可能导致魔物发生异常生长。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
By the way, who came up with the idea of that device?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
顺便问一下，是谁想出了这个装置的主意的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全不知道。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I see...
Mutants caused by a man-made device... Then there might be more mutated creatures in addition to Tendrillion.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
原来如此...
由人造装置造成的变异...那么除了三角兽之外，可能还有其他变异的生物。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Now I'm very curious.
But... I want to go back home... It's no use studying them if the management will order me to return.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...我现在非常好奇。
但是...我想回家...如果管理层命令我回去，研究它们也没用了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I guess my brother really likes this place.
I mean, he's working so hard to figure things out...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
看来我哥哥真的很喜欢这个地方。
我是说，他为了弄清楚事情真相，工作得非常努力...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Well, not everyone can live the same life.
I just hope he'll have a better understanding about me...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
嗯，并不是每个人都能过一样的生活。
我只希望他能更理解我一些...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I don't know if people in Midgard will welcome me back.
Thanks to you, I at least have a few interesting stories to tell them.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我不知道米德加尔特的人是否会欢迎我回去。
多亏了你，我至少有几个有趣的故事可以讲给他们听。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
If you're going to stick around here longer, please help my brother with his study.
I might want to come back later once this area is fully explored and developed...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
如果你打算在这里多待一段时间，请帮我哥哥做研究。
等这个区域被完全探索和开发后，我可能会再回来...

scripts.text: - With a shy smile on the face, Rumis Block asked you to shake hands, and then turned around hurriedly. -
scripts.translation: - 鲁米斯·布洛克脸上带着羞涩的微笑，请你握手，然后匆匆转身离开了。 -

scripts.text: - You really hope that Rumis will be able to go back home. -
scripts.translation: - 你真的希望鲁米斯能回家。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...I submitted the report to the management, but they have not yet ordered me to go back home...
...*Sigh* I guess nothing's as easy as I'd hoped.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...我向管理层提交了报告，但他们还没有命令我回家...
...*叹气* 看来事情并没有我想象的那么顺利。

scripts.text: - Rumis seems anxious and scatterbrained. -
scripts.translation: - 鲁米斯看起来很焦虑，有些心神不宁。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
When can I go back to Midgard...? *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我什么时候能回米德加尔特...？*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
这片新土地！
未被发现的生命！
这个世界的每一样东西都让我兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!
This is how it goes...
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦，好的...啊哈！
事情就是这样发展的...

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
这片新土地！
未被发现的生命！
这个世界的每一样东西都让我兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!
This is how it goes...
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦，好的...啊哈！
事情就是这样发展的...

scripts.text:
This new land!
Undiscovered life!
Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation:
这片新土地！
未被发现的生命！
这个世界的每一样东西都让我兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, okay... Ah-hah!
This is how it goes...
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦，好的...啊哈！
事情就是这样发展的...

scripts.text: Express your displeasure.
scripts.translation: 表达不满

scripts.text: Agree with him.
scripts.translation: 表示赞同

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your excitement agitates me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的兴奋让我感到烦躁。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Err? Ahahahaha!
Oh, come on! I'm just being happy.
By the way, is there anything I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
诶？啊哈哈！
哎呀！我只是很开心而已。
对了，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I agree. There's so much to see around here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我同意。这里有很多值得看的东西！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Ahahaha!
Nice to meet you, my friend.
So, is there anything I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
啊哈哈！
很高兴认识你，我的朋友。
那么，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother wanted me to send this to you. Maybe it'll help with your study.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你哥哥让我把这个带给你。也许对你的研究有帮助。

scripts.text: - You have given the Nepenthes Specimen to the botanist. -
scripts.translation: - 你将猪笼草标本交给了植物学家。 -

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh...? Isn't this?!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦...？这不是...！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
...Well, I've got a ton of samples of this specimen. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
...好吧，我有很多这种标本的样本。抱歉。

scripts.text: - He points at a pile of specimens in the tent. -
scripts.translation: - 他指向帐篷里的一堆标本。 -

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Still, I'm impressed. I always thought my brother could never do anything on his own. But look, he was able to collect a Nepenthes specimen.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
不过，我还是很佩服。我一直以为我哥哥什么都做不好。但看，他居然能采集到猪笼草标本。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Then again, I had this strong feeling that someone has helped him.
That someone was probably you, right?~
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
话说回来，我有一种强烈的感觉，有人帮了他。
那个人应该就是你吧？~

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Either way, I don't care.
I'm just happy that he cares about me...
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
不管怎样，我不在乎。
我只是很高兴他关心我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why do you think that?
Can't you just thank him for trying to help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么这么想？
难道不能感谢他试图帮你吗？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Well, you must forget that he and I are twins.
We are spiritually connected to each other.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
嗯，你一定忘了我和他是双胞胎。
我们在精神上彼此相连。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Usually twins share the same feelings and ideas, I can see what he does or thinks if I try hard.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
通常双胞胎会有相同的感受和想法，如果我努力的话，我能看到他在做什么或想什么。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Let me see what Rumis is doing right now... Oh, he's picking his nose with his left hand and eating a slice of bread with his right.
God, how disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
让我看看鲁米斯现在在做什么...哦，他在用左手挖鼻孔，用右手吃一片面包。
天哪，真恶心！

scripts.text: Go check Rumis if it's true.
scripts.translation: 去检查鲁米斯是否属实

scripts.text: Do not trust his word.
scripts.translation: 不要相信他的话。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Hahaha!
Muhahaha!
Let me guess, you want to go check Rumis to see if I'm telling the truth. Am I wrong?
Hahahaha! Sorry, but I lied. I mean, remote vision? Because we're twins?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哈哈哈！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
让我猜猜，你是想去看看鲁米斯，验证我说的话是不是真的。我猜错了吗？
哈哈哈哈哈！抱歉，我骗你了。我是说，远程视觉？因为我们是双胞胎？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
God, you're so funny. Hahaha~
You please me, just like the new creatures blooming on the World Tree.~
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
天哪，你真有趣。哈哈哈~
你让我很开心，就像世界树上绽放的新奇生物一样。~

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh,
won't you cut me some slack? I was just joking to melt the ice.
This world is too barren and tough to live without good humor and jokes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦，
你就别怪我了，我只是开个玩笑来打破僵局。
这个世界太贫瘠、太艰难了，没有幽默和玩笑怎么活呢，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Anyways, as I said, I've got a lot of Nepenthes specimens.
But I'll gratefully take this pretentious gift of his.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
总之，正如我所说，我有很多猪笼草标本。
但我也会欣然接受他这份自命不凡的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This may be an unexpected question, but... Are you interested in meeting dangerous girls playing on a field?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
这可能是一个意想不到的问题，但...你对在草地上玩耍的危险女孩感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Dangerous girls?
scripts.translation: 危险的女孩？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Yes, femme fatales!
I've seen girls that are so beautiful.
They're too dangerous to get close, but that's what make them so irresistibly attractive. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
是的，致命女人！
我见过非常美丽的女孩。
她们太危险了，让人不敢靠近，但正是这种危险让她们具有不可抗拒的吸引力。你明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text: It's... Hard to say.
scripts.translation: 这...很难说。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Have you explored the area over the bridge at the right side of the united expedition camp?
Then you know the area is so cold that it'll instantly freeze your heart.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
你探索过联合远征营右侧桥上的区域了吗？
那么你知道那里冷得能瞬间冻结你的心脏。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
You should go across the leftward bridge, you'll be surprised to see what's ahead of you.
It's yet to be known how such a thing can happen.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
你应该走过左边的桥，你会惊讶地看到前面有什么。
目前还不知晓这样的事是如何发生的。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Well...
I suppose I don't have the words to really describe such an amazing scene.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
嗯...
我想我找不到合适的词语来描述如此美妙的景象。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'll send a message to the garrison for you. Why don't you go see it with your own eyes? You won't be disappointed!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
我会给你发一条消息给加里森。你何不亲眼去看看？你不会失望的！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Of course, I'm offering such an extraordinary service because there's something I want in return. Ahahaha!
...Truth be told, I'm having some trouble. And I need someone to help me.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
当然，我提供如此非凡的服务，是因为我想要回报。啊哈哈！
...说实话，我遇到了一些麻烦。我需要有人帮我。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
现在，你应该走过左边的桥。和那里的卫兵对话，然后直接过去。
一群美丽的女孩会欢迎你。我希望你能享受与她们的对话。也许你会理解自然的奥秘。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Yes, I only need... ^3131FF30^000000 of them.

[Botanist]
Welcome back! How was it?
It was amazing, wasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
欢迎回来！感觉如何？
很惊人，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
On the right side of this united expedition camp,
we have a land surrounded by roaring blizzards.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
在这个联合远征营的右侧，
有一片被呼啸暴风雪包围的土地。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
And on the other side,
we have a peaceful green land
where we can enjoy Mother Nature's warm embrace.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
而在另一边，
有一片宁静的绿色土地，
我们可以享受母亲大自然的温暖怀抱。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Two completely different worlds coexist
within a short distance of each other.
Where else can you see such amazing contrasts at a glance?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
两个截然不同的世界
在很短的距离内共存。
还有哪里能一眼看到如此惊人的对比？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'm curious to know all secrets about this world.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
我很好奇，想要了解这个世界的
所有秘密。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'm so excited that I can't hide it!
*Pant Pant*
*Pant Pant*
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
我太兴奋了，根本藏不住！
*呼哧呼哧*
*呼哧呼哧*

scripts.text: What a mysterious world this is!
scripts.translation: 真是个神秘的世界啊！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Yes, it is...
Oh, right!
Actually I'm here to study this strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
是的，确实如此...
啊，对了！
其实我来到这里，是为了研究
这种奇怪的现象。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
To understand the environmental conditions,
including temperature and humidity,
5.....and check the families and growth of plants,
I've installed several special environmental meters
in this area.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
为了了解包括温度和湿度在内的
环境状况，
5.....并检查植物的科属和生长情况，
我在这个区域安装了
几台特殊的环境监测仪。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Unfortunately, some evil monsters
keep destroying the precious meters
with their ^3131FFHeinous Hoops^000000!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
不幸的是，一些邪恶的魔物
一直用它们^3131FF邪恶的环^000000
破坏着珍贵的监测仪！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
The culprits are called Cornus.
I'd like to ask you to teach them not to destroy my devices again.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
罪魁祸首是飞马。
我想请你教训它们一下，
让它们别再破坏我的设备了。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
How'd you like to hunt ^3131FF10 of them^000000 to set an example? Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
你愿意猎杀^3131FF10只^000000给它们
立个榜样吗？祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
现在，你应该走过左边的桥。和那里的卫兵对话，然后直接过去。
一群美丽的女孩会欢迎你。我希望你能享受与她们的对话。也许你会理解自然的奥秘。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Hopefully the Cornuses have learned their lesson, and won't touch my special environmental meters anymore.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
希望飞马们已经吸取了教训，
不会再碰我的特殊环境监测仪了。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh Karyl, while you were away, I received an interesting report from one of my research machines that remained intact.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦，卡里尔，趁你不在的时候，
我收到了一份有趣报告，
来自一台幸存的研究机器。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
According to the report, The original weather condition of Ash Vacuum is cold and dry, just like the land on the right side.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
根据报告，阿什真空的原始天气状况
是寒冷干燥的，
就像右侧的土地一样。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
That means, somebody has artificially cultivated the leftward land.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
这意味着，有人人工培育了
左侧的土地。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Do you remember seeing strange mushroom shaped buildings everywhere in the fields?
I suspect it to be an environmental purifier that converts barren land into lush, green fields.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
你还记得在田野里随处可见的
那些奇怪的蘑菇状建筑吗？
我怀疑那是一种环境净化器，
能将贫瘠的土地转化为郁郁葱葱的绿色田野。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Let me show you.
Please take this rotting plant stem,
I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
让我给你看看。
请拿着这根腐烂的植物茎，
我会在另一边，紧挨着左侧桥梁的
环境净化器那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Cornuses are breaking my special environmental meters!
Please show them the power of Midgardians!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
飞马正在破坏我的特殊环境监测仪！
请向它们展示米德加尔特人的力量！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
我会在另一边，紧挨着左侧桥梁的
环境净化器那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
I submitted a report to upper management.
I haven't received any response, but I'm sure they'll be as excited as I am once they read the report. Woohoo!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
我向高层提交了报告。
虽然还没收到回复，但我相信
他们读了报告后，会和我一样兴奋的。耶！

scripts.text:
[Camp Guard]
Stop!
You're about to enter an area that has not been fully explored.
Only personnel--researchers and explorers--authorized by United Midgard and the garrison are allowed to enter the danger zone.
scripts.translation:
[营地卫兵]
站住！
你即将进入一个尚未完全探索的区域。
只有获得联合米德加尔特和驻军授权的
人员——研究员和探险家——
才能进入危险区域。

scripts.text: I want to enter the next area.
scripts.translation: 我想进入下一个区域。

scripts.text: I want to stay.
scripts.translation: 我想留下来。

scripts.text:
[Camp Guard]
Please be careful out there.
If you encounter any threats or strange phenomenon, then please don't hesitate to report to us at the garrison.
scripts.translation:
[营地卫兵]
请在外面的时候小心。
如果遇到任何威胁或异常现象，
请随时向驻军报告。

scripts.text:
[Camp Guard]
No, you can't. Please return to the expedition camp.
scripts.translation:
[营地卫兵]
不，你不能进去。
请回到探险营地。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
This is it.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
就是这里了。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Look.
You can tell the pileus is creating drops of light which drip to the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
看。
你可以看到菌盖正在产生光滴，滴落到地面上。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
请尝试将腐烂的茎种植在地里。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
请尝试将腐烂的茎种植在地里。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
请尝试将腐烂的茎种植在地里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's sprouted! That shoot looks healthy!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
发芽了！那株嫩芽看起来很健康！

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
See?
This giant mushroom, otherwise known as an Environmental Purifier, not only brings dying plants back to life, but also stimulates their growth.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
看到了吗？
这种巨大的蘑菇，也被称为环境净化器，
不仅能起死回生，还能促进植物生长。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Isn't it amazing?!
This finding will surely stir up the academic world.
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
是不是很神奇？！
这一发现肯定会轰动学术界。

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Now, I should get back to work. I need to write a report based on my study results.
I can't wait to see how the expedition management will react to my report. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
好了，我该回去工作了。我需要基于研究结果写一份报告。
真期待看到探险管理方对我的报告会有什么反应。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
Oh, right... Rumis!
Can you please tell him that I've received his Nepenthes specimen safely?
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
哦，对了...鲁米斯！
能请你告诉他，我已经安全收到了他的猪笼草标本吗？

scripts.text:
[Botanist]
And don't forget to tell him that I've produced great research results. That'll make him cry like a baby. Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[植物学家]
别忘了告诉他，我取得了很棒的研究成果。那会让他感动得像个婴儿一样哭的。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: - You dug a hole into the ground, planted the rotting stem, and then watered it. -
scripts.translation: - 你在地上挖了个洞，种下腐烂的茎，然后浇了水。 -

scripts.text:
- Pzzzz -
- Ssshuhhhh -
scripts.translation:
- 噗滋滋 -
- 嘶嘶呼 -

scripts.text: - Something is growing out of the dirt. -
scripts.translation: - 有什么东西从土里长出来了。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
This is it! Come to the small tree in the southeast direction!
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
就是这里！来东南方向的那棵小树旁！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Knock, knock. Are you here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咚咚。你在上面吗？

scripts.text: - Something is making loud noise near the top of the tree. -
scripts.translation: - 树顶附近有什么东西发出了很大的声响。 -

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...Oh, yes. Yes!
Monsters were looking at me, so I climbed up this tree without even thinking!
How can I get down now?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...哦，是的。是的！
魔物在看我，所以我没想就爬上了这棵树！
现在我怎么下去啊？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh wait, I can see everything so clearly from here.
I guess staying here will be much safer and easier for studying monsters.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
啊，等等，从这里看得真清楚。
我想待在这里观察魔物会安全又方便得多。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...I'm looking at Hillsrion, the creature that people are talking about.
It's covered with soft fur that reminds me of soft ice flakes floating in the air.
...Oh, sorry.. I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...我正在看着希尔里昂，就是人们口中谈论的那种生物。
它身上覆盖着柔软的毛发，让我想起空气中飘浮的柔软冰晶。
...啊，抱歉...我刚才只是在自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'll be watching the Hillsrions from this tree. {0}, can you please go collect ^3131FFHillsrion Horns^000000 for me?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我会在这棵树上观察希尔里昂。{0}，能麻烦你帮我收集一些^3131FF希尔里昂的角^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Their horns might possess a special power. And I want to have them for further research.
...5 horns will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
它们的角可能拥有特殊的力量。我想收集一些用于进一步研究。
...5个就够了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I'd like to study Hillsrion's Horns. Please bring 5 of them for me, okay.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我想研究希尔里昂的角。请帮我带5个过来，好吗。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...*Shiver*...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
...*颤抖*...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...

[Rumis Block]
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...
...*Shiver*...

[Rumis Block]
Ah! You're back!
Phew...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
啊！你回来了！
呼...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Are you okay? Their fangs look so sharp and shiny...
Oh right, you're an expert when it comes to this kind of job. Hahaha, I don't have to worry about you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你没事吧？它们的牙齿看起来好锋利、好闪亮...
对了，你是这方面的专家。哈哈，我不必再为你担心了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Have you brought Hillsrion's Horns?
Those are the horns in your hands?
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
你带希尔里昂的角回来了吗？
就是你手里拿着的那些角？

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Oh...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
哦...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Ho...
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Well, they appear to be ordinary horns with a spiral pattern.
Monsters with such horns are a dime a dozen in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
嗯，它们看起来像是带有螺旋纹路的普通角。
在米德加尔特，长着这种角的魔物随处可见。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
I, however, still have no idea how Hillsrions use their horns.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
不过，我仍然不知道希尔里昂是如何使用它们的角的。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
If they have bad vision, they could use the horns as feelers, or... I know you don't want to hear me ramble on with my conjecture. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
如果它们的视力不好，可能会把角当作触角来用，或者...我知道你不想听我瞎猜。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
We can call it a day for today. Thanks to you, I now feel confident enough to at least come to this tree by myself next time.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
今天我们就到此为止吧。多亏了你，我现在有信心下次至少能独自来到这棵树下了。

scripts.text:
[Rumis Block]
Let's go back to the camp. Shall we? I have something to discuss with you.
scripts.translation:
[鲁米斯·布洛克]
我们回营地吧。好吗？我有件事想和你商量。

scripts.text:
You find a little creature flying in the bushes.
It has tiny wings on the back...
It's a fairy!
scripts.translation:
你在灌木丛中发现了一只飞舞的小生物。
它的背上长着小小的翅膀...
这是一只妖精！

scripts.text:
[Small Fairy]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!
scripts.translation:
[小妖精]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!

scripts.text:
The fairy notices you, and looks very surprised.
It is saying something, but you don't understand.
scripts.translation:
小妖精注意到了你，看起来非常惊讶。
它正在说着什么，但你听不懂。

scripts.text:
You should report this to the united expedition quickly.
Perhaps the guard captain of the expedition is the right person to report to.
scripts.translation:
你应该尽快向联合远征队报告这件事。
也许远征队的卫兵队长是合适的汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Small Fairy]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!
scripts.translation:
[小妖精]
RLGHLRXLA TKANTLFDMS
WJACK TNAHRDNJSDMFH
WLSGHKWND !!

scripts.text: The surprised fairy is saying something to you, but you cannot understand fairy language.
scripts.translation: 惊讶的小妖精正在对你说着什么，但你听不懂妖精语。

scripts.text:
[Small Fairy]
Who are you?! Are you looking for the Sapha!?
scripts.translation:
[小妖精]
你是谁？！你在找萨法吗？！

scripts.text:
You have found something moving between dry branches.
It appears to be a tree at first glance, but it turns out to be a giant that is half tree and half man.
scripts.translation:
你在枯枝间发现了一个移动的东西。
乍看之下像是一棵树，但仔细看却是一个半树半人的巨人。

scripts.text:
[Tree Giant]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..
scripts.translation:
[树巨人]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..

scripts.text:
The giant notices you, and looks very surprised.
It is saying something, but you don't understand.
scripts.translation:
巨人注意到了你，看起来非常惊讶。
它正在说着什么，但你听不懂。

scripts.text:
You should report this to the united expedition quickly.
Perhaps the guard captain of the expedition is the right person to report to.
scripts.translation:
你应该尽快向联合远征队报告这件事。
也许远征队的卫兵队长是合适的汇报对象。

scripts.text:
[Tree Giant]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..
scripts.translation:
[树巨人]
TJDTMFJDNS CJFDI
TKADLFDMF QKATOS
EKDTLSDML DLFMADMS..

scripts.text: The surprised giant is saying something to you, but you cannot understand.
scripts.translation: 惊讶的巨人正在对你说着什么，但你听不懂。

scripts.text:
[Tree Giant]
Where are the Laphine reinforcements? I might have a problem.
scripts.translation:
[树巨人]
拉斐恩的增援部队在哪里？我可能要遇到麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Captain]
Good day. I'm here to protect the
peace and safety of explorers
working for United Midgard.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[船长]
你好。我负责保护为联合米德加尔特工作的探险者的和平与安全。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, nothing.
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，没什么。
抱歉打扰你了。

scripts.text: - You report your encounter with a small fairy in the Splandid area to the guard captain. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卫兵队长报告了在Splandid区域遇到小妖精的情况。 -

scripts.text:
[Captain]
That sounds very important.
It's too early to say this, but we might have to dispatch an investigation group to the area.
scripts.translation:
[船长]
这听起来非常重要。
现在说还太早，但我们可能不得不派遣调查组前往该区域。

scripts.text:
[Captain]
I'll discuss this more with the expedition management.
Thank you for your valuable information.
scripts.translation:
[船长]
我会和远征队管理层进一步讨论此事。
感谢你的宝贵信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, nothing.
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，没什么。
抱歉打扰你了。

scripts.text: - You report your encounter with a tree giant in the Manuk area to the guard captain. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卫兵队长报告了在Manuk区域遇到树巨人的情况。 -

scripts.text:
[Captain]
That sounds very important.
It's too early to say this, but we might have to dispatch an investigation group to the area.
scripts.translation:
[船长]
这听起来非常重要。
现在说还太早，但我们可能不得不派遣调查组前往该区域。

scripts.text:
[Captain]
I'll discuss this more with the expedition management.
Thank you for your valuable information.
scripts.translation:
[船长]
我会和远征队管理层进一步讨论此事。
感谢你的宝贵信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, nothing.
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，没什么。
抱歉打扰你了。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
你怎么带了这么多东西？
你是在进行训练什么的吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Hmmmm...mmm...
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
嗯...唔...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh! Hello there!
You must be the adventurer from Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
哦！你好！
你一定是来自米德加尔特的那位冒险者吧。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
We've come all the way here to keep track of Satan Morocc, but... Now it seems that's not our priority anymore... Tsk,tsk...
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
我们大老远来到这里是为了追踪魔王梦罗克，但...现在看来那已经不是我们的首要任务了...啧，啧...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Well, since our research group has been gathered in such haste, many of our members collide too often.
I think it's just the process of trial and error, but this really slows things down.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
既然我们的研究小组是匆忙集合起来的，成员之间经常发生碰撞。
我想这只是试错的过程，但这确实拖慢了进度。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Alas, the head office keeps pushing me to submit a report... As if I could perform miracles!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
唉，总部一直催我提交报告...
我又不是会魔法，哪能凭空变出来啊！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
I can't go around and meet those people myself, mediate among troubled people... This is impossible!! Unless...Unless someone helps me with that ! I need... someone...
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
我没法亲自去见那些人，也没法去调解那些麻烦事...
这根本做不到！！除非...除非有人能帮我处理一下！我需要...有人...

scripts.text:
- He stared at you -
- with sparkling -
- eyes as if he were -
- demanding for help! -
scripts.translation:
- 他盯着你 -
- 眼神闪烁 -
- 仿佛在 -
- 急切地请求帮助！ -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Eh?! Oh, my... You really shouldn't. You must be extremely busy tracking down Satan Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
诶？！哎呀...你千万别这样。
你肯定正忙着追踪魔王梦罗克吧！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
But... if you say so, could I really use your help? Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
但是...既然你都这么说了，我真的可以拜托你帮忙吗？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
最近那些研究员抱怨得特别多。他们压力很大，我觉得真的应该有人听听他们的烦恼。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Especially those dealing with document files that argue with each other so many times! You might wanna start by talking to them.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
尤其是那些处理卷宗夹的研究员，他们总是互相争吵！你可能得先从跟他们聊聊开始。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Sounds good, huh? Please, you should go now.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
听起来不错，对吧？请，你现在就出发吧。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
最近那些研究员抱怨得特别多。他们压力很大，我觉得真的应该有人听听他们的烦恼。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Especially those dealing with document files that argue with each other so many times! You might wanna start by talking to them.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
尤其是那些处理卷宗夹的研究员，他们总是互相争吵！你可能得先从跟他们聊聊开始。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
And, don't worry! I'm even willing to share my snacks with you if things go well. I'm not asking this for free, you got that~?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
还有，别担心！如果事情顺利的话，我甚至愿意把我的零食分给你。我可不是白求你帮忙的，懂吗~？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Aha!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
啊哈！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Isn't that an invitation to the meeting?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
这不是会议的邀请函吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
And...and I really get to sign this thing and approve it...? Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
而且...而且我真的可以签署并批准这份文件...？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
This, this means I need to get prepared for the meeting! Finally!
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
这意味着我需要为会议做准备！终于！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh, by the way, did you get a rough idea of the atmosphere of this expedition?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
哦，对了，你对这次远征的氛围有大概的了解吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Normally, researchers just take their own instruments and find their own tracks of Satan Morocc.
They don't really need to cooperate with other members.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
通常，研究员们只是带着自己的仪器，独自寻找魔王梦罗克的踪迹。
他们其实不需要与其他成员合作。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Howerver, things get different when it comes to document files.
Those researchers in charge of document files must contact eachother for information, and this just makes for endless work.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
然而，涉及到卷宗夹时情况就不同了。
负责卷宗夹的研究员必须互相联系以获取信息，这只会带来无穷无尽的工作。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
People can't always be perfect, so they stress out and get to arguing...
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
人不可能总是完美的，所以他们会感到压力，进而发生争吵...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So... Could you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
那么...能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
As you've heard, about the 3 researchers, they don't agree with eachother too often. It's just too obvious that their meeting will turn out a disaster, and the whole research group could break down!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
正如你所听到的，关于那三位研究员，他们经常意见不合。很明显，他们的会议会变成一场灾难，整个研究小组都可能因此崩溃！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh, just thinking about it scares the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
光是想想就让我吓得要命。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
What I'm asking is that you participate in the meeting with them and help them negotiate.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
我请求你参加与他们的会议，并协助他们进行谈判。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So, first! Can you go meet those 3 researchers and check on them to prepare for the meeting?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
那么，首先！你能去见见那三位研究员，确认一下他们的情况，为会议做准备吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
情况如何？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Did you talk to those researchers in charge of document files?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
你和负责卷宗夹的那些研究员谈过了吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Please, you should participate in the meeting and mediate them if anything goes wrong!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
拜托了，你应该参加会议，如果发生任何意外，请出面调解！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
First, you should go meet those 3 researchers and check on them to prepare for the meeting. Hope they're not preparing any weapons though...
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
首先，你应该去见见那三位研究员，确认一下他们的情况，为会议做准备。希望他们没在准备什么武器...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ohhh, you came! How generous of you!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
哦，你来了！真是大恩大德！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
The meeting's about to begin.
Whew... I think I'm too tense... My chest hurts... Aaaah.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
会议马上就要开始了。
呼...我觉得我太紧张了...胸口好痛...啊。

scripts.text:
- Somebody's knocking -
- on the door... -
scripts.translation:
- 有人在敲门 -
- ... -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Finally, the meeting's starting.
You should come in.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
终于，会议要开始了。
请进。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So, everyone's here.
Let us begin our meeting.
First, I need to hear the report on the process of tracking Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
那么，大家都到齐了。
让我们开始会议吧。
首先，我需要听取关于追踪魔王梦罗克进程的汇报。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Alright. I'm Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts. We're certain that Satan Morocc came to this place through the crack of dimension, however, we failed to find any traces within the area we inspected.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好的。我是来自卢恩·米德加兹的Ryosen。我们确信魔王梦罗克是通过维度裂缝来到这里的，然而，我们在检查区域内未能找到任何踪迹。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
The Tripartite Union is doing whatever it takes to track down Satan Morocc's whereabouts, but the research in Ash-Vacuum is very limited.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
三方联盟正在竭尽全力追踪魔王梦罗克的下落，但在阿什-真空的研究非常有限。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Supplies, reinforcements as wel as demanded goods are all insufficient, so we can't really go on.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
物资、增援以及所需物品都不足，所以我们真的无法继续。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I've heard the assassins took action in order to find the traces of Satan Morocc, but nothing's been reported so far.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我听说刺客们为了寻找魔王梦罗克的踪迹采取了行动，但到目前为止还没有任何报告。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm Hue from the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我是来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的休。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
We're still researching on the crack of dimension that Satan Morocc has come through, and the false data research on the noise created when moving through the crack is currently being corrected.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我们仍在研究魔王梦罗克穿过的维度裂缝，关于穿越裂缝时产生的噪音的虚假数据研究目前正在修正中。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
The real cause of this problem has yet to be found, which makes it hard for us to provide any reinforcements or other supplies.
scripts.translation:
[休]
这个问题的真正原因尚未找到，这使得我们很难提供增援或其他物资。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ok. I see. How's it going with the research on Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
好的。我明白了。阿什-真空的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hi, I'm Hansenne from Arunafeltz. We have conclused that his world of Ash-Vacuum is nothing related to the continent of Midgard, as it is placed in a totally indipendent world dimension.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你好，我是来自阿鲁纳菲兹的汉森娜。我们已经得出结论，阿什-真空所在的世界与米德加尔特大陆毫无关联，因为它位于一个完全独立的维度世界中。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
The environment of the fields on the East and West where we can work on the research has nothing in common with the environment within the boundrary of the Tripartite Union's army post.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我们可以在东西两侧的研究区域开展工作，那里的环境与三方联盟军哨所边界内的环境完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I also have been reported that the ecosystem in the researched are is different.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我还收到报告称，研究区域的生态系统也有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
We could not go further with the research on the ecosystem due to some violent living creatures which have never been found on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
由于出现了一些在米德加尔特大陆从未发现过的凶猛生物，我们无法进一步研究那里的生态系统。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
So... All in all, nothing has been clearly found. Any problems among the members of the United Research Group?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
所以...总而言之，目前还没有明确的发现。联合研究组的成员之间有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: - The room is in awkward silence for a short while... -
scripts.translation: - 房间里陷入了短暂的尴尬沉默... -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ha..... Hahahaha...
... Then, anything you need to request, or suggest, perhaps? Anything you want to complain about?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
哈...哈哈哈哈哈...
...那么，有什么需要申请或建议的吗？或者有什么想抱怨的？

scripts.text:
- Ryosen, who was fidgeting with -
- his files, suddenly stops and -
- studies the others. Then, he takes -
- out something from the bottom of -
- the chair and puts it on the table. -
scripts.translation:
- Ryosen原本在摆弄文件，突然停了下来，
- 审视着其他人。然后，他从椅子底下
- 拿出一样东西，放在了桌子上。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I'm.... I... The document file...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我...我...那份文件...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Aaaaaahahhhhhhhhhhcckk!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

scripts.text:
- Hue, shocked by the sudden
scream, stands up frantically and
accidentally hits and drops the
object which Ryosen had taken out. -
scripts.translation:
- 休被突如其来的尖叫声吓到，慌乱地站起身，
- 不小心撞到了Ryosen拿出来的东西，
- 导致它掉在了地上。 -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Kkkkhaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!!
It's the Thief Bug!!!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
咯咯咯咯咯咯咯咯！！！！
是浮勒盗虫！！！

scripts.text:
- As the Official screamed, all the
researchers of the union started to
scream as well, and rushed out of
the room. -
scripts.translation:
- 随着官员的尖叫，联合研究组的所有
- 研究员也开始尖叫，并冲出了房间。 -

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Hhmm, hmmmm...
I really don't know what to say.
I mean... I'm totally OK with other monsters, mutants or whatever, but that black evil thing... Oh, I can't stand that one...
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
嗯...嗯嗯...
我真的不知道该说什么了。
我是说...其他魔物、变异体之类的我都无所谓，但那个黑色的邪恶生物...哦，我受不了那个...

scripts.text:
- Knock, knock-
- The researchers come back into the room. -
scripts.translation:
- 咚咚咚-
- 研究员们回到了房间。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Uh-hmm! Sorry about the mess.
I... Something urgent came up...
............Aaaaaaaaahhhhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗯哼！抱歉弄得一团糟。
我...有急事要处理...
............啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Whhhhhhaaattt!!!! What is it!!?
The Thief Bug, Again!!!???
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
什...什么！！那是什么！！？
又是浮勒盗虫！！！？？

scripts.text: - Except for Ryosen, the rest spring out of their seats and run hurriedly for the door. -
scripts.translation: - 除了Ryosen，其余人都从座位上弹起，慌忙冲向门口。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
My... my strawberry cake!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我...我的草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text: - Ryosen picks up his strawberry cake, all squashed with some fingerprints. -
scripts.translation: - Ryosen捡起他的草莓蛋糕，上面全是被压扁的指纹。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Stop! Freeze, everyone!
Move one more time and you'll be considered guilty!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
住手！都给我站住！
再动一下，我就当你们有罪了！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This cake was just fine before that evil thing appeared, and there were only 4 of us here!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
在那邪恶的东西出现之前，这块蛋糕还好好的，而且这里只有我们4个人！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
One of you must be guilty of ruining my Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你们之中肯定有人毁了我的卢恩·米德加兹草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I can't help checking your hands! This must be a fingerprint! It's loud and clear!! Hmm, I bet this is the mark of an index finger!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不得不检查你们的手！这一定是指纹！非常清晰！！嗯，我猜这是食指的痕迹！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Wait a minute! Wait! Stop treating us like criminals! What is wrong with you, it's only a cake!? Don't you think you're going a little too far?
scripts.translation:
[Hue]
等一下！等等！别把我们当罪犯一样对待！你疯了吗，只是一块蛋糕而已！你不觉得有点过分了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Whatttttt!? Only a cake????
Aha, yeah, I just remembered. You people from Schwarzwald don't ever appreciate food at all, right?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
什...什么？？只是一块蛋糕？？？
啊哈，我想起来了。你们修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的人从来都不懂得欣赏食物，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Especially when the food is NOT yours, huh? That's why you people sneak a taste of other people's food like my strawberry cake!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
尤其是当食物不是你们自己的时候，对吧？所以你们才会偷偷尝别人的食物，比如我的草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hmm, are you talking about Dusty?
He was expelled right after the incident and his job was taken away! I told you several times already!
scripts.translation:
[Hue]
嗯，你是在说Dusty吗？
他在事件发生后立刻被开除了，工作也被收回了！我已经跟你说过好几次了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ugh... You guys, I think you should calm down... This is ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
唉...你们，我觉得你们应该冷静一下...这太荒唐了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ughhhhh! It was I who did that!!!
scripts.translation:
[Hansenne]
唉...是我干的！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Sorry, I was just too shocked by that thief bug and accidentally touched your cake with my finger!
scripts.translation:
[Hansenne]
抱歉，我被那只浮勒盗虫吓到了，不小心用手指碰到了你的蛋糕！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Huh? No. Wait...

[Ryosen]
You again?!
I can't belive how careless you are all the time, like with the requested data and all!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
又是你？！
我真不敢相信你总是这么粗心，就像对待那些要求的数据一样！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ah, I forgot to say thank you.
Hue, thank you so much for restoring my documents!!!
Thanks!!!
Ahahahahaha. Hahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[Hansenne]
啊，我忘了说谢谢。
Hue，非常感谢你帮我恢复了文件！！！
谢谢！！！
哈哈哈哈哈。哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
No, I...
scripts.translation:
[Hue]
不，我...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hey, stay on topic!!
You are...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嘿，回到正题！！
你是...

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ahhhhhh! I guess we should call it a day now! Thanks for comingm all of you. Ok, let's go. Dismissed!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
啊...我想我们今天到此为止吧！感谢大家前来。好了，走吧。解散！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Come on!!!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
快一点！！！

scripts.text: -The three researchers say nothing. They just stare at each other, standing still... Then they finally leave the room. -
scripts.translation: -三位研究员一言不发。他们只是互相凝视着，僵在原地... 最后终于离开了房间。-

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Ugh, I've got nothing to say.
All I wanted was to let those people be closter to each other, become more friendly. But, problems come up every single time.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
唉，我无话可说。
我只是想让那些人彼此亲近一些，变得更友好。但每次都会出问题。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Can you think of any idea how to get those people to get along??
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
你能想到什么办法让他们和睦相处吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Actually... Hansenne is not the one who ruined that cake.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
... 其实... 弄坏蛋糕的不是汉森娜。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Eh? What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
诶？你说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But... I don't understand why Hansenne would take the blame...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是... 我不明白汉森娜为什么要替人背黑锅...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Well, I should go now.

[United Research Official]
What? Ah, adventurer?!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
什么？啊，是冒险者！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Actually... Hansenne is not the one who ruined that cake.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
... 其实... 弄坏蛋糕的不是汉森娜。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Eh? What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
诶？你说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But... I don't understand why Hansenne would take the blame...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是... 我不明白汉森娜为什么要替人背黑锅...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Well, I should go now.

[United Research Official]
What? Ah, adventurer?!
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
什么？啊，是冒险者！

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How are they?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
他们怎么样了？

scripts.text: - You tell the Official about the conversation that the 3 researchers had, in detail. -
scripts.translation: -你向官员详细讲述了三位研究员之间的对话。-

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Whew, I see.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
呼，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Maybe I've been a little too worried.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
也许是我太担心了。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
How often they collide, it must be a natural thing for people from different countries with different personalities and customs.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
他们经常发生冲突，对于来自不同国家、拥有不同个性和习俗的人来说，这也许是件很自然的事。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Thank you for helping me.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
谢谢你帮了我。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Here, I'll offer you a cup of tea.
This is a really special drink I preserved. Please, drink it while it's nice and hot.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
来，请喝杯茶。
这是我珍藏的一款特制饮品。趁热喝吧。

scripts.text: - You feel so refreshed and light, as you drink the tea that the Official offered. -
scripts.translation: -喝着官员提供的茶，你感到神清气爽，浑身轻松。-

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Now, I should get to work on the report I need to submit to the head office. Ah, and this is nothing big, but still... This might come in handy when you travel.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
现在，我得去写要提交给总部的报告了。啊，虽然不是什么大事，但... 这个在你旅行时可能会用得上。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Please, stop by and say hellp to us from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
请偶尔来拜访我们，打个招呼。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Thank you for everything.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
感谢你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Please, stop by and say hellp to us from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
请偶尔来拜访我们，打个招呼。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Oh, I'm not asking you to keep your eye on those 3 researchers. Don't get me wrong, hahaha.~
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
哦，我可不是让你去盯着那三位研究员。别误会，哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
...Mmmm? What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
...嗯？你找我有事吗？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
I wouldn't be roaming around this place like that, if I were you.
It's very dangerous here, and people dwelling is this place are not that nice.
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
如果是我的话，不会像这样四处游荡的。
这里非常危险，而且住在这里的人也不怎么友善。

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
Hmm? What did you just say?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
嗯？你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[United Research Official]
I can't really hear you. Could you speak louder?
scripts.translation:
[联合研究官员]
我听得不太清楚。能大声点说吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你怎么带了这么多东西？
难道是在进行什么训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, keep your hands off my stuff!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
请别碰我的东西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, keep your hands off my stuff!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
请别碰我的东西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ugh! My, my... What am I gonna do with this!? Files, files, files!!!
Ahhhhhkk!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊！天哪...我该怎么办！？文件，文件，全是文件！！！
啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What time is it now? Ugh... This is such a mess!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
现在几点了？啊...真是乱成一团！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What are they thinking!!? I don't get it. How come I have to work, while those guys from other countries are just praying for a breakthrough, every single day!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
他们在想什么！！？我不明白。为什么我要在这里工作，而其他国家的人每天都在祈祷突破极限！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This is so unfair!! My stress is growing geometrically every hour!
What a waste of time! Why do they have to pray! Why?! Why?! Why don't they work instead of pray!!
Ugh...!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
这太不公平了！！我的压力每小时都在几何级数地增长！
真是浪费时间！他们为什么要祈祷！为什么？！为什么？！他们为什么不工作而去祈祷！！
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Nothing's appreciated! Nothing!
They're just so useless!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
没有任何人感激我！什么都没有！
他们简直一无是处！

scripts.text:
- He took a deep breath -
- trying to calm down. -
scripts.translation:
- 他深吸了一口气 -
- 试图让自己冷静下来。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Anyway, who are you? This place is restricted.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
总之，你是谁？这里是限制区域。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah! You must be the one who came to help us track down that Satan Morocc, the bastard who made the giant hole and then was gone like the wind.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊！你一定是来帮我们追踪那个魔王梦罗克的人，那个挖了个大洞就消失得无影无踪的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ugh. I should watch my mouth.
Sorry. You're on our side. I should just be polite, but it's just... I'm so stressed out.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊。我该注意自己的言辞。
抱歉。你是我们这边的人。我应该礼貌一点，只是...我太有压力了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How about having some tea here?
It's Rafflesia tea from Schwarzwald. Don't even expect taste, it's awful... But what can I do? It's the only thing I've got...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
要不要在这里喝点茶？
这是来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的草精茶。别指望有什么好味道，很难喝...但我能怎么办呢？这是唯一有的东西...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You must have heard about this, but this is the place where Satan Morocc landed through the crack of dimension.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你应该听说过这件事，这里是魔王梦罗克通过维度裂缝降落的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
As you see, this seems like a totally different world. It's nothing like the continent of Midgard, though we haven't found any concrete evidence. We decided to call this place Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如你所见，这里看起来完全像另一个世界。它和米德加尔特大陆完全不同，尽管我们还没有找到确凿的证据。我们决定把这个地方称为阿什-真空。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
We're doing everything we can, to track down Satan Morocc, but all those researchers from different countries couldn't help but wonder what this place really is.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我们正在竭尽全力追踪魔王梦罗克，但来自不同国家的研究员们不禁开始怀疑，这个地方究竟是什么。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Well, so we're all interested in one thing. However, the real problem lies on our structure of the group.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗯，我们都对同一件事感兴趣。然而，真正的问题在于我们团队的架构。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Three different countries united to take down the comon enemy, Satan Morocc, byt they eventually started to gather and keep the information to themselves.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
三个不同的国家联合起来共同对抗敌人魔王梦罗克，但最终他们开始各自为政，将信息据为己有。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
So... frankly speaking...
Tracking Satan Morocc is not or major concern anymore. Our expedition was formed in such hase that so may things can cause problems in this group.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
所以...坦白说...
追踪魔王梦罗克已经不再是我们的主要关注点了。我们的远征队组建得如此仓促，导致团队内部许多事情都可能引发问题。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
People don't believe other members of the group except for the ones from their own countries. They're all so sensitive that every little thing hits a nerve.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
除了本国成员外，人们并不信任团队中的其他成员。他们都非常敏感，任何小事都会触动他们的神经。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But what can we do? After all, we were gathered to achieve the same goal, and we researchers don't want to cause any trouble among countries. It's really hard for us to live with our complaints.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
但我们能怎么办呢？毕竟，我们聚集在一起是为了实现同一个目标，而且我们研究人员不想在国家之间制造麻烦。带着这些抱怨生活真的很难。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I mean... the situation here is... just like the taste of this tea.
Just awful!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我的意思是...这里的情况...就像这茶的味道一样。
糟透了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, I spent too much time talking.
I should be working now!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
噢，我花了太多时间在闲聊上。
我现在应该去工作了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Look at this pile of document files... We're supposed to share all the information within these documents...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
看看这堆卷宗夹...我们本应该共享这些文件中的所有信息...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, well... Maybe the same thing's happening at other offices. People from other countries might have hidden some important information behind my back.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
噢，算了...也许其他办公室也在发生同样的事。来自其他国家的人可能在我背后隐瞒了一些重要信息。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Whatever... Could you deliver this document to the Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz researchers?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
无论如何...你能把这份文件送到修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德和阿鲁纳菲兹的研究员那里吗？

scripts.text: Why me?
scripts.translation: 为什么是我？

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
... Eh? Didn't you come to help us?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...咦？你不是来帮我们的吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Whew~ Very good.
No one in our research group wants to visit the offices of the other countries!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
呼~ 很好。
我们研究组里没人想去其他国家的办公室！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ok, now, please deliver the file to Hue and Hansenne. Hue's in charge of Schwarzwald's documents and Hansenne's in chare of Arunafeltz's.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好的，现在，请把文件交给休和汉森娜。休负责修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的文件，汉森娜负责阿鲁纳菲兹的文件。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
The file contains the brief introduction and the schedule of the meesting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
文件里包含了简要介绍和会议日程。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
For your information, you should go see Hue at the Schwarzwald's office first. Otherwise, he'll be whining about it.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
顺便告诉你，你应该先去修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的办公室找休。否则，他会一直抱怨的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You must check if they read and understand correctly after delivering it. Don't forget to get them to sign at the bottom of the page, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
送交文件后，你必须确认他们是否阅读并正确理解了内容。别忘了让他们在页面底部签字，以防万一。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Go on now.
Just so you know, today's Desert Day. Midgard is sending some desserts through the crack of dimension, regularly.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
去吧。
顺便告诉你，今天是甜点日。米德加尔特会定期通过维度裂缝送来一些甜点。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Midgard's desserts are definitely the world's best.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
米德加尔特的美食绝对是世界上最好的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
The only thing we enjoy here is that dessert we receive, once a week.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我们在这里唯一享受的，就是每周收到的那份甜点。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee is just awful. It tastes something like rusty steel.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典蛋糕简直糟糕透顶。吃起来就像生锈的钢铁。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Arunafeltz's Desert Sandwich is nothing better than that. I think that sandwich's made of some old meat, otherwise, we wouldn't have been food poisoned so often!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
阿鲁纳菲兹的沙漠三明治也好不到哪里去。我觉得那三明治是用陈年肉做的，不然我们怎么会经常食物中毒！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But, Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake! It's the best.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
但是，卢恩·米德加兹的草莓蛋糕！那是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Nice and soft spongecake covered with sweet-tasting whipped cream, lots of fresh strawberries on top!
Rune-Midgarts' top chef, Charles Orleans makes it himself!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
松软的海绵蛋糕，上面覆盖着甜美的鲜奶油，还有满满的新鲜草莓！
卢恩·米德加兹的首席厨师查尔斯·奥尔良亲自制作的!!!

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry, you must hurry up, or you won't be able to taste this wonderful cake!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快一点，你必须加快速度，否则就尝不到这块美妙的蛋糕了！

scripts.text:
- You got the Meeting -
- Invitation from Ryosen, -
- which briefly explains -
- the agenda and schedule -
- of the whole meeting! -
scripts.translation:
- 你获得了会议 -
- 来自Ryosen的邀请函， -
- 简要说明了 -
- 整个会议的议程和日程 -
- 安排！ -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry up and deliver the document to Hue and Hansenne!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快把文件送到休和汉森娜那里！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Don't forget! Schwarzwald's Hue must get it first, otherwise, he'll nag us like crazy.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
别忘了！必须先送到修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的休那里，否则他会像疯了一样唠叨我们。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
And you must get the document signed at the bottom before you bring it back.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
而且，在你带回来之前，必须让他们在底部签字。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry, you must hurry up or you won't be able to taste this wonderfull cake!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快一点，你必须加快速度，否则就尝不到这块美妙的蛋糕了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah, welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊，欢迎回来！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Must've been hard to get them all signed. Well done!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
让他们全部签字一定很不容易吧。干得好！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hue's so egotistic and stubborn. He thinks he's some kind of royale... and Hansenne... Whew~nobody ever gets what he's just talking about.
He's just ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
休太自恋又固执了。他觉得自己像是某种皇室... 还有汉森娜... 呼~没人知道他到底在说什么。
他真的很荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Thank you for dealing with those guys. I've got to go through the file now. Please give me the Invitation.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
谢谢你处理了那些家伙。我现在得审阅这份文件了。请给我邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please get Hue and Hansenne to sign the Inviation, then come back.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
请让休和汉森娜在邀请函上签字，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hurry, you must hurry up or you won't be able to taste this wonderfull cake!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
快一点，你必须加快速度，否则就尝不到这块美妙的蛋糕了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huhuhuhu, what a sight...!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
呼呼呼，真是好一番景象...！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This autograph here looks like Hue's. See, the letters are all so strongly pressed down with his anger. This one here should be Hansenne's, scrawled without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
这个签名看起来像是休的。看，字迹都被他的怒气重重地按下去了。这个应该是汉森娜的，写得毫无章法。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How was it? Did you have a chance t find out what the problem is among us researchers?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
怎么样？你有机会找出我们研究员之间的问题所在吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This isn't all because of the different personalities. Lots of other members have similar problems. Howerver, the problem among us three: Hue, Hansenne and I... is just more visible than others.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
这不仅仅是因为性格不同。很多其他成员也有类似的问题。然而，我们三个：休、汉森娜和我... 之间的问题比别人更明显。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
So, here we are. We are finally ordered to have a meeting and supposed to find the way to solve our problem.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
就这样，我们到了。我们终于被要求召开一次会议，并设法解决我们之间的问题。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But, do you know what really would be the best solution for us? It's to avoid meeting face to face.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
但是，你知道对我们来说最好的解决方案是什么吗？就是避免面对面见面。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
It wasn't our will to have this meeting, and I never imagined they'd sign this thing... Well, I just feel like I've been punched in the head or something.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
这次会议并不是我们的本意，我也从没想过他们会签署这份文件... 唉，我觉得自己像是被人狠狠揍了一拳。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Well, it's already spilled milk. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
算了，覆水难收。不管我喜不喜欢，我都得去参加那个会议。你能帮我把这个交给联合研究所的官员吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
In the meantime, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
在此期间，我得为会议做点准备。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
It wasn't our will to have this meeting, and I never imagined they'd sign this thing... Well, I just feel like I've been punched in the head or something.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
这次会议并不是我们的本意，我也从没想过他们会签署这份文件... 唉，我觉得自己像是被人狠狠揍了一拳。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Well, it's already spilled milk. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
算了，覆水难收。不管我喜不喜欢，我都得去参加那个会议。你能帮我把这个交给联合研究所的官员吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
In the meantime, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
在此期间，我得为会议做点准备。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hi! Did you give that Invitation to the Official?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗨！你把那份邀请函交给官员了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, goo to hear that it's delivered safely.
Anyway, what brings you here again?
Would you like some tea? We haven't got any dessert yet. I only have some tea to offer.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，很高兴听到它已经安全送达了。
不管怎样，你这次又是什么风把你吹来了？
想喝点茶吗？我们还没准备甜点，只有茶可以招待你。

scripts.text: Can I help you with anything?
scripts.translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Help?
Well, there are tons of things waiting for help!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
帮忙？
嗯，有很多事情等着帮忙呢！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Nice Timing.
I've requested something from the Arunafeltz office but haven't gotten anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
真是时候。
我向阿鲁纳菲兹办事处申请了一些东西，但还没收到。你能去汉森娜那里取一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I need that for the meeting, but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again! You'll help me with this, right!?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我开会需要那个，但他从来都不寄给我。他肯定又忘了！你会帮我的，对吧！？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I've requested something from the Arunafeltz office but haven't gotten anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我向阿鲁纳菲兹办事处申请了一些东西，但还没收到。你能去汉森娜那里取一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I need that for the meeting, but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again! You'll help me with this, right!?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我开会需要那个，但他从来都不寄给我。他肯定又忘了！你会帮我的，对吧！？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huh? Are you serious???? Dropped it on a bridge while playing treasure hunting???
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
什么？你是认真的？？？玩寻宝游戏的时候掉到桥底下了？？？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hansenne! What and itiot! I knew it! His brain must've been melted with hot air!
Aarrrrr!!!!! Can't believe this!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
汉森娜！你这个白痴！我就知道！他的脑子肯定是被热气给蒸熟了！
啊啊啊啊！！！真不敢相信！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What the heck should I do??? The meesting's soon!!!
Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
I hate foreigners.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我该怎么办？？？会议马上就要开始了！！！
天哪！我真的更喜欢独自工作。我讨厌那些人！
我讨厌外国人。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
.....Whew... completely soaked, so loosely binded...torn here and there... I can't even read this thing!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
......呼... 完全湿透了，绑得松松垮垮... 这里那里都破了... 我根本没法读这东西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What is he expecting from me with this!!!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
他拿着这个想让我干什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Aarrrrr!!!!! This is a nightmare!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊啊啊啊！！！这简直是场梦魇！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huh? Are you serious???? Dropped it on a bridge while playing treasure hunting???
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
什么？你是认真的？？？玩寻宝游戏的时候掉到桥底下了？？？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Hansenne! What and idiot! I knew it! His brain must've been melted with hot air!
Aarrrrr!!!!! Can't believe this!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
汉森娜！你这个白痴！我就知道！他的脑子肯定是被热气给蒸熟了！
啊啊啊啊！！！真不敢相信！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
What the heck should I do??? The meesting's soon!!!
Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
I hate foreigners.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我该怎么办？？？会议马上就要开始了！！！
天哪！我真的更喜欢独自工作。我讨厌那些人！
我讨厌外国人。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
...Oh, this is...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...哦，这是...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
This is the document I requested.
I thought the document was lost at some bridge and ruined completely, but then...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
这就是我要找的文件。
我以为它掉在桥底彻底毁了，结果...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Wow... this document is amazingly neat. Looks like Hue's the one who made this... He's really picky, if you know what I mean... Anyway, it's pretty impressive...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哇...这份文件整理得真整齐。看来是休整理的...他做事真是一丝不苟，你懂的...总之，真的很厉害...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I'm so relieved I got this before the meeting. I've got to go now.
I'm running late.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
能在会议前拿到真是太好了。我得走了。
我要迟到了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
But first, I have to find another document for the meeting. Could you please ask the Official to wait for me a bit?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
不过在那之前，我得再找一份会议用的文件。能麻烦你请那位官员稍等我一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, the meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
拜托了，会议马上就要开始了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How could I go to the meeting without the research report??!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
没有研究报告我怎么去参加会议？？！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
I hate foreigners.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
天哪！我真的更喜欢独自工作。我讨厌那些人！
我讨厌外国人。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Could you please ask the Official to wait for me a bit?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
能麻烦你请那位官员稍等我一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I have to find another document for the meeting. Please, hurry.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我得再找一份会议用的文件。拜托了，快一点。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah..... That... in that meeting room... Is.. everything alright now?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊...那个...在那个会议室...现在...一切都还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, I need to be left alone for a while.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，我需要一个人静一静。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Krrrrrrrr! Ugh...!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
库鲁鲁鲁鲁！呃...！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I know, I know! I went too far!
I was just so shocked and disappointed at the same time.
After all, it was just a cake...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我知道，我知道！我做得太过分了！
我当时既震惊又失望。
毕竟那只是一块蛋糕...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I wasn't very mature.
Oh, what have I done?
I should go an apologize.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我做得很不成熟。
天哪，我干了什么？
我应该去道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait! Hue wanted me to bring this to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！休让我把这个带给你。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
A report... ?
Ahhh... the one I left in the meeting room...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
一份报告...？
啊...是我落在会议室的那份...

scripts.text:
- Ryosen takes the report -
- and gives a glance -
- at the memo stuck on it. -
scripts.translation:
- Ryosen 接过报告 -
- 瞥了一眼 -
- 贴在上面的备忘。 -

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
... ?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦。你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah. I'm so embarrassed.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊。真让人尴尬。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, I didn't expect to get an apology. This is such a shame.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，没想到会收到道歉。真是遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Now that I think of it. I didn't even say 'thank you' to him for restoring my documents...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
说起来。我甚至没对他说声“谢谢”，感谢他帮我恢复了文件...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ok. I should setup another meeting ASAP. That way, we'd have a chance to get to know each other.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好吧。我应该尽快安排另一次会议。这样，我们就有机会互相了解了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
So... Could you do me another favor?
Could you go see the Official in my stead and set up a meeting?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
那么...能再帮我个忙吗？
你能替我去见那位官员，安排一次会议吗？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh! And... Here's Rune-Midgarts' fresh strawberry cake. This is for you. I'm so sorry I haven't even offered you a piece. I was so distracted with stress, I think.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦！还有...这是卢恩·米德加兹的新鲜草莓蛋糕。这是给你的。很抱歉我甚至没给你分一块。我想我因为压力太大而分心了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Thank you so much for everything you've done. And... pleade don't forget to do me this last favor, going to the Official and setting up a meeting.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
非常感谢你为我做的一切。还有...拜托别忘了帮我这个最后的忙，去见那位官员并安排会议。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I... think I should prepare for the meeting again.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我...觉得我应该为会议再做些准备。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Again, thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
再次非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ok. I should setup another meeting ASAP. That way, we'd have a chance to get to know each other.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
好吧。我应该尽快安排另一次会议。这样，我们就有机会互相了解了。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Could you go see the Official in my stead and set up a meeting?
I... think I should prepare for the meeting again.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你能替我去见那位官员，安排一次会议吗？
我...觉得我应该为会议再做些准备。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ah, hello adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊，你好，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I don't know how to thank you.
You can't imagine how greatful I feel!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不知道该怎么感谢你。
你无法想象我有多感激！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Oh, but then... Have you ever seen a ^0000ffMystic Horn^000000? I'd love to get one.
I heard you can get this thing from a monster named, 'Cornus' found in the fields.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
哦，不过...你见过^0000ff魔力之角^000000吗？我很想弄到一个。
我听说可以从一种叫“飞马”的魔物身上获得，它们生活在野外。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Or... do you have any ^0000ffMystic Horns^000000 with you? Of course, I'm not saying that I want it for free. If you'd give me ^0000ff2 Mystic Horns^000000, I'd give you my Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
或者...你身上有^0000ff魔力之角^000000吗？当然，我不是说我要白拿。如果你给我^0000ff2个魔力之角^000000，我就把我的卢恩·米德加兹草莓蛋糕给你。

scripts.text: I haven't seen such a thing.
scripts.translation: 我没见过这种东西。

scripts.text: Oh, ok, I'll give you!
scripts.translation: 哦，好的，我送给你！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Mmmmmmm~
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
嗯嗯嗯~

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
If by any chance you find one, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如果你碰巧找到了一个，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Huh?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You have Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你居然有卢恩·米德加兹的草莓蛋糕？

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
How come you haven't had it yet?
You should quickly finish that cake or else, somebody would steal it from you.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
怎么还没吃呢？
快把它吃完吧，不然别人会偷走的。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I don't need it!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
... Haha, I'm joking...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
...哈哈，我开玩笑的...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Are you really, honestly, positively sure you want to exchange them for my cake?
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你真的、真的、真的确定要用它们换我的蛋糕吗？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Yeah... I'll exchange.
scripts.translation: 是的...我要交换。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Ahhh...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如果你改变主意了，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I don't need it!
... Haha, I'm joking...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我不需要！
...哈哈，我开玩笑的...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
I heard you could extract some magical energy form Mystic Horns and use it. Anyway, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
我听说可以从魔力之角中提取一些魔力并使用。总之，谢谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You lie! You don't even have any!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你撒谎！你根本没有！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, if you find any Mystic Horns, come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
拜托了，如果你找到魔力之角，请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
Please, don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
拜托，不要碰任何东西！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
You know somethig... Something comes out from this thing...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
你知道的...有什么东西从这东西里出来了...

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
If anyone tried to talk to you in the middle of the night, you should just walk away... Don't ever look back!!
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
如果半夜有人试图和你说话，你应该直接走开...千万不要回头！！

scripts.text:
[Ryosen]
And don't stare at the crack of dimension... or you'd be dragged to somewhere mysterious and never be able to come back...huhuhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[Ryosen]
也不要盯着维度的裂缝看...否则你会被拖到某个神秘的地方，再也回不来...呼呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你怎么带了这么多东西？
你是在训练什么的吗？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What is it you want?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Don't walk around this place without thinking.
After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不要不假思索地四处走动。
毕竟，会有麻烦的是你自己。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What is it you want?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You can't just come and go around as you please here. This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[休]
你不能在这里随心所欲地进出。这是限制区域。

scripts.text: Sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text: I came to show you this.
scripts.translation: 我来给你看这个。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You're just helpless, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你真是没用啊。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What's that?
scripts.translation:
[休]
那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
...An invitation to the meeting... ?
scripts.translation:
[休]
...会议邀请函...？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Haha. You expect me to accept this?
As always, scheduling things as they want, report to us to accept it...
scripts.translation:
[休]
哈哈。你居然指望我接受这个？
一如既往，想怎么安排就怎么安排，然后让我们去接受...？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I can't think of any other words to describe them, except for this word: RUDE!
scripts.translation:
[休]
除了“无礼”这个词，我找不到其他词来形容他们了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Never ever asking for our opinion and always delivering things through some strangers... By the way, no offense...
scripts.translation:
[休]
从来不征求我们的意见，总是通过一些陌生人来传达...顺便说一句，别介意...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
THey don't ever take the official route! Rune-Midgartish way of reporting! Very unprofessional!
scripts.translation:
[休]
他们从来不走正规渠道！卢恩·米德加兹式的汇报方式！太不专业了！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Anyway, what is this meeting about?
Give it to me. I should read it at least.
scripts.translation:
[休]
总之，这个会议是关于什么的？
给我看看。我至少应该读一下。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You should have some Sand chips while I'm reading this. Don't expect any taste, it's from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[休]
在我读这个的时候，你可以吃点沙粒。别指望有什么味道，这是从阿鲁纳菲兹来的。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You can't go around this place as you want. This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation:
[休]
你不能在这里随心所欲地走动。这是限制区域。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
...Meeting Schedule, on the Xth day, from hh:mm to hh:mm...
Location... Rune-Midgarts' camp...
Ha! I knew it. Rune-Midgarts' camp again!
scripts.translation:
[休]
...会议日程，X日，从hh:mm到hh:mm...
地点...卢恩·米德加兹的营地...
哈！我就知道。又是卢恩·米德加兹的营地！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation:
[休]
目标...汇报追踪魔王梦罗克和阿什真空的研究进展！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Having some time to get to know each other??? Haaaaa!
scripts.translation:
[休]
有些时间让大家互相认识一下？？？哈啊！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, thank you for entertaining me. You should tell Ryosen that.
scripts.translation:
[休]
好吧，谢谢你逗我开心。你应该告诉료森这一点。

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会的。

scripts.text: Please sign the invitation.
scripts.translation: 请签署邀请函。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, you should also tell him that I think he's very talented in settin up comedy. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯，你也应该告诉他，我觉得他在设置喜剧方面很有天赋。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
... Sign this thing???

[Hue]
You mean this meeting's for real???
scripts.translation:
[休]
你是说这个会议是真的？？？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh my!
I have never seen an official invitation to be this stupid-looking!
scripts.translation:
[休]
天哪！
我从未见过这么丑的正式邀请函！
