scripts.text: - Hue got so furious and pressed the pen so hard that the ball point got pushed in. Then he threw the document after signing it. -
scripts.translation: - 休气得把笔按得太紧，笔芯都戳进去了。签完字后，他把文件扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, at least I respect that Ryosen hasn't forgotten the reporting order. So, you're off to Arunafeltz now?
scripts.translation:
[休]
好吧，至少我尊重ryo森没有忘记汇报顺序。那么，你现在要去阿鲁纳菲兹了？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You'll experience some hard time talking to Hansenne... It'll be like testing your patience.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[休]
和汉森娜打交道会很辛苦...这简直是在考验你的耐心。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Come on, what's the hurry?
Wait a few more minutes, I didn't finish reading it!
scripts.translation:
[休]
急什么？
再等几分钟，我还没读完呢！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You should have some Sand chips while I'm reading this. Don't expect any taste, it's from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[休]
在我读这个的时候，你可以吃点沙粒。别指望有什么味道，这是从阿鲁纳菲兹来的。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm not sure if everyone from Arunafeltz is like him, but, it'll be like testing your patience to get Hansenne to read this thing.
You can trust me on that one. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我不确定阿鲁纳菲兹的人是不是都像他那样，但让汉森娜读这份文件简直是在考验你的耐心。
这一点你可以相信我。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What is this stupid looking pile of documents?
scripts.translation:
[休]
这堆看起来愚蠢的文件是什么？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Is this the file Ryosen requested from Hansenne??? The one which is all ruined...?
scripts.translation:
[休]
这是ryo森向汉森娜索取的那份文件？？？就是那份被毁得乱七八糟的...？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ha! Tsk,tsk! Is this some kind of joke?! Who'd manage the files like this? I'd never know!
scripts.translation:
[休]
哈！啧，啧！这是某种玩笑吗？！谁会这样管理文件？我完全不知道！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Whew... I can't even stand looking at it! Oh just, give it to me!
scripts.translation:
[休]
呼...我甚至无法直视它！哦，算了，给我吧！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Too bad I'm not in Schwarzwald. I could use our document restoring machine back at home... Ugh! Now I gotta do everything manually.
scripts.translation:
[休]
真可惜我不在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德。我可以用家里的文件修复机器...唉！现在只能手动处理了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯。完全湿透了。我应该先把它弄干，熨平这些褶皱。然后，再修复文字。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我需要一些材料。你得帮我。我需要^0000ff1把扇子，1个破旧平底锅，1个火焰能量石，1瓶中国墨水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hey, hey... don't look at me like that. I know you're not delighted to do these things but think about it, what about me? Why should I restore this garbage?
scripts.translation:
[休]
嘿，嘿...别那样看着我。我知道你对做这些事并不高兴，但想想看，我呢？我为什么要修复这堆垃圾？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Listen, sometimes, we've got to do things we don't like in order to get things accomplished.
scripts.translation:
[休]
听着，有时候，为了达成目标，我们不得不做一些不喜欢的事。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
只要别忘了，你为我准备好这些东西的速度，决定了文件修复的速度。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I wonder if the preparation for the meeting's going ok.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不知道会议的准备进行得怎么样了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I heard Ryosen say that the file he requested from Hansenne is all ruined. I hope I dont get involved in that trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我听说ryo森说他从汉森娜那里要的文件全毁了。希望我不会卷入那个麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Impressive. That was fast enough.
scripts.translation:
[休]
令人印象深刻。速度够快。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Give them to me.
I have no time to waste.
scripts.translation:
[休]
把它们给我。
我没时间浪费。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Could you please sit there and wait for me while I restore this file?
scripts.translation:
[休]
请坐在那里等我，我要修复这份文件。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯。完全湿透了。我应该先把它弄干，熨平这些褶皱。然后，再修复文字。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我需要一些材料。你得帮我。我需要^0000ff1把扇子，1个破旧平底锅，1个火焰能量石，1瓶中国墨水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
只要别忘了，你为我准备好这些东西的速度，决定了文件修复的速度。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
There!
scripts.translation:
[休]
好了！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation:
[休]
装订太松了，所以我重新整理并装订了这份文件。这才是正式文件该有的样子。我真觉得他们应该学学怎么整理文件。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation:
[休]
请赶在太晚之前把这份文件送过去。会议马上就要开始了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Hey, stop pushing me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嘿，别推我。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I have to be extra careful with this kind of work, ok? Can't you sit quietly over there? Take a nap or something.
scripts.translation:
[休]
这种工作我必须格外小心，明白吗？你能不能在那边安静地坐着？或者打个盹什么的。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation:
[休]
装订太松了，所以我重新整理并装订了这份文件。这才是正式文件该有的样子。我真觉得他们应该学学怎么整理文件。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation:
[休]
请赶在太晚之前把这份文件送过去。会议马上就要开始了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, finally... It's time for the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯，终于...该开会了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Like it or not... I should go in.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不管愿不愿意...我都得进去了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
.....Ittt....Is... it still there... ?
- Looks like he's thinking about something... very seriously. -
scripts.translation: - 看起来他正在非常认真地思考着什么... -

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I just decided I can't stay like this.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我刚下定决心，不能再这样下去了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I couldn't confess the truth when Hansenne said he ruined the cake instead of me.
scripts.translation:
[休]
当汉森娜说是他弄坏了蛋糕而不是我时，我没能说出真相。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I was so bewildered that I lost the chance to say anything... but... I was such a coward to admit that I was the one who caused the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我当时太慌乱，错过了开口的机会...但是...承认是我惹了麻烦，我实在太懦弱了。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I must apologize.
But then...
scripts.translation:
[休]
我必须道歉。
但是...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，和他面对面太尴尬了。或者...不如...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation:
[休]
这个，是我在会议室一片混乱时带走的卢恩·米德加兹的报告。能请你把这个交给ryo森吗？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm sorry to ask you this but...
Could you? For this, I'll give you some Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不好意思麻烦你了，但是...
你能帮我吗？作为回报，我会给你一些修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please give this report to Ryosen.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[休]
请把这份报告交给ryo森。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，和他面对面太尴尬了。或者...不如...

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation:
[休]
这个，是我在会议室一片混乱时带走的卢恩·米德加兹的报告。能请你把这个交给ryo森吗？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I'm sorry to ask you this but...
Could you?
scripts.translation:
[休]
不好意思麻烦你了，但是...
你能帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ah, hello!
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，你好！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
If it weren't for you, we wouldn't be able to get along at all.
I don't know how to thank you!
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果不是你，我们根本没法相处。
真不知道该怎么感谢你！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Have you ever seen something called, ^0000ffFur^000000 ?
I hear you can get it from the monsters called 'Tatacho' and 'Hillsrion' in the fields.
scripts.translation:
[休]
你听说过叫^0000ff毛皮^000000的东西吗？
听说在野外可以从叫“哒哒乔”和“希尔里恩”的怪物身上获得。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Could you bring ^0000ffFur^000000 if you get some? I'm not asking it for free.
I'll give you my Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald, if you bring me ^0000ff2 Furs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果你能弄到^0000ff毛皮^000000，能带给我吗？我不是白拿的。
如果你给我^0000ff2个毛皮^000000，我就把修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典给你。

scripts.text: I don't have any, right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在没有。

scripts.text: Oh, I'll give you Fur.
scripts.translation: 哦，我给你毛皮。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Alright, you don't have any.
scripts.translation:
[休]
好吧，你现在没有。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please give me some when you get some.
scripts.translation:
[休]
等你弄到了请给我一些。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ah, oh my.
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，哎呀。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
You already have the Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald!
scripts.translation:
[休]
你已经拥有修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典了！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I think you should drin that thing fast. Otherwise, all the ice will melt and it'll taste like some kinda medicine!
scripts.translation:
[休]
我觉得你应该快点喝掉那个东西。不然冰都化了，味道就像某种药一样！

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ah, are you sure you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[休]
啊，你确定要交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Oh, so it's the thing called, Fur??
scripts.translation:
[休]
哦，就是那个叫毛皮的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Are you sure you want to exchange this for my Pineapple Jubilee?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你确定要用这个换我的菠萝庆典吗？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Ahhhhh...

[Hue]
Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[休]
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
I always needed this because the weather here is colder then I expected. I'm sure this will keep me warm.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我一直需要这个，因为这里的天气比我预期的要冷。我相信这个能让我暖和起来。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Well, I don't think you have any Fur.
scripts.translation:
[休]
嗯，我想你应该没有毛皮。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Please come back if you find any Fur.
scripts.translation:
[休]
如果你找到毛皮，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Don't walk around this area. It's restricted.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不要在这个区域走动。这里是禁区。

scripts.text:
[Hue]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[休]
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Hue]
Don't walk around this place without thinking.
After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[休]
不要不假思索地四处走动。
毕竟，会有麻烦的是你自己。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
How come you've got so much to carry?
Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你怎么带了这么多东西？
难道是在进行什么训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
谁在那里？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Who's here?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
谁在这里？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm? What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯？什么事把你带到这里来了？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Of course, your feet brought you here!?!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
当然，是你的脚把你带到这里来的！？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Come and look at this.
scripts.translation: 过来看看这个

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
What are you looking at?
Something I said?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你在看什么？
是我刚才说的话吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
What's that?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
An invitation to the meeting?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
会议的邀请函？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmm, Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts made it and... Hue from Schwarzwald agreed to sign it too?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯，卢恩·米德加兹的Ryosen制作的，而且...修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的休也同意签署了？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm, that's not funny at all.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯，这一点也不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
They're so boring. They always report to me after making all the decisions. No sense of humor... so stubborn and strict... They're totally not my style.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
他们真无聊。总是先做完所有决定，然后再向我汇报。一点幽默感都没有...固执又严厉...完全不是我的风格。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Anyway, give it to me.
I should have a look at least.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
总之，把它给我。
我至少应该看一眼。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You should take a rest, while I'm reading this. Oh, have some Poring Candy from Rune-Midgarts. It's terribly sour and sometimes salty. Funny taste, huh?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
趁我读这个的时候，你休息一下。哦，吃点卢恩·米德加兹的波利糖果吧。味道非常酸，有时还有点咸。味道挺特别的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm? Are you from Rune-Midgarts?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯？你是卢恩·米德加兹的人？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Then where's the person from Rude Midgard? Hahahahah, do you get my joke?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
那卢恩·米德加兹的人在哪里呢？哈哈哈，你懂我的玩笑吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Mmmmmm~
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯嗯~

scripts.text:
- Hansenne picks up the file -
- and suddenly gets serious -
- while turning the pages... -
scripts.translation:
- 汉森娜拿起文件 -
- 突然变得严肃起来 -
- 翻动着书页... -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Mmmmmm~
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯嗯~

scripts.text: - Hansenne drops some kind of liquid on the file document, and carefully looks at it. -
scripts.translation:
- 汉森娜在文件上滴了一些液体，
- 然后仔细端详着。 -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Meeting Schedule... on the Umpth day, from then-o'clock to later-o'clock
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
Meeting Schedule, shmeating schedule... Beating Schedule!!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
会议日程... 在Umpth日，从then-o'clock到later-o'clock
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。
会议日程，什么会议日程... 殴打日程！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Location... Rune-Midgarts' camp!
Rude-Midgard's camp!?!?
Are they camping in that place??
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
地点... 卢恩·米德加兹的营地！
卢恩·米德加兹的营地！？！？
他们居然在那个地方露营？？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and of the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
目标... 汇报对魔王梦罗克和阿什真空的研究进展！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ash-Vacuum!
Ash-Vacuum... what is that, a homemaker's device???
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
阿什真空！
阿什真空... 那是什么，家用设备？？？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
...and a very useless one which vacuums only ash!
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
...而且是一个只吸灰烬的非常无用的设备！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ehhhhh? And what's this? Having some time to get to know each other??? ...Pffthahahahaha...
Aaahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
诶诶诶？这是什么？还有时间互相认识一下？？？ ...噗嗤哈哈哈哈哈...
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: What's so funny?!
scripts.translation: 有什么好笑的？！

scripts.text: Hey, just sign this thing.
scripts.translation: 嘿，就在这上面签个字吧。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha...get to know each other...
Pffftahahaha.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈...互相认识一下...
噗嗤哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Phew! Excuse me!
I can't help it! I can't stand this! What the heck!!! What do we have to know about each other???
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
呼！抱歉！
我忍不住了！我受不了这个！到底要互相了解什么啊？？？
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
- Hansenne signs the paper -
- with a shaking hand -
- still laughing out loud. -
scripts.translation:
- 汉森娜签了那张纸 -
- 手还在颤抖 -
- 依然在大声笑着。 -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Puhhh-haha, this is unbelievable.
Ryosen's avery funny guy. Well, he wouldn't know how funny he is...
Haha, you should tell him that.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
呼哈哈，这太不可思议了。
Ryosen真是个有趣的人。不过，他自己可能不知道他有多有趣...
哈哈，你应该告诉他。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ahhh, wait. I didn't finish reading it.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
啊，等等。我还没读完。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I didn't finish reading it.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我还没读完。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hush! Please don't talk! We must pray now!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嘘！请别说话！我们现在必须祈祷！

scripts.text:
- He takes a bow silently, -
- toward the sky, -
- with his eyes firmly closed. -
scripts.translation:
- 他默默地鞠躬， -
- 面向天空， -
- 双眼紧闭。 -

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I got it, I got it. I should go to the meeting. Ryosen's really a funny guy, if you know what I mean.
Please, thank him for entertaining me. Haha, hahaha,
hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我知道了，我知道了。我该去开会了。Ryosen真是个有趣的人，如果你懂我的意思的话。
请替我谢谢他逗我开心。哈哈，哈哈哈，
哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmm? You again?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯？又是你？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text: I missed you.
scripts.translation: 我想你了。

scripts.text: I came to pick up the requested document.
scripts.translation: 我来领取所需的文件。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You what?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你说什么？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You missed me? Don't expect a kiss!
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你想我了？别指望我会亲你哦！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
A requested document? Did Ryosen send you?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
所需的文件？是Ryosen派你来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm.
Wait for me here. Now, where did I put it...?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯。
在这里等我一下。对了，我把它放哪儿了...？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm~?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯~？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ahhhh!
Hmmmmm, right, right!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
啊！
嗯嗯，对了，对了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
It's gone!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
不见了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我弄丢了。我想我可能在桥上玩寻宝游戏的时候，不小心把它掉进河里了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
不过你知道吗，有趣的是...我听说我父母是在桥上捡到婴儿时期的我的，而现在我又在桥上弄丢了文件！真是巧合啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
重新制作需要时间。不过...嗯...我要不要去钓鱼，把那个东西捞上来~？
你知道的，西南边的那些家伙很会钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Maybe we can catch that document with a fishing rod if we're lucky!
Wow!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
也许我们运气好的话，可以用鱼竿把那份文件钓上来！
哇！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我弄丢了。我想我可能在桥上玩寻宝游戏的时候，不小心把它掉进河里了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
不过你知道吗，有趣的是...我听说我父母是在桥上捡到婴儿时期的我的，而现在我又在桥上弄丢了文件！真是巧合啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

你知道的，西南边的那些家伙很会钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Cool, you found it!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
酷，你找到了！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Mmmm, I'm sure this is the one I made, just by looking at this overall shape.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯，光看这个整体形状，我就确定这是我做的那份。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm, but then... I'm afraid Ryosen would explode when he sees this! Boom!!!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯，但是...我恐怕Ryosen看到这份文件会气炸的！轰！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Schwarzwald people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的人擅长修复这类东西...你为什么不请休来修复一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He'd scream so hard and the windows might break. But he'll do it.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
他肯定会尖叫得很大声，窗户可能会被震碎。但他还是会做的。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我弄丢了。我想我可能在桥上玩寻宝游戏的时候，不小心把它掉进河里了！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.

重新制作需要时间。不过...嗯...我要不要去钓鱼，把那个东西捞上来~？
你知道的，西南边的那些家伙很会钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm, it's all screwed up. I'm afraid Ryosen would explode when he sees this! Boom!!!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯，全乱了。我恐怕Ryosen看到这份文件会气炸的！轰！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Schwarzwald people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He'd scream so hard and the windows might break. But he'll do it.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
他肯定会尖叫得很大声，窗户可能会被震碎。但他还是会做的。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm~ It's about time.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯~ 差不多该到了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I don't wanna get in trouble. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我不想惹麻烦。我得赶紧走了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha....
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈....

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
That friend of yours never gets my jokes... My sense of humor is... just... out of his league!! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你那朋友从来都听不懂我的笑话... 我的幽默感... 简直... 高他好几个等级！！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Huh? You again?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
咦？又是你？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么要那样做？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hehhhhh??? What are you talking about? If you wanna blame me for anything, tell me the reason first~
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嘿？？？你在说什么？如果你想怪我，先告诉我理由嘛~
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know you're not the one who ruined the cake. I saw it. It was Hue! I saw him clearly when he pressed his hand on the cake when the Thief Bug came out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道破坏蛋糕的不是你。我看见了。是休！当浮勒盗虫出现时，我清楚地看到他按在了蛋糕上。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Well... Who cares who did it?
It was just a mistake. Nothing's gonna change even if we find out who did it. The cake is still ruined, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯... 谁做的有什么关系？
只是个意外而已。就算查出来是谁做的，也没什么改变。蛋糕还是毁了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Hmmmmm... or... I don't know. Maybe I'm thanlful that he restored my garbage looking file... ?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯嗯... 或者... 我不知道。也许我有点感激他修复了我那看起来像垃圾一样的文件...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But... You were blamed for it.
Aren't you feeling bad? It's unfair!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是... 你被责怪了。
你不觉得难过吗？这不公平！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Well, not really.
Ryosen could be very rhough when he gets freaked out, but he will forget about all that soon...
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯，还好吧。
Ryosen 情绪激动时可能会很粗暴，但他很快就会忘记这些事的...

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I understand. He was upset.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我理解。他当时很生气。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You see, he brought that cake for all of us in there. He wouldn't normally do that, but I guess he wanted to be nice. But then, poof~ the cake was ruined.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你看，他是为了我们大家才带那个蛋糕来的。他平时不会这么做，但我想他是想表现得好一点。结果，噗~ 蛋糕毁了。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He must've been so upset that we all couldn't share that cake. Isn't it kinda cute?
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
他一定很沮丧，因为我们大家都没能分享那个蛋糕。是不是有点可爱？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Well, it's nothing big. Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
嗯，没什么大不了的。你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
He'll be ok soon. He'll get to thinking that it wasn't actually a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
他很快就会没事的。他会想通这其实没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
But the thing is that... the relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all.
Why don't you help them get along with each other?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
但是问题是... Ryosen 和休的关系看起来一点都不好。
你为什么不帮他们和好一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Sorry for asking these things of you. And... here's Arunageltz's Desert Sandwich. It's nothing special but... tastes pretty good.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
抱歉让你帮忙处理这些。还有... 这是阿鲁纳格尔特兹的沙漠三明治。没什么特别的，但... 味道还不错。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Thank you for doing me a favor.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
谢谢你的帮忙。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
The relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all.
Why don't you help them get along with each other?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
Ryosen 和休的关系看起来一点都不好。
你为什么不帮他们和好一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ah, it's you adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
啊，是你啊，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I heard about you from the Official. Thank you so much for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我从官方那里听说了你的事。非常感谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Anyways.. I wonder if you have seen a ^0000ffPeaked Hat^000000. I heard the monster, 'Tatacho' has that hat.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
话说回来... 不知道你有没有见过^0000ff红色高帽^000000。我听说怪物“哒哒乔”身上有那顶帽子。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Can you give me a ^0000ffPeaked Hat^000000 if you have any? I'm not asking for free.
For ^0000ff2 Peaked Hats^000000, I'll give you my special dessert!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
如果你有的话，能给我一顶^0000ff红色高帽^000000吗？我不是白拿的。
用^0000ff2顶红色高帽^000000，我就把我的特制甜点给你！

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
No way?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
不行吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
I'd say, yes way?
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
我觉得，行吧？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
... 咦？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Oh, it loos like you already have the Arunafeltz's Desert Sandwich.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哦，看起来你已经有了阿鲁纳菲兹的沙漠三明治。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You should eat that up before it gets rotten. Maybe it's gone bad already.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你应该在它腐烂之前把它吃掉。也许它已经变质了。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ah!!! You have it?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
啊！！！你有吗？

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Oh, you really have those!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哦，你真的有那些！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Are you sure you want to give these to me?
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你确定要把这些给我吗？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
No way. Yes way. This way. That way.
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
不行。行。这样。那样。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Ohhhhh, thank you!
Ehhmmm, thank you!
Geeeee, thank you!
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
噢噢噢，谢谢你！
呃嗯，谢谢你！
哎呀呀，谢谢你！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
You haven't got any.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
你还没有啊。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
How about getting some?
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
要不要去弄一些？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Sasquatch Hydra!!!
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
雪熊海葵！！！

scripts.text:
[Hansenne]
Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[汉森娜]
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: What is this place?
scripts.translation: 这是什么地方？

scripts.text: I'm here for a job.
scripts.translation: 我来找工作的。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
This is where we keep creatures
captured here in Ash Vacuum.
We study them to understand
their characteristics and habits.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
这里存放着我们在阿什真空捕获的生物。
我们研究它们，以了解它们的特征和习性。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Of course, scholars and
specialists perform the studies.
I'm here to tame and breed
dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
当然，研究和专业工作是由学者和专家进行的。
我负责驯服和繁殖危险的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
...I hope I can carry them
around as my pets.
Hillstions are so cute.
You can't find such an
animal on the mainland,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
...我希望能把它们当作我的宠物带着。
希尔里昂太可爱了。
你在大陆上是找不到这种动物的，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I'm sorry, but I don't need any assistance right now.
I'll make an official anouncement if I need help.
Please come back then.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
抱歉，我现在不需要任何帮助。
如果需要帮忙，我会发布正式公告的。
请到时候再来。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Welcome.
Your job is simple:
help me out by gathering
the animals' feed or by
cleaning their cages.
These are the available jobs.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
欢迎。
你的工作很简单：
帮我收集动物的饲料，或者清理它们的笼子。
以下是可用的工作。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Please bring me 50 Fresh Fish.
They're feed for Tatachoes.
I'm fresh out, and I'll need to restock very soon.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
请给我带50个美味的鱼。
它们是塔塔乔的饲料。
我刚好用完了，很快就需要补充。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
You can find them from Tatachoes in the fields.
Strange, isn't it?
I don't know where they've caught the fish.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你可以在田地里从塔塔乔那里找到它们。
奇怪，不是吗？
我不知道它们是从哪里抓到的鱼。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Thank you in advance.
Please bring me feed for Tatachoes: ^4d4dff50 Fresh Fish^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
提前谢谢你了。
请给我带塔塔乔的饲料：^4d4dff50个美味的鱼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I've just run out of
feed for Cornuses.
Can you please bring me
^4d4dff30 Great Leaves and 30 Brown Roots^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
我刚好用完了科努斯的饲料。
你能帮我带^4d4dff30片大叶子和30个褐色树根^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
You can find them from
Pinguiculas in the fields.
Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你可以在田地里从捕虫堇那里找到它们。
提前谢谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I've just run out of
feed for Hillsrions.
Scholars think these
guys are members
of the cat family.
I've been trying to feed
them various things.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
我刚好用完了希尔里昂的饲料。
学者们认为这些家伙是猫科动物。
我一直在尝试喂它们各种东西。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
This time... I'd like to
try Monster's Feed.
Can you please bring me
^4d4dff20 Monster's Feeds and 30 Pet Foods^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
这次...我想试试魔物饲料。
你能帮我带^4d4dff20个魔物饲料和30个宠物饲料^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Thank you in advance.
Don't forget the
20 Monster's Feeds
and 30 Pet Foods.
I hope the Hallsrions
will like them.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
提前谢谢你了。
别忘了
20个魔物饲料
和30个宠物饲料。
我希望希尔里昂会喜欢它们。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
This is perfect because
I was going to try some
new feed for Hillsrions.
I tried Monster's Feed,
but I don't know if they
liked it or not.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
这正好，因为我正打算给希尔里昂试试新的饲料。
我试过魔物饲料，
但不知道它们喜不喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
I want to try Meat this time.
Can you please bring me
^4d4dff50 Meat^000000 and ^4d4dff30 Pet Foods^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
这次我想试试肉。
你能帮我带^4d4dff50个肉^000000和^4d4dff30个宠物饲料^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Taab]

您的Zeny不足？
猫爪贸易的仓库服务
费用为60 Zeny。
很便宜，不是吗？

猫爪贸易积分的顾客开放。
请记住，一旦传送到米德加尔特，
就不容易回来了。

[Cat Paw Agent]
Thank you for using our service.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Thank you for using our service.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
感谢您使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
*Yawn...*
I want to eat fish.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
*打哈欠...*
我想吃鱼。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Don't play with money.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
别拿钱开玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
*Sniff Sniff* Can't you smell fish
around here?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
*嗅嗅* 你闻不到附近有鱼的味道吗？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Hmm?
Oh, did the Cat Paw Agent send you?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
嗯？
哦，是猫爪特工派你来的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Oh, okay...
Well, where should I begin.
(Mumble Mumble)
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
哦，好的...
那么，我该从哪里开始说起呢。
*咕哝咕哝*

scripts.text: What do you guys do?
scripts.translation: 你们公司是做什么的？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Oh, sure.
I can start from there.
You used Kafra Corporation services on the Midgard Continent, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
哦，当然可以。
我可以从那里开始。
你在米德加尔特大陆使用过卡普拉公司的服务，对吧？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Cat Trading is a new trading company based on this undeveloped continent.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
猫贸易是一家基于这片未开发大陆的新兴贸易公司。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Well, frankly we wanted to join the Midgard Market, but it was too competitive...
Not only that, they don't have enough fish for all of us either... (Mumble Mumble)
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
说实话，我们本来想加入米德加尔特市场的，但那里的竞争太激烈了...
而且，那里的鱼也不够我们所有人吃的... *咕哝咕哝*

scripts.text: What services do you offer?
scripts.translation: 你们提供什么服务？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
*Purr* Oh, our service range is similar to the Kafra's Location Saving, Storage Service, Warp Service, and more.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
*呼噜* 哦，我们的服务范围与卡普拉的地点保存、仓库服务、传送服务类似，还有更多。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
The only difference is that, our services are limited depending on the customer's credit.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
唯一的区别是，我们的服务会根据顾客的信用额度而有所限制。

scripts.text: Credit?
scripts.translation: 信用额度？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
As you might know already, we're a considerably small company struggling to make ends meet in this niche market.
We desperately need your support to grow.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
您可能已经知道了，我们是一家相当小的公司，在这个小众市场中艰难求生。
我们迫切需要您的支持来发展壮大。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
You can increase your credit by helping us secure our food or by collecting minerals.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
您可以通过帮助我们获取食物或收集矿石来增加您的信用额度。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
The more credits you earn, the more services you can use. You can also apply for special events.
Say, how'd you like to make a membership contract with us?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
您获得的信用额度越多，能使用的服务就越多。您还可以申请参加特殊活动。
那么，您愿意与我们签订会员契约吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I need to think it over.
scripts.translation: 我需要再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Excellent! Thank you for joining the Cat Trading membership service.
We hope you'll support our exploration of this unknown land.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
太好了！感谢您加入猫贸易会员服务。
希望您能支持我们探索这片未知的土地。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Please go speak to the Cat Paw Agent over there to use a basic service.
Oh, and please come back afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
请去那边和猫爪特工对话，以使用基础服务。
哦，之后请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
How disappointing!
But I understand.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
真令人失望！
但我理解。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
We offer one service to new customers.
If you want to use more services, you must do some things for us.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
我们为每位新顾客提供一次服务。
如果您想使用更多服务，就必须为我们做一些事情。

scripts.text: What kind of things?
scripts.translation: 做什么样的事情？

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
For now...
Please catch the main dish of the Cat Trading employees, fish, and collect minerals once every day.
Your credit will increase each day if you do those things.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
目前...
请每天捕捉猫贸易员工的主菜——鱼，并收集一次矿石。
如果您每天完成这些任务，您的信用额度就会增加。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Of course, we'll reward you with a reasonable amount of EXP for the services.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
当然，我们会为您提供合理的经验值作为服务的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
This is a good opportunity to increase your credit and EXP ate the same time.
Doesn't that sound like a win-win situation?
Would you like to start now?
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
这是一个同时增加信用额度和经验值的好机会。
听起来是不是双赢的局面？
您想现在开始吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I need to go prepare first.
scripts.translation: 我需要先准备一下。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Excellent.
For more information about fishing and mining, please speak to the two Cat Agents standing at the river over there.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
太好了。
如需了解钓鱼和采矿的更多信息，请去那边河边找两位猫特工对话。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
No problem.
Please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
没问题。
请慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
For more information about fishing and mining, please speak to the two Cat Agents standing at the river over there.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
如需了解钓鱼和采矿的更多信息，请去那边河边找两位猫特工对话。

scripts.text:
[Fluffy Gyaruk]
Your current credit points with us are ^0000FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[毛茸茸的 吉亚鲁克]
您目前的信用额度为 ^0000FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text: How can I increase my points?
scripts.translation: 我该如何增加点数？

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
You can increase them daily by fishing and mining, you need to submit caught Pieces of Fish to Gorurung and minerals to the Mining Agent.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪特工]
您可以通过每天钓鱼和采矿来增加点数，您需要将捕获的鱼块提交给戈鲁鲁格，将矿石提交给采矿特工。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Grrr....
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
咕噜噜....

scripts.text:
A cat purring like a lion
is looking into the water.
scripts.translation:
一只像狮子一样发出咕噜声的猫
正看着水面。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
I'm busy.
I need to catch fish.
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
我很忙。
我需要抓鱼。

scripts.text: Gyaruk has sent me.
scripts.translation: 吉亚鲁克派我来的。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Gyaruk sent you?
Oh, you are here to fish? *Purr*
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
吉亚鲁克派你来的？
哦，你是来钓鱼的？*咕噜*

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我该做什么？

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You need to catch fish. There are schools of fish in the waters.
It's hard to see them but if you use your cursor to click around, you should be able to catch them.
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你需要抓鱼。水里有鱼群。
虽然很难看清，但如果你用光标在周围点击，应该就能抓到它们。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
It's easier to fish in the water outside the town.
If you're not afraid of monsters, you can go fishing over there.
*Purr*
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
在城镇外的水域钓鱼更容易。
如果你不怕魔物，可以去那边钓鱼。
*咕噜*

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Now, let me teach you how to fish.
It's simple: bring your cursor to a school of fish, and then click it to grab them.
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
现在，让我教你怎么钓鱼。
很简单：把光标移到鱼群上，然后点击它们抓住它们。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You'll have a hard time to catch them at first, but you'll get better.
It gets easier with a bit of practice.
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
一开始你会很难抓到它们，但你会越来越熟练。
练习几次就会变得容易了。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你带来了鱼块！
干得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP {0}^000000

[Ferocious Gorurug]
Bring your cursor to a school of fish, then click it to grab them.
Don't move while doing it!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
把光标移到鱼群上，然后点击它们抓住它们。
操作时不要移动！

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你带来了鱼块！
干得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 15,000^000000

[Ferocious Gorurug]
Do you want to fish again?
Don't forget to bring me
Pieces of Fish if you catch them.
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你想再钓一次吗？
如果你抓到了鱼，
别忘了带鱼块给我。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你带来了鱼块！
干得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 15,000^000000

[Ferocious Gorurug]
Hey, I've been waiting for you!
Good luck fishing today!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
嘿，我一直在等你！
祝你今天钓鱼顺利！

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你带来了鱼块！
干得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 15,000^000000
Gorurug looks happy to see you.
scripts.translation: 戈鲁鲁格看到你很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
What do you want to catch today? *Purr*
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
今天你想抓什么？*咕噜*

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
You've brough Pieces of Fish!
GOOD JOB!
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
你带来了鱼块！
干得好！

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou gain EXP 1,500^000000
Gorurung welcomes you with a happy purr.
scripts.translation: 戈鲁鲁格用快乐的咕噜声欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
Welcome!
You're here to give me fishes, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
欢迎！
你是来给我送鱼的，对吧？

scripts.text: Ferocious Gorurug is asleep.
scripts.translation: 凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格正在睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
*Yawn*
I'm sorry, but I'm off-duty.
I can't accept any fish right now.
Come back tomorrow, alright?
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
*打哈欠*
抱歉，我现在下班了。
我现在不能接收任何鱼。
明天再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ferocious Gorurug]
*Purr*
Another day has started, back to work!
You can now bring me fish if you catch them.
scripts.translation:
[凶猛的 戈鲁鲁格]
*咕噜*
新的一天开始了，继续工作！
如果你抓到了鱼，现在可以带给我了。

scripts.text: Nothing was caught.
scripts.translation: 没有抓到任何东西。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
scripts.translation: 鱼在水里游动。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Congratulations, you've caught a precious Marlin.
I'll give you 2 Cat Trading Points in exchange for your Marlin.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
恭喜，你抓到了一条珍贵的旗鱼。
作为交换，我将给你2个猫爪积分。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
I got them from a black marketer,
but I guarantee the authenticity of these points.
Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
这些积分是我从一个黑市商人那里弄来的，
但我保证它们的真实性。
你有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Thank you for the Marlin.
I've given you the points in return.
You may go check your points through the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
谢谢你的旗鱼。
我已经把积分给你了。
你可以通过猫爪特工查看你的积分。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Alright, if you say so.
But feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
好吧，既然你这么说。
如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
You may have hear
about this already, but
this river is full of rare fish.
I've followed these cats
to see if the rumor is true.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
你可能已经听说了，
这条河里有很多稀有的鱼。
我跟着这些猫来到这里，
想看看传闻是否属实。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
Marlin, the legendary silver
fish is the best prey of all.
You can also catch precious
treasure floating in the river.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
旗鱼，传说中的银色鱼类，
是这里最好的猎物。
你还可以抓到漂浮在河里的珍贵宝物。

scripts.text:
[Henry Clifford]
If you happen to catch a Marlin,
please trade it with me.
I'll give you something
nice in return.
scripts.translation:
[亨利·克利福德]
如果你碰巧抓到旗鱼，
请把它交给我。
我会给你一些不错的回报。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
Oh, wow~
Thank you for collecting minerals for me.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪采矿特派员]
哇哦~
谢谢你帮我收集矿石。

scripts.text: I'm freezing! Take them quickly.
scripts.translation: 我快冻死了！快收走它们。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
Yes, yes~ I've received the mineral samples.
I'll go ahead and add points to your credit.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪采矿特派员]
是的，是的~ 我已经收到矿石样本了。
我会把积分加到你的账户里。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
To collect minerals,
we have to go to the
frozen land to the east.
But for short-haired cats
like me, the weather
is unbearable.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪采矿特派员]
要收集矿石，
我们必须去东边的冻土。
但对于像我这样的短毛猫来说，
那里的天气太难以忍受了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
If the weather
is good tomorrow,
I might try to go,
but not today.
It looks freezing to
you too, doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪采矿特派员]
如果明天天气好，
我可能会去试试，
但今天不行。
看起来对你来说也很冷，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
I hope you'll bring me minerals again tomorrow...
If you can. It's much better to wait for you to do it than go there on my own.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪采矿特派员]
希望明天你还能给我带矿石来...
如果你能的话。等你去带回来比我亲自去好多了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Mining Agent]
Umm... It's time to collect minerals.
How'd you like to collect minerals for me?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪采矿特派员]
嗯... 是时候收集矿石了。
你愿意帮我收集矿石吗？

scripts.text:
This rock contains unidentified minerals.
It's not possible to mine more than the limit.
scripts.translation:
这块岩石含有未确认矿石。
无法开采超过上限的数量。

scripts.text:
Cat trading Point adjust
You can enter the number between 1~3000.
scripts.translation:
猫爪积分调整
你可以输入1~3000之间的数字。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*叹气* 看看我，我曾经指挥着摩洛哥的沙漠，但现在却被部署到一个连上帝都不知道在哪里的世界...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Come on'that's not ture. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition.
Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
别这么说。事实上，你以前只是一个小城镇的官员，后来被提拔为远征队的指挥官。
你的成功简直好得难以置信。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom's scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
嘿，老板。我们能不能就敷衍了事，赶紧离开这里？这个所谓的“阿什真空”太无聊了。对王国的学者来说这是天堂，但对我来说不是。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? It's Commander, alright?
Hmpf! So disrespectful.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
天哪，你能不能别一直叫我老板？我是指挥官，懂吗？
哼！真没礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Can you guys stop complaining?
God...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
你们能不能别抱怨了？
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
你是谁？找阿吉普指挥官有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
什么事？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Err? Hey, aren't you that famous adventurer,{0}? I've heard many good things about you.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
咦？嘿，你难道就是那位著名的冒险者，{0}？我听说过很多关于你的好事。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I don't know what you're talking about. Boss, do you know this adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我不知道你在说什么。老板，你认识这位冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Stop calling me boss! Call me Commander, alright? Hey Abidal, is this adventurer really famous?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
别叫我老板！叫我指挥官，懂吗？嘿，阿比达尔，这位冒险者真的很有名吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Commander, haven't you read the report? The adventurer who helped the expedition solve the XX case was{0}.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
指挥官，您没看报告吗？帮助远征队解决XX事件的冒险者就是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Ahem Ahem* I see. I've been too busy to read all the reports. So what brings you here? A reward?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*咳咳* 原来如此。我最近太忙了，没空看所有的报告。那你来这里是为什么？为了奖励吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
This is perfect. I was going to send a messenger to you for an important discussion.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
真是巧了。我正准备派信使去找您，有一件重要的事要商量。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey Abidal, he's here to see me, not you. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，阿比达尔，他是来见我的，不是见你的。记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Commander, please let me talk. {0}I'd like to talk to you privately. Can you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
指挥官，请让我说。{0}我想和您私下谈谈。您能稍后再回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Why do you want to talk privately?
Is it because of me? Grrr... I'll be watching you, Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
为什么要私下谈？
是因为我吗？哼...我会盯着你的，阿比达尔。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
What are you still doing here? Go, go speak to Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
你还在这里干什么？去吧，去和阿比达尔对话。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm not the one who has business with you. You should go speak to Staff Officer Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我才是和你有公事的人。你应该去和参谋 阿比达尔对话。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Oh yes, right... You're{0}, right? Abidal has told me good things about you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦对了...你是{0}，对吧？阿比达尔跟我说过你的很多好事。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
We're lucky to have you, my friend... I hope you're as good as the stories play you up to be.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
能有你真是我们的幸运，我的朋友...希望你像传说里那样优秀。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Commander, please!
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
指挥官，求您了！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Alright, alright. gosh will you stop yelling at me?
You're not going to live long if you get angry at all the little things.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了好了。天哪，你能不能别对我大吼大叫？
如果你因为一点小事就生气，是活不长久的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Anyways, I took some time to check your background and reports of your accomplishments.
I must say that I'm quite impressed.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
总之，我花了一些时间查阅了你的背景和业绩报告。
不得不说，我相当印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
As you know by now, I have to send out an expedition report to the national leaders of the Midgard continent, and I need someone that I can trust.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
想必你也知道了，我必须向米德加尔特大陆各国的领导人发送远征报告书，而我需要找一个值得信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'd go if I could, but my duty is to command, and my instructor over there is too dense. He'll embarrass me by acting stupid in front of the national leaders.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
要是能去的话我肯定亲自去了，但我的职责是指挥。而且那边的指导员太迟钝了，他会在各国领导人面前做出蠢事，让我丢脸的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Come on, boss... Er, Commander!
Don't you think you're exaggerating?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
拜托了，老板...啊不，指挥官！
您觉得您是不是有点夸张了？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm... Anyways, this is not a difficult mission. All you have to do is deliver this expedition report to officials of three countries of Midgard. Simple right?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...总之，这并不是一项困难的任务。你只需要把这份远征报告书送到米德加尔特三个国家的官员那里就行了。很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
The officials are ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz, and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwatzvalt Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
这些官员分别是：卢恩·米德加兹王国的^0000FF大臣 劳尔^000000、阿鲁纳菲兹的^0000FF牧师 努莉亚^000000，以及施瓦茨瓦尔特共和国的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
A messenger, who will inform the official of your arrival, is waiting for you at the time-space gap to Midgard. You'd better find him before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
在通往米德加尔特的时间空间裂缝处，有一位信使在等你，他会通知官员你的到来。你最好在离开之前找到他。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Since the officials are busy attending to national matters, they won't meet you unless they're informed of your arrival beforehand. I doubt those pretentious guys would even want to see me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
由于官员们正忙于处理国家事务，除非提前通知他们你的到来，否则他们不会见你。我怀疑那些自命不凡的家伙甚至都不愿意见我。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Travel safely, adventurer, and come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
旅途平安，冒险者，记得要全身而退，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Haven't you left yet? It's hard to make ends meet, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你还没走吗？生活不易，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I mean, if you want to be paid, you'll have to work. Do you still not understand? I'm saying that you better proceed with your mission.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我是说，如果你想拿报酬，就得干活。你还没明白吗？我的意思是，你最好赶紧去执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
......
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
......

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了好了。我知道你为什么来见我了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
他们还没收到报告书。我们应该派士兵去...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我担心的不是这个。问题是，负责的人没能完成任务，并且丢失了报告书。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
总之...没关系。你不用感到难过。我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Commander, who might have done this? I will destroy him myself.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
指挥官，是谁干的？我要亲手毁了他。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
别冲动。我们的部队不仅仅来自一个国家，而是来自三个不同的国家，他们在这里是为了追求各自国家的利益。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Hard to say... who is behind this. If I had to guess, either side could be behind this...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
很难说...幕后黑手是谁。如果非要我猜的话，可能是任何一方...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*啐* 这就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比达尔，解决这次事件是你的首要任务。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
伊格丽德，评估一下这个营地的安全状况以及士兵们的纪律。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
现在轮到你了...阿比达尔在利用各部门的报告编写远征队报告书后，就把它们处理掉了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我们非常重视文件的安全。所以...没有远征队报告书的副本。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我至少还记得那份文件30%的内容。也许我能重新写一份...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我需要它完美无缺。只有30%的内容有什么用？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，你必须找到那份报告书。如果你能找回尽可能多的页面，阿比达尔就能用它们来填补缺失的部分。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
有些页面可能已经被魔物吞食，或者流落到了海里，但我不管。不惜一切代价找到它们，这是我的命令。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我希望你能尽力。既然开始了，就要做完。我们会尽力协助你。对吧，大家？阿比达尔？伊格丽德？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Of Course, I'm happy to...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
当然，我很乐意...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
......
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
......

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了，到处去找那份报告书的页面吧。参谋阿比达尔会把它们装订成完整的报告书。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, and... I've received a report that you tried to hand out the report to our enemy when the situation happened.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，还有...我收到报告说，在事发时你试图把报告书交给我们的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Argh...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hahaha! You're smart, my friend. Of course, I don't like smart soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哈哈！你很聪明，我的朋友。当然，我不喜欢聪明的士兵。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me tell you this: I can care less about justice or righteousness, but loyalty and faithfulness are very important. Keep that in mind for your own good, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
让我告诉你：正义或公理我毫不在意，但忠诚和信义非常重要。为了你好，记住这一点，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
祝你在寻找页面时好运。找到后记得把上面的污渍清理干净，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
......
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
......

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了好了。我知道你为什么来见我了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
他们还没收到报告书。我们应该派士兵去...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我担心的不是这个。问题是，负责的人没能完成任务，并且丢失了报告书。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
总之...没关系。你不用感到难过。我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Commander, I'll go find those evil scoundrels...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
指挥官，我去找那些卑鄙小人...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
别冲动。我们的部队不仅仅来自一个国家，而是来自三个不同的国家，他们在这里是为了追求各自国家的利益。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I wonder who's behind this. Frankly, I must say that every country is a suspect.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
不知道幕后黑手是谁。老实说，每个国家都是嫌疑人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*啐* 这就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比达尔，解决这次事件是你的首要任务。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
伊格丽德，评估一下这个营地的安全状况以及士兵们的纪律。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
现在轮到你了...阿比达尔在利用各部门的报告编写远征队报告书后，就把它们处理掉了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我们非常重视文件的安全。所以...没有远征队报告书的副本。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我至少还记得那份文件30%的内容。也许我能重新写一份...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我需要它完美无缺。只有30%的内容有什么用？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，你必须找到那份报告书。如果你能找回尽可能多的页面，阿比达尔就能用它们来填补缺失的部分。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
有些页面可能已经被魔物吞食，或者流落到了海里，但我不管。不惜一切代价找到它们，这是我的命令。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我希望你能尽力。既然开始了，就要做完。我们会尽力协助你。对吧，大家？阿比达尔？伊格丽德？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Of Course, I'm happy to...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
当然，我很乐意...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
......
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
......

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了，到处去找那份报告书的页面吧。参谋阿比达尔会把它们装订成完整的报告书。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, and... I've received a report that you fought hard against the enemy to protect the report from them.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，还有...我收到报告说，你为了从敌人手中保护报告书而奋力战斗。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Umm...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hahaha, you're fearless and I can make good use of a soldier like you at any time of the day.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哈哈，你真是无所畏惧。像你这样的士兵，无论何时我都能派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me tell you this, loyalty and faithfulness are very, very important. They may cause you hardship sometimes, but those qualities will guarantee you the last laugh.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
让我告诉你，忠诚和信义非常重要。它们有时可能会让你陷入困境，但这些品质终将让你笑到最后。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
祝你在寻找页面时好运。找到后记得把上面的污渍清理干净，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Talk to my staff officer until you're finisehd finding the pages of the lost report. Right now, I'm swarmed with work.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
在找到遗失报告的所有页面之前，请和我的参谋多交流。我现在被工作包围了，忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm sure you'll easily find those if you keep your eyes open. I must warn you about the monsters around this area though. Who knows? They might love the taste of paper.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
只要你留心观察，应该很容易找到它们。不过我要提醒你，这一带有很多魔物。谁知道呢？它们可能很喜欢纸张的味道。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
How have you been doing? I've heard Igrid has personally send out his soldiers to support you guys.
Haven't you met them?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
最近过得怎么样？听说伊格丽德亲自派出了士兵来支援你们。
你们见过他们了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
While searching for the report, look around and meet our soldiers.
They've been sent to help you and Abidal. Ask their help if you think you need it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
在寻找报告的过程中，四处看看，认识一下我们的士兵吧。
他们被派来协助你和阿比达尔。如果你觉得需要帮助，尽管向他们求助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So, the report has been restored successfully?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那么，报告已经成功复原了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
This was finished more quickly than I thought. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
这比我预想的完成得更快。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It looks alright. I don't have to read this thoroughly because I trust Abidal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
看起来没问题。因为我相信阿比达尔，所以我不需要逐字逐句地仔细检查。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now, let's go back to your original mission. I'd like you to deliver this to the national leaders of the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好了，让我们回到你最初的任务上。我希望你能将这份报告送达米德加尔特三个国家的国家领导人手中。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Dont worry too much, my friend.
I've arranged troops in the time-space gap to protect the report.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
别太担心，我的朋友。
我已经在时空裂隙中安排了部队来保护这份报告。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Of course, you can't see them because they're undercover soldiers under my direct command. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
当然，你看不见他们，因为他们是直接受我指挥的卧底士兵。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
让我再提醒你一次。官员是这三位：卢恩·米德加兹王国的^0000FF大臣 劳尔^000000、阿鲁纳菲兹的^0000FF牧师 努莉亚^000000，以及修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
让我再提醒你一次。官员是这三位：卢恩·米德加兹王国的^0000FF大臣 劳尔^000000、阿鲁纳菲兹的^0000FF牧师 努莉亚^000000，以及修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Is something wrong? Alright, we'll write another report for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
出什么事了吗？好吧，我们会为你再写一份报告。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
让我再提醒你一次。官员是这三位：卢恩·米德加兹王国的^0000FF大臣 劳尔^000000、阿鲁纳菲兹的^0000FF牧师 努莉亚^000000，以及修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
让我再提醒你一次。官员是这三位：卢恩·米德加兹王国的^0000FF大臣 劳尔^000000、阿鲁纳菲兹的^0000FF牧师 努莉亚^000000，以及修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的^0000FF格哈特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Oh, how was your trip? Hey, you look better than you did when you left. Did you drop by your hometown and enjoy great food or something?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦，旅途如何？嘿，你看起来比出发时气色好多了。难道你顺路回了趟家乡，享受了美食之类的吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So tell me, did you bring the report to all three national leaders? Good job.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那么告诉我，你把报告带给三位国家领导人了吗？干得好。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I understand there were some unforeseen obstacles we didn't anticipate since we thought this mission was pretty trivial, but you still did your best.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我听说过程中出现了一些我们未曾预料的障碍，毕竟我们原本以为这项任务相当简单，但你依然尽力了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I must warn you, however, this is not the end of these strange events. You're involved in this situation so deeply that you can't get out of it. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
不过我必须警告你，这些奇怪的事件并没有结束。你已深陷其中，无法脱身。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Don't worry. I'm not here to fool around. Isn't that right?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
别担心。我可不是在这里开玩笑的。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Yes, sir. We can't let the same thing happen again.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
是的，长官。我们不能让同样的事情再次发生。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I shall find out who's behind this, and destroy him.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我会查明幕后黑手是谁，并将其消灭。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So... I was hoping that you'll come back and help us once we figure out who's behind this. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那么...等我们查明幕后黑手是谁后，希望你能回来帮助我们。你愿意吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
And please take this small reward.
Thank you for your help so far.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
请收下这份小小的谢礼。
感谢你一直以来的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Then I'll see you next time. Keep yourself in one piece, alright?
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那我们下次再见。保重身体，别受伤了，好吗？
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, how have you been? It's too early to say that we've figured out who's the mastermind.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，最近怎么样？现在就说我们已经查明了幕后黑手还为时过早。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Please be patient, I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
请耐心等待，时机成熟时我会联系你。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Wait, have you explored this area yet? I mean the wide tundra and fields around the camp.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
等等，你探索过这片区域了吗？我是说营地周围广阔的苔原和原野。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
There are many fun things outside. If you are an adventurer, go explore for yourself. Come back after you've explored the areas around the camp.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
外面有很多有趣的东西。既然你是冒险者，就自己去探索一下吧。探索完营地周围的区域后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, it's you again. So, are you accustomed to this area now?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，又是你。那么，你现在习惯这片区域了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What brings you here again? You seem to have something to say to me.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你这次来有什么事吗？看起来你似乎有话想对我说。

scripts.text: I just want to say hello.
scripts.translation: 只是想打个招呼。

scripts.text: I found a weird portal below the mine cave.
scripts.translation: 我在矿洞下方发现了一个奇怪的传送门。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Well hello then...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦，你好啊...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Please be patient. I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
请耐心等待，时机成熟时我会联系你。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What portal? I've never heard about it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
什么传送门？我从未听说过。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
That place must be where both races fight against each other. It might be dangerous there.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那个地方应该是两个种族互相战斗的地方。那里可能很危险。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I have no idea of what it is like. It is not in my field of expertise.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我完全不知道那里是什么样子。这不在我的专业范围内。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
There is someone here who can help you. He is a historian from Rune-Midgarts. He may be aware of some relics or something that could help.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
这里有一位能帮到你的人。他是来自卢恩·米德加兹的历史学家。他可能了解一些遗迹或其他能帮到你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Find the historian and see if he has any useful information for you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找那位历史学家，看看他是否有对你有用的资讯。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
He's at his post, you can't find him?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他就在他的岗位上，你找不到他？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
His name is Magniffer... look for him.. he's somewhere around here...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他叫马格尼弗...去找找他...他应该就在这附近...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Did you talk with the scholar? Thesedays, I haven't seen him for a while.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你和那位学者谈过了吗？最近这段时间，我没怎么见到他。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
That's because you don't like talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
那是因为你不想和他说话。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hey, don't judge me like that...the problem is only that I can't see him often.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嘿，别那样评判我...问题只是我很少见到他而已。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Whatever. Did something happen because he showed up to me? Tell me more.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
算了。是因为他向我显现才发生了什么事吗？告诉我更多细节。

scripts.text: Tell the story.
scripts.translation: 讲述故事

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmmm... umm... so...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...唔...所以...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So, that's why that happened like that... It's so complicated...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
原来事情是这样发生的...真是复杂啊...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
And you guys...you just take a task that you start up at first.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
还有你们...你们只是接手了一个一开始就开启的任务。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
You sent him to Doctor Magnifer first....
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
你最初是让他去找医生马格尼弗的....

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I just thought that he needed someone to talk to.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我只是觉得他需要有人倾诉。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Ah yeah... you're right.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
啊，是啊...你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm... for example, you want to investigate a cave that you found, but you got on the Laphine and Sapha's nerves. right?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...比如说，你想调查一个发现的洞穴，但这惹恼了拉芬和萨法。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
And that two guys pay attention and stay quiet, but they are doing it for themselves..
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
而那两个人虽然保持沉默并密切关注，但他们这么做是为了他们自己..

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
The most important thing is that this place is the ground that the Yggdrasilberry takes root acording to Magnifer.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
最重要的是，根据马格尼弗的说法，这里是世界树之果扎根之地。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Abidal, do you have anything to say about this?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
阿比达尔，你对这件事有什么看法吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Our object is to make contact with one tribe and investgate this world and how adaptable it can be.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们的目标是与一个部落建立联系，并调查这个世界以及它的适应性。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Actually, we don't have to make this situation bigger than it already is.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
实际上，我们没必要让局势比现在更严重。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah right. I don't want to extend this thing anymore...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
没错。我也不想把事情闹得更大...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
But the two tribes have remained neutral towards us up until now.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
不过到目前为止，这两个部落对我们一直持中立态度。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We don't really know what attitude they have towards us.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们并不清楚他们对我们到底持什么态度。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah.. that makes sense... If they made a general attack, we would probably fail.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...有道理...如果他们发动全面进攻，我们恐怕会失败。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We should map out a strategy. There is a method that uses Laphine and Sapha's together.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们应该制定一个策略。有一种方法可以结合拉芬和萨法的力量。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We send this guy to one of the tribes and ask for cooperation in our investigation.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们派这个人去其中一个部落，请求他们在调查中与我们合作。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Will they help us? They have already said threatening words...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他们会帮我们的忙吗？他们之前已经说过威胁的话了...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Of course they will help us. if they reject our demand, we just say that we'll ask for help from the other tribe.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
当然会帮我们的。如果他们拒绝我们的要求，我们就说会向另一个部落求助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Right, if we do that, they will have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
没错，如果我们这么做，他们别无选择。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
In this situation, they want to avoid showing that place to the other tribe.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
在这种情况下，他们不想让另一个部落知道那个地方。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
So, they have to cooperate with us.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
所以，他们必须与我们合作。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Oh, you have a malicious idea.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
哦，你有个阴险的主意。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
That's called that Kuhotanrangjigea from east. I didn't make that by myself.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
这叫“以彼之道，还施彼身”。不是我一个人想出来的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Whatever.. Hey, you there... your name is {0} right? Do you know what to do?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
算了...嘿，你...你的名字叫{0}对吧？你知道该怎么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to one of the tribes and ask for help officially. I'll send someone to the other tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去其中一个部落，正式请求他们的帮助。我会派人去另一个部落。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to give you a choice. Which tribe do you want to go to?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我会给你一个选择。你想去哪个部落？

scripts.text: Laphine
scripts.translation: 拉芬

scripts.text: Sapha
scripts.translation: 萨法

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
好吧，那么责任就交给你了。从现在开始，你要专注于在拉芬那里建立良好的声誉。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It won't be easy to get a good impression from the Sapha again.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
要在萨法那里重新获得好印象并不容易。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
So you must earn us a good reputation from the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
所以，你必须为我们从拉芬那里赢得良好的声誉。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Will you choose the Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你会选择拉芬吗？

scripts.text: Choose Laphine.
scripts.translation: 选择拉芬

scripts.text: Think again.
scripts.translation: 再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
很好。现在，建立我们与拉芬部落的关系就是你的责任了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Go to the chief of the Laphine and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
去找拉芬的首领，如果他不接受我们的请求，就告诉他你们打算向萨法寻求帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
任务已下达！现在我要去找一个愿意被派往萨法的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yeah? Then think again and decide.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是吗？那就再考虑一下，做出决定吧。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Sapha.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
任务已下达！现在我要去找一个愿意被派往拉芬的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
How's the activity in Laphine? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
拉芬那边的情况如何？他们的性格很严厉。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我不适合和他们打交道...呕...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to send a few able men to the Sapha, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我会派几个得力的人去萨法，你不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
How's the activity in Sapha? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
萨法那边的情况如何？他们的性格很严厉。

scripts.text:

I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation:
