scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm going to send a few able men to the Laphine, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我会派几个得力的人去拉芬，你不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You've come back alive? Let us celebrate your immunity!
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你竟然活着回来了？让我们庆祝一下你的“不死之身”吧！

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Who would have thought that that outsiders would be treated so vulgar by the leaders of the other tribes?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
谁能想到，那些外人竟然会被其他部落的首领如此粗鲁地对待？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I have said before this thing is not the last, and certainly there is something waiting for us.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我之前说过，事情还没完，肯定……有什么……在等着我们。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
It is time for us to head out, is it not, instructor?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是时候出发了，不是吗，指导员？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Right... It's time...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
是的……是时候了...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I'm ready.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I am looking forward to what will happen... Whew...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我很期待接下来会发生什么...呼...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*叹气* 看看我，我曾经指挥着摩洛哥的沙漠，但现在却被部署到一个连上帝都不知道在哪里的世界...

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Come on, that's not true. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition. Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
拜托了，别这么说。事实上，你以前只是个小城镇的官员，现在却成了远征军的指挥官。你的成功简直好得难以置信。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
嘿，老板。我们能不能就敷衍一下，赶紧离开这里？这个所谓的“阿什真空”太无聊了。这对王国的学者来说是天堂，但对我来说不是。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? I'm the Commander, alright? So disrespectful.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
天哪，你能不能别叫我老板？我是指挥官，懂吗？太没礼貌了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Can you guys stop complaining? God...
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
你们能不能别抱怨了？天哪...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
你是谁？找阿吉普指挥官有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
What is it? If you have too much time on your hands, you'd better go outside and find something productive to do.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
怎么了？如果你们闲得发慌，最好出去找点有意义的事情做。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Phew, I'm glad the mission is over. Thank you so much for your help.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
呼，很高兴任务结束了。非常感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We'll contact you again when we have another mission for you. I hope we can count on your help again when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
当我们有新的任务时，会再次联系你。希望到时候还能得到你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I'm Staff Officer Abidal of the Midgard Expedition. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我是米德加尔特远征军的参谋 阿比达尔。有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Midgard Expedition Introduction
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特远征军介绍

scripts.text: Midgard Expedition's Achievement
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特远征军的成就

scripts.text: Situation in the Ash-Vacuum
scripts.translation: 阿什真空的情况

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
The Midgard Expedition is conducted by a group of explorers from the three countries of Midgard and the Mercenary Association. We're here to explore the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
米德加尔特远征军由来自米德加尔特三国的探险家以及佣兵协会的成员组成。我们在此探索阿什真空。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Command Hibba Agip behind me is our commander. He may appear unreliable, but he has extensive knowledge and experience in exploration.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
站在我身后的指挥官是希巴·阿吉普。他看起来可能不太靠谱，但在探险方面拥有广博的知识和丰富的经验。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We have many aides and scholars to support our expedition.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们有许多助手和学者支持这次远征。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, you may know this already, but Commander Agip isn't from any of the three countries. Neither am I or Instructor Igrid.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
哦，您可能已经知道了，但指挥官阿吉普并不属于三国中的任何一个。我和指导员 伊格丽德也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
There's an obvious power struggle among the three countries to assign their officers to the commander position.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
三国之间在指派军官担任指挥官一职上存在明显的权力斗争。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
As a last resort, they had to select Commander Agip since he's unaffiliated with any of those countries, but is talented enough to lead the expedition.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
作为最后的手段，他们不得不选择指挥官阿吉普，因为他不隶属于任何一国，且具备领导远征的才能。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We, the commanders, Igrid, and I aren't used to the leadership role. We're having trouble taking care of everything that's happening. *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们——指挥官、伊格丽德和我——并不习惯领导角色。我们很难应对正在发生的一切。*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
The members of the Midgard Expedition are conducting various kinds of research about the Ash-Vacuum searching for possible living creatures and studying what might be beneficial for the development of the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
米德加尔特远征军的成员正在进行各种研究，探索阿什真空，寻找可能的生物，并研究其对大陆发展的潜在益处。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
If you look around, you'll find many people in need of your help. Enjoy your stay in the otherworld, and feel free to ask me if you have questions.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
如果您四处看看，会发现许多需要您帮助的人。祝您在这个异世界度过愉快的时光，如有任何问题，请随时向我提问。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We're still at an early stage of the expedition, so we haven't made any major achievements. That's why we need help from adventurers like you.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们的远征仍处于早期阶段，因此尚未取得重大成就。这就是为什么我们需要像您这样的冒险者的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
If you look around this camp, you'll find many opportunities to help us. We always welcome every bit of help.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
如果您看看这个营地，会发现许多帮助我们机会。我们欢迎任何形式的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
So far, only a few truths about the Ash-Vacuum have been revealed.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
到目前为止，关于阿什真空的真相只揭示了一小部分。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
We now know there's a demihuman race in this otherworld, but we're too busy figuring out the true nature of the time-space gap, let alone study the demihuman race in depth.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我们现在知道这个异世界存在半人种族，但我们正忙于弄清时空裂隙的本质，更不用说深入研究半人种族了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
My advice for you will be to be careful when you encounter members of that race. Who knows? They might be extremely hostile toward other races.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我的建议是，当您遇到该种族的成员时要小心。谁知道呢？他们可能对其他种族极度敌视。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, and take heed, unidentified creatures appear outside the camp during nighttime. Be careful of them, too.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
哦，请注意，夜间营地外会出现不明生物。也要小心它们。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, welcome back. I apologize for troubling you like this. I didn't feel to comfortable talking to you back there.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
哦，欢迎回来。很抱歉这样打扰您。刚才在那里和您说话时，我有点不自在。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
In fact, I have a favor to ask of you. From what I know of your accomplishments you're the right person for this.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
事实上，我有一事相求。据我所知，您的成就表明您是合适的人选。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
On behalf of the expedition, I'd like to give you a mission. Would you like to accept it?
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
代表远征军，我想给您一个任务。您愿意接受吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Thank you so much. I had a good feeling about you, and I was so sure that you'd be willing to help.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
非常感谢。我对您有一种良好的感觉，我确信您愿意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Let's cut to the chase. The mission is simple, deliver our expedition report to the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
直入正题吧。任务很简单，将我们的远征报告送达米德加尔特三国。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
But I have to tell you... We sent out three adventurers on this mission before you, and they all dissapeared. Please don't disclose this information to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
但我必须告诉您...在您之前，我们曾派出三名冒险者执行这项任务，但他们全都失踪了。请不要将此事透露给任何人。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
The commander or I cannot leave this camp, even though delivering the report is one of our most important duties. That's why I need someone reliable and trustworthy like you.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
指挥官和我都无法离开营地，尽管递交报告是我们最重要的职责之一。所以我需要像您这样可靠且值得信赖的人。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Phew, I'm so glad that you've accepted this mission. Now, please go receive the report from the commander. He'll officially assign you to the mission.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
呼，很高兴您接受了这个任务。现在，请去指挥官那里领取报告。他会正式指派您执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I'll prepare for your departure.
Please go speak to the commander.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我会为您出发做好准备。
请去和指挥官对话。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, I see... Then can you help me whenever you have some time?
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
哦，我明白了...那么，当您有空的时候，能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
This is urgent, please think it over and come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
这件事很紧急，请再考虑一下，如果您改变主意了，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I've reported to the commander about your decision to help us.
Please go speak to him.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我已经向指挥官汇报了您决定帮助我们的事。
请去和他对话。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
You've been assinged to the mission officially. Good luck, and I hope you'll come back safely.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
让我们看看报告的修复进展如何。
[参谋 阿比达尔]
您已修复报告的第一卷、第二卷和第三卷。还剩1卷待修复。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Let's see how far we've progressed on the report's restoration.
[Staff Officer Abidal]
You have restored the second, third and fourth volume of the report. There is 1 volume left to restore.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
让我们看看报告的修复进展如何。
[参谋 阿比达尔]
您已修复报告的第二卷、第三卷和第四卷。还剩1卷待修复。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Oh, great! Every volume of the report has been restored. I'll bind them into one book for you.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
太好了！报告的所有卷册都已修复完毕。我会把它们装订成一本书。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I'm glad that we were able to make this again. Please bring this report to the commander.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
很高兴我们能把这份报告重新整理出来。请把它交给指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Phew, I'm glad we can resume the mission again.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
呼，太好了，我们可以继续执行任务了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
...您还不走吗？我想您该离开了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
I heard that you got a new duty from Commander Agip.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
我听说您从阿吉普指挥官那里接到了新的任务。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
...您还不走吗？我想您该离开了。

scripts.text:
[Staff Officer Abidal]
Hello, I'm Staff Officer Abidal. Safe travels, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[参谋 阿比达尔]
您好，我是参谋阿比达尔。一路顺风，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, rookies. I guess you were lucky enough to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
嘿，新人。看来你们运气不错，顺利完成了任务。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
This is not the end. Keep yourself in one piece until we need your services again.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
这还不是结束。在我们需要你们再次服役之前，请保持好状态。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I'm Instructor Igrid of the Midgard Expedition. I'm in charge of training and commanding soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我是米德加尔特远征队的指导员伊格丽德。我负责士兵的训练和指挥。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You must want to become an official member of our expedition.
I'm sorry, but you're too weak to endure my intensive training.
Give up before you get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
您一定想成为我们远征队的正式成员吧。
很抱歉，您太弱了，无法承受我的强化训练。
在受伤之前放弃吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If you have too much time on your hands, look around. There's plenty of chores available for so-called adventurers's like you.
If you do your best to do them, I might accept you as a trainee on this expedition.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
如果你闲得发慌，就四处转转吧。像你这种所谓的冒险者，有的是杂活可以干。
如果你能尽力完成，我或许会接受你成为这次远征的学员。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I don't trust you. Hm. Sorry. I don't really have the right to say that if the commander has assigned you to the mission.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我不信任你。嗯。抱歉。如果指挥官已经指派你执行任务，我其实没有资格这么说。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If you're going to give up, give up now. That'll be better for both of us.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
如果你打算放弃，现在就放弃吧。这样对我们双方都好。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I knew you couldn't do it. Didn't I tell you to give up when you had the chance?!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我就知道你做不成。我是不是告诉过你，有机会就放弃？！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Do you think I'm doing this for you? No, I'm just using this chance to discipline idle soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
你以为我这么做是为了你吗？不，我只是借这个机会管教一下那些无所事事的士兵。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
What are you looking at? Go mind your own business!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
你在那看什么？管好你自己的事！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I am Expedition Training Instructor Igrid, and the commander responsible for training soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 伊格丽德]
我是远征队训练指导员伊格丽德，负责士兵训练的指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Welcome, I've been waiting for you.
You must be {0}. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
欢迎，我一直在等你。
想必你就是{0}吧。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Let me check something quicly. You received the report directly from the commander, didn't you? May I see it?
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
让我快速确认一下。你是直接从指挥官那里收到报告的吧？可以给我看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Excellent. Thank you. Then we'll go back to the mainland and let the leaders know that you, {0}, have departed.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
很好。谢谢。那么我们要回大陆了，并通知首领们，你，{0}，已经出发了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Guys, it's time to go.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
大家，该走了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
You, head to Schwaltzval Republic.
And you, take Arunafeltz. I'll visit Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
你，去施瓦茨瓦尔共和国。
你，去阿鲁纳菲兹。我要去普隆德拉王宫。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
I'll see you guys later.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
What's up? Why haven't you left...?
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
怎么了？为什么还没走...？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Argh... Why are you doing this?!
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
啊...你为什么要这么做？！

scripts.text:
[???]
Give me the report.
scripts.translation:
[???]
把报告给我。

scripts.text: Give the report.
scripts.translation: 交出报告

scripts.text: Protect the report.
scripts.translation: 保护报告

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Wha... What are you doing? You can't give up the report...
Awww...
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
什...你在做什么？你不能交出报告...
啊...

scripts.text:
[???]
Give it to me, now!
scripts.translation:
[???]
现在，把它交给我！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* Oh, thank god! {0}, please take the report and run!
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
*咳* 谢天谢地！{0}，请拿着报告快跑！

scripts.text:
[???]
No... Noooo!

[Expedition Messenger]
Argh... {0}, are you alright? The report... The report...
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
呃...{0}，你没事吧？报告...报告...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
We lost the report. The pages are blowing away!
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
我们丢失了报告。纸张正在四处飞散！

scripts.text:
[???]
Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哈哈，虽然我没能拿到报告，但让它被毁掉总比落在你们手里好！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Are you alright? What about the report... ?
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
你没事吧？报告怎么样了...？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* The report is out of our reach now...
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
*咳* 报告现在已经不在我们的掌控之中了...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
If we mobilize all our troops to search this entire area...
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
如果我们动员所有部队搜索这一整个区域...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
We must report this to the commander before anything else.
{0}, please report to the commander immidiatly. Let us take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
在一切之前，我们必须向指挥官汇报此事。
{0}，请立即向指挥官汇报。剩下的交给我们处理。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Yes, please report to the commander...
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
是的，请向指挥官汇报...

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, yeah? Then I'll have to use force!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，是吗？那我只能动武了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Argh!

[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* Oh, thank god! {0}, please take the report and run!
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
*咳* 谢天谢地！{0}，请拿着报告快跑！

scripts.text:
[???]
No... Noooo!

[Expedition Messenger]
Argh... {0}, are you alright? The report... The report...
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
呃...{0}，你没事吧？报告...报告...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
We lost the report. The pages are blowing away!
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
我们丢失了报告。纸张正在四处飞散！

scripts.text:
[???]
Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[???]
哈哈，虽然我没能拿到报告，但让它被毁掉总比落在你们手里好！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Are you alright? What about the report... ?
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
你没事吧？报告怎么样了...？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
*Cough* The report is out of our reach now...
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
*咳* 报告现在已经不在我们的掌控之中了...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
If we mobilize all our troops to search this entire area...
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
如果我们动员所有部队搜索这一整个区域...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
We must report this to the commander before anything else.
{0}, please report to the commander immidiatly. Let us take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
在一切之前，我们必须向指挥官汇报此事。
{0}，请立即向指挥官汇报。剩下的交给我们处理。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
Yes, please report to the commander...
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
是的，请向指挥官汇报...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Were you assigned to deliver the expedition report?
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
你是被指派来运送远征队报告书的吗？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
I'm sorry, but I don't see any report in your hands. Please bring me the report, so I can confirm your identification.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
抱歉，我没看到您手里拿着报告书。请带报告书来找我，以便我核实您的身份。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Please hurry up and report this incident to the commander.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
请赶快向指挥官汇报这起事故。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Messenger]
Good day! I'm here, just waiting for someone. Well, that's my duty.
scripts.translation:
[远征队信使]
你好！我在这里等人。嗯，这是我的职责。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
......
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
......

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -
scripts.translation: - 当你试图与他交谈时，他凭空消失了。他看起来像是正在执行一项非常重要的任务... -

scripts.text:
[Expedition Agent]
...
scripts.translation:
[远征队特派员]
...

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -
scripts.translation: - 当你试图与他交谈时，他凭空消失了。他看起来像是正在执行一项非常重要的任务... -

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Good day. I'm from the Third Scout Party under direct command of the commander of the Midgard Expedition.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
你好。我是米德加尔特远征队指挥官直属的第三侦察队成员。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
I've been ordered by Instructor Igrid to conduct a search for something.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
我受指导员伊格丽德之命，正在搜寻某样东西。

scripts.text: Ask about search results.
scripts.translation: 询问搜寻结果

scripts.text: Chitchat.
scripts.translation: 闲聊

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Oh, you must be{0}. I heard that you'll be delivering the report.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
哦，您一定是{0}。我听说您负责运送报告书。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Searching for lost pages was tougher then I expected. Please come back later when I'm finished making one round.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
搜寻丢失的纸张比我预想的要困难。请等我完成一轮搜寻后再来。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Good news! I've found {0} pieces of paper that appear to be part of the report.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
好消息！我找到了{0}张看起来像是报告书一部分的纸张。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
I'm doing my best, but I haven't found any pages yet.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
我正在尽力，但还没找到任何纸张。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Well then, keep up the good work!
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
那么，请继续加油！

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Who are you? Why do you want to know about our search results? Are you from the army?
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
你是谁？为什么想知道我们的搜寻结果？你是军队的吗？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Man, don't you know that you can be arrested for interrupting a military operation?
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
天哪，你不知道干扰军事行动会被逮捕吗？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
Please leave immediately.
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
请立即离开。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Scout]
I'm sorry, but I'm on duty. Why don't we talk later when I'm off-duty?
scripts.translation:
[远征队侦察兵]
抱歉，我正在执勤。我们改天我下班后再聊吧？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
I'm Laur, the aide of the Home Minister of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
我是劳尔，卢恩·米德加兹王国的大臣。您有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Why are you back? You've delivered the report to me already. Are you suffering from amnesia or something?
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
你怎么又回来了？你不是已经把报告书交给我了吗？你是失忆了吗？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Oh, you brought me the report from the Midgard Expedition. What took you so long? I received a message about your departure a long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
哦，你带来了米德加尔特远征队的报告书。怎么花了这么久？我很久以前就收到你出发的消息了。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Well, tell the commander that I'm not happy with your tardiness. Now, give me the report.
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
好吧，告诉指挥官我对你们的迟到很不满意。现在，把报告书给我。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
I knew it was the wrong idea to out a mercenary in the commander position. See, nothing is done on time. Gosh!
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
我就知道让佣兵担任指挥官是个错误的决定。看吧，什么事都没能准时完成。真是的！

scripts.text:
[Laur]
*Ahem Ahem* Thank you for bringing me the report. I guess I was wrong about the commander. This report is actually very well done.
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
*咳咳* 谢谢你把报告书带给我。看来是我误会指挥官了。这份报告书做得非常好。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
But don't forget to tell him that I need the expedition reports on time from now on. Alright? *Ahem*
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
但别忘了告诉他，从现在开始，米德加尔特远征队的报告书必须准时交上来。明白了吗？*咳*

scripts.text:
[Laur]
You should leave and go back to your work.
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
你该走了，回去工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Can you sense the great disorder occuring on the Midgard Continent and the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
你能感受到米德加尔特大陆和卢恩·米德加兹王国正在发生的巨大动荡吗？

scripts.text:
[Laur]
Still, there always a silver lining, no matter how dangerous this world may become.
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
不过，无论这个世界变得多么危险，总有一线希望。

scripts.text:
[Laur]
There is hope and opportunity beyond the chaos, and I see the world beyond the time-space gap as a source of new hope.
scripts.translation:
[劳尔]
在混沌之外，存在着希望与机遇。我透过时空裂隙看到的，正是新希望的源泉。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Welcome, stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
欢迎，陌生人。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Oh, right, I already received the report from you. Don't worry, you didn't forget.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
哦，对了，我已经收到你的报告书了。别担心，你没有忘记。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Good day, stranger. May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
祝你有美好的一天，陌生人。愿芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Oh, I see. You've brought me a report from the expedition beyond the time-space gap.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
哦，我明白了。你带给我的是来自时空裂隙之外的远征报告书。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
I regret admitting that you've brought it much later than I expected, but... I'm glad it is here safely. Please give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
很遗憾，你交得比我预期的晚了很多，但...很高兴它安全地送到了。请把它给我。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
I'm happy to see that they've made good progress so far. Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
很高兴看到他们取得了良好的进展。请告诉指挥官继续保持。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Excuse me, but it's time to pray now. Please be safe on your travels.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
抱歉，现在是祈祷的时间了。请一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Nuria]
Please be safe on your way back to the expedition camp.
scripts.translation:
[努莉亚]
请平安返回远征营地。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Welcome, {0}. What took you so long?
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
欢迎，{0}。怎么现在才来？

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
What is it? Do you still have business with me?
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
什么事？你还有事找我？

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
What is it? I don't have time for chitchat.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
什么事？我没时间闲聊。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Oh, who am I? Let's say... That you can make ends meet because of me.
Make sense?
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
哦，我是谁？这么说吧...多亏了我，你才能勉强糊口。
懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Do you know how long I waited for this report? *Sigh* ...Fine, just give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
你知道我等这份报告书等了多久吗？*叹气* ...算了，给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Hmmm... This report is a clear demonstration of Commander Hibba Agip's competence... Well, that's great.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
嗯...这份报告书清楚地展示了指挥官希巴·阿吉普的能力...好吧，那很好。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Thank you for bringing the report.
Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
谢谢你送来了报告书。
请告诉指挥官，继续保持这种良好的工作状态。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
Now excuse me, I must go back to work.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
那么失陪了，我得回去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
I've received the report safely.
Please go back to the commander, and tell him to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
报告书已安全收到。
请回到指挥官那里，告诉他继续保持这种良好的工作状态。

scripts.text:
[Gerhart]
If you have business with me. please talk to my secretary and schedule an appointment. My office is on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
如果您有公事找我，请和我的秘书预约时间。我的办公室在二楼。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh adventurer, you've come at the perfect time.
Since you and I both know that we can't waste time on idle chitchat,
I'll cut to the chase.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
哦，冒险者，你来得正是时候。
既然你我都知道不能把时间浪费在闲聊上，
那我就直入正题了。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Most expeditions come to this area to explore the Ash Vacuum,
but we've come here for a different reason.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
大多数探险队来到这片区域是为了探索阿什真空，
但我们来这里是为了别的原因。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
You know about this space gap that was caused by Satan Morocc, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你知道魔王梦罗克造成的这个空间裂隙，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Our job is to pursue Satan Morocc and figure out how this all happened.
Your job is to assist us, and prove that you can be a good member of our expedition.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我们的任务是追踪魔王梦罗克，弄清楚这一切是如何发生的。
你的任务是协助我们，并证明你能成为我们探险队的好成员。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
... Umm... So, you'll have to.. Let me think which job would be perfect for you.
Umm.. I remember someone said that he needed assistance...
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
...嗯...所以，你得...让我想想哪个职位最适合你。
嗯...我记得有人说过他需要助手...

scripts.text: Hey, excuse me.
scripts.translation: 嘿，打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Ah, I know what you can do!
There's a guy conducting an investigation near the space gap. You can go help him.
Just do what he asks you to do, alright?
Now go!
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
啊，我知道你能做什么了！
有个家伙正在空间裂隙附近进行调查。你可以去帮他。
只要照他说的做就行了，好吗？
现在去吧！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
......
By the way, adventurer,
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
......
顺便问一下，冒险者，
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Ah, you are
{0}.
Well, {1}, I've just assigned you as Mr. Kidd's assistant.
Good, everything's done on this end. I just needed to get your name on record.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
啊，你是
{0}。
好吧，{1}，我刚把你指派为基德先生的助手。
很好，这边的手续都办完了。我只是需要把你的名字记录下来。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What are you still doing here?
{0}, your job is to assist Mr. Kidd.
Please go help him, will you?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你还在这里干什么？
{0}，你的工作是协助基德先生。
请去帮他，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What are you doing here?
Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
Go back to the mainland as quickly as possible.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你在这里做什么？
只有授权人员才能进入这个区域。
请尽快返回大陆。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Your job is to assist Mr. Kidd who's standing near the space gap, otherwise known as the gate.
Please go help him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你的工作是协助站在空间裂隙——也就是大门——附近的基德先生。
请去帮他，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Why are you back?
You're irresponsible. How could you abandon such an important duty?
If you don't want to work, why did you even come here to the Ash Vacuum in the first place?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你怎么回来了？
你真是不负责任。怎么能抛弃这么重要的职责？
如果你不想工作，当初为什么要来阿什真空？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Alas! There's no one I can trust!
You know, when I was working at the palace, I was.. *Blah Blah*...
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
唉！没有我可以信任的人！
你知道吗，当我在宫殿工作时，我... *巴拉巴拉*...

scripts.text: - Her rant doesn't seem to be ending any time soon. You'd better go back and help Mr. Kidd, even if your heart's not in it. -
scripts.translation: - 她的抱怨似乎一时半会儿停不下来。你最好还是回去帮基德先生吧，哪怕心里并不情愿。 -

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Hm? Where are you going? I'm not finished!
Hey, hey!
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
嗯？你要去哪里？我还没说完呢！
喂，喂！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Mr. Kidd is such a great young man.
You should be thankful that I've assigned you to help him. Don't be lazy by neglecting your duties.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
基德先生是个很棒的年轻人。
你应该感激我派你去协助他。别偷懒，不要忽视你的职责。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh, welcome back!
I knew you would successfully complete your duties.
So, tell me; how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
哦，欢迎回来！
我就知道你能顺利完成职责。
那么，告诉我，有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
A scholar who is familiar with magic?
What about that old man over there? If you couldn't tell, he comes from a distant country.
Why are you looking for a scholar, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
一位精通魔法的学者？
那边那位老人怎么样？如果你没认出来的话，他来自遥远的国度。
你为什么要找一位学者呢？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Did Mr. Kidd ask you to find one?
I see. He's probably looking for a solution for the spell scroll.
Then yes, that old man would be the perfect person to ask.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
是基德先生让你去找的吗？
我明白了。他大概是在寻找解决魔法卷轴问题的办法。
那么是的，那位老人会是询问的最佳人选。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
He's from Arunafeltz, and has extensive knowledge in magic as well as sacred power.
I'm sure he'll be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
他来自阿鲁纳菲兹，对魔法和神圣力量都有广泛的了解。
我相信他能帮到你。

scripts.text: Who?
scripts.translation: 谁？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Do you see an old man over there? He's trying to make a fire with wet firewood to roast a sweet potato.
His name is Mr. ^4d4dffDefaria^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你看到那边那位老人了吗？他正试图用湿柴生火烤红薯。
他的名字是^4d4dff德法里亚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Why don't you go show it to him? He might be able to help Mr. Kidd with what he is trying to do.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你不妨去给他看看？他也许能帮基德先生解决他正在尝试的事情。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
If you're seeking advice about the spell scroll, you should go talk to Mr. Defaria.
I don't practice magic, so I wouldn't know anything about it.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
如果你是在寻求关于魔法卷轴的建议，你应该去和德法里亚先生谈谈。
我不练习魔法，所以对此一无所知。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh, welcome back.
How can I help you?
Oh... You've brought the journal..
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
哦，欢迎回来。
有什么可以帮你的吗？
哦...你带来了日记本...

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I see...
...Basically it all comes down to Rayan.
He's been abducted by Satan Morocc.
If we find Rayan using this location-tracing spell.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我明白了...
...归根结底，这都与拉扬有关。
他被魔王梦罗克绑架了。
如果我们用这个定位法术找到拉扬。

scripts.text: We'll find Satan Morocc too!
scripts.translation: 我们也能找到魔王梦罗克！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
That's right.
But it'll work only if Satan Morocc actually abducted Rayan.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
没错。
但这只有在魔王梦罗克确实绑架了拉扬的情况下才有效。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Say, what's the tracing pattern number?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
喂，追踪图案的编号是多少？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
[{0}]
...Ah, there it is.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
[{0}]
...啊，就是那个。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
[{0}]
It's not working for some reason.
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as yours.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
[{0}]
不知为何不起作用。
我找不到一块与你波长相同的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength...
We can use the spell with one stone to find the other stone with the matching wavelength.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
这个定位法术使用一对波长相同的魔法之石...
我们可以用法术通过其中一块石头来寻找另一块波长匹配的石头。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We'll analyze this pattern number and detect the wavelength.
It'll take some time before we get the results.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我们会解析这个编号并检测波长。
得到结果还需要一些时间。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength..
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as your pattern number.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
这个定位法术使用一对波长相同的魔法之石...
我找不到一块与你的编号波长相同的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Go check the number again.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
去再确认一下编号。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Welcome, adventurer.
I hope they've been able to trace the wavelength by now.
How'd you like to go check the results?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
欢迎光临，冒险者。
希望他们现在已经检测出波长了。
要去看看结果吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
To the south of this camp, you'll see a building with a mana detector attached to it.
Go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
在这个营地的南边，你会看到一座装有玛娜探测器的建筑。
去问问那里的管理员关于追踪结果的事。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Tracing magic wavelength is not easy as you think.
Please be patient: the results will arrive soon enough.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
追踪魔法波长并不像你想象的那么容易。
请耐心等待：结果很快就会出来的。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I'm in charge of tracing the wavelength from the Midgard Continent,
and the south camp is tracing it in this area.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我负责追踪米德加尔特大陆的波长，
南边的营地负责追踪这个区域的。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I asked them to assign top priority to this task, so with any luck, they've finished it by now.
..What are you doing? I said, go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我让他们把这个任务列为最高优先级，所以运气好的话，他们现在已经完成了。
...你在干什么？我说，去问问管理员关于追踪结果的事。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
How are the results?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
结果怎么样？

scripts.text: - You told her exactly what you were told by the soldier managing the building. -
scripts.translation: - 你告诉她，正如管理建筑的士兵所说的那样。 -

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Oh, is that the case? I see.
That means.. The man called Rayan isn't on the Midgard Continent or in this Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
哦，是这样吗？我明白了。
也就是说...那个叫拉扬的男子不在米德加尔特大陆，也不在这个阿什真空区域。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
He must be somewhere else.
As I suspected, he must be with Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
他一定在别的地方。
正如我所料，他一定和魔王梦罗克在一起。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Pursuing Satan Morocc was supposed to be our last resort..
...I guess we have no choice now..
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
追捕魔王梦罗克本来应该是我们的最后手段...
...看来我们现在别无选择了...

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
...I should log a report entry into this journal.
Our pursuit of Satan Morocc is at an end for now.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
...我应该在这本日志里记录一下报告。
我们对魔王梦罗克的追捕暂时告一段落。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
You did a great job helping us, and went above and beyond my expectations.
Here, this is a reward for your help.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你帮了大忙，表现超出了我的预期。
拿着，这是对你帮助的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Keep up the good work assisting the explorers in this camp.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
继续协助这个营地的探险家们。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
....

[Echinacea]
Hmm..
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
嗯..

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
...Grr...!
What?! What do you want?
Why do you keep giving me that dirty look?!
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
...嘎...!
什么？你想要什么？
你为什么一直用那种眼神看我？!

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: Something is bothering me...
scripts.translation: 我有些心事...

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Argh...!
Are you annoying me on purpose?
Go and find something else to do!
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
啊...!
你是故意在烦我吗？
去干点别的吧！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
I'm stressed out and I've got a headache writing this report. I don't have the time to deal with you right now.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我压力很大，写这份报告让我头疼。我现在没空理你。
你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What is it that worries you?
Please, I've got enough worries already.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你在担心什么？
拜托，我已经够烦了。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
So, tell me, what is it?
{0}, you've done a great job helping us...
Oh, you must have questions about that last case, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
那么，告诉我，是什么事？
{0}，你帮了我们大忙...
哦，你肯定对上个案子有疑问，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
...Wait, are you worried because of him?
...I see, you're worried about him being supported by the country.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
...等等，你是因为他才担心的吗？
...我明白了，你担心他受到国家的支持。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This isn't a good time to disclose the truth. It'll cause more confusion.
I believe the diplomats and presidents of both countries are responsible for those national matters.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
现在不是揭露真相的好时机。那样只会引起更多混乱。
我相信两国的外交官和总统会负责处理这些国家事务。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
This is out of your hands, adventurer.
So stop worrying about it. Alright?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
这超出了你的能力范围，冒险者。
所以别再担心了。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
No country wants to start a war, especially when we have a greater common enemy.
Just focus on what you can do to help us.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
没有国家想要发动战争，尤其是当我们有更大的共同敌人时。
专注于你能做的，来帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We've stopped pursuing Satan Morocc, so you may go help the other explorers now.
I've already rewarded you for your services.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我们已经停止追捕魔王梦罗克了，所以你现在可以去帮助其他探险者了。
我已经为你的服务给予奖励了。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Remember; don't open your mouth about this to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
记住；不要对任何人提起这件事。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What is it? I thought you've been discharged from my service.
..What are these sweet potatoes?
Did that old man send these?
No way..! Are you..?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
怎么了？我以为你已经解除我的服务了。
..这些是什么？红薯？
是那个老人送来的吗？
不会吧..！你是..？

scripts.text: That's right.
scripts.translation: 没错。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
What do you not understand?
Nothing good can come out of this if it's released to the public.
Can't you see?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你哪里不明白？
如果这件事公之于众，不会有任何好事发生。
你看不出来吗？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Arunafeltz has replaced their leaders with the moderates just recently.
Shoving the remnants of the radicals in front of them is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
阿鲁纳菲兹最近刚用温和派替换了他们的领导人。
把激进派的残余推在他们面前是极其危险的。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We've finally made a truce with them.
Their sins will not be forgiven, but we won't make a stupid attempt to get revenge and end up shedding more blood!
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我们终于与他们达成了停战协议。
他们的罪行不会被原谅，但我们不会愚蠢地试图复仇，从而流更多的血！

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Let the politicians do their job.
I assure you they won't lead us to the worst case scenario. That's what you're worried about, right?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
让政治家们去做他们的工作。
我向你保证，他们不会让我们陷入最坏的情况。这就是你担心的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
No, wait.. Do you..?
Do you want us to wage war against Arunafeltz over this?!
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
不，等等.. 你是..？
你想让我们因为这件事对阿鲁纳菲兹发动战争吗？!

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Let me ask you to forget the past and focus on the present.
For everyone's sake, please just look toward the future and move forward.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
让我请求你忘记过去，专注于现在。
为了大家，请只看向未来，向前看。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
We won't do anything that you'd morally oppose.
You believe in peace, don't you?
Tell him that I'm grateful for these sweet potatoes, anyway..
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
我们不会做任何你在道德上反对的事。
你相信和平，对吧？
告诉他，我感谢这些红薯，无论如何..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
Where can I get those?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？我没有两个美味红薯...
我该去哪里弄到它们？

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
Let us take care of the rest.
I'm not suggesting that we should pretend as if the past never happened. All I'm saying is that we should work towards achieving a greater cause.
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
剩下的交给我们处理。
我并不是说我们要假装过去没有发生过。我只是说，我们应该为了更大的目标而努力。

scripts.text:
[Echinacea]
You're doing a great job.
I suppose I have an eye for people after all.
Yes, that must be right.
Keep up the good work, will you?
scripts.translation:
[紫锥菊]
你做得很好。
看来我确实有识人的眼光。
是的，一定是这样。
请继续保持，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Everything's okay so far!
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
目前一切正常！
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Everything's okay so far!
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
目前一切正常！
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
This device detects mana and magic wavelengths around this area. identifying what enemies we're dealing with.
It can be used to trace the wavelengths of location-tracing spells.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
这个装置可以探测这个区域的玛娜和魔法波长，识别我们面对的敌人。
它还可以用来追踪定位法术的波长。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Did Captain Echinacea send you?
I have something to report to you.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
是紫锥菊船长派您来的吗？
我有件事要向您汇报。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
The magic wavelength of the requested pattern number has not been detected in this area.
It's not possible to trace the number around this area, but..
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
在这个区域没有探测到指定编号的魔法波长。
无法在这个区域追踪该编号，但是..

scripts.text: But?
scripts.translation: 但是？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
I can tell this magic pattern is supposed to be used to trace a human being.
You know tracing magic stones always come in pairs, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
我可以断定，这个魔法模式是用来追踪人类的。
您知道追踪用的魔法之石总是成对出现的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Now, magic stones specifically used to trace humans have a special feature.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
现在，专门用于追踪人类的魔法之石有一个特殊功能。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
When the target of the trace dies, the pair of stones are automatically destroyed.
Since this patterned magic stone is still intact..
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
当追踪目标死亡时，成对的魔法之石会自动销毁。
既然这块带有该模式的魔法之石还完好无损..

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Well, this magic stone serves as proof that the target of the trace is still alive somewhere in the world.
I'll keep watching.
Hopefully, we'll detect the same wavelength.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
好吧，这块魔法之石证明了追踪目标仍然活在世界的某个地方。
我会继续监视。
希望我们能探测到相同的波长。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
That's all for today.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
今天就到这里。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Please report this to Captain Echinacea;
We've failed to trace the location of the target,
but he's still alive somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
请向紫锥菊船长汇报；
我们未能追踪到目标的位置，
但他仍然活在某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
It's a fantastic product made from a combination of magic and science.
The Ash Vacuum hasn't been fully explored, and we don't know what kind of dangers to expect in this area.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
这是魔法与科学结合的杰出产品。
阿什真空尚未被完全探索，我们不知道在这个区域会遇到什么样的危险。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
By using this device, we can check the change and flow of mana around this area,
and prepare for any possible threats.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
通过使用这个装置，我们可以检查这个区域玛娜的变化和流动，
并为任何可能的威胁做好准备。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Hey, you.
Don't get too close to anything except the gate.
It's too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
嘿，你。
除了大门，不要靠近任何东西。
太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......Do you have any business here?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......您有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Echinacea...
scripts.translation: 紫锥菊...

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
An assistant? I don't think I need one, but...
I guess I should give you something to do.
Do you mind if I entrust you with a chore?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
助手？我觉得我不需要一个，但是...
我想我应该给你找点事做。
你介意我委托你一件杂务吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, I don't mind at all.
scripts.translation: 不，我完全不介意。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Then why did you come all this way?
I didn't really need any help to begin with. If you don't want to work, then stop bothering me.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
那你大老远跑来这里是做什么？
我本来就不需要任何帮助。如果你不想工作，就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you don't want to help us out then go back to Echinacea and let her know yourself!
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你不想帮忙，那就回紫锥菊那里，亲自告诉她！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......
I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here
to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......
不知道紫锥菊是否已经告诉过你，我们在这里是为了追踪魔王梦罗克的踪迹。
我们一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加尔特大陆。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我们定期与梦罗克那边的同事交换情报，但已经有一段时间没有收到他们的消息了。
你要不要去帮我收集一些情报？
这应该很简单，我希望你能搞定。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
Go find ^4d4dffRin^000000.
Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
在西南梦罗克，你会找到一家地下酒馆。
去找^4d4dff琳恩^000000。
告诉她是我派你来的，她会照顾你的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you don't have any business here, then step aside. It's too dangerous.
You might not be able to return to this world if you enter a route that hasn't been properly identified.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你在这里没有正事，就请让开。这里太危险了。
如果你进入一条未被正确识别的路线，可能就无法回到这个世界了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I guess she forced you to do this, huh? Don't worry; you're not the first victim of her bossiness.
You should tell her if you really don't want to work for me.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
看来她是逼你来做这个的，对吧？别担心，你不是第一个被她强势作风害苦的人。
如果你真的不想为我工作，就告诉她。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I can tell you aren't so happy with this, huh?
While you're here, why don't you help us out and see where it goes?
Don't worry, I won't give you a hard time...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我看出来你对此并不太高兴，是吗？
既然你在这里，为什么不帮个忙，看看情况如何呢？
别担心，我不会让你太辛苦的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......
I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......
不知道紫锥菊是否已经告诉过你，我们在这里是为了追踪魔王梦罗克的踪迹。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我们一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加尔特大陆。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我们定期与梦罗克那边的同事交换情报，但已经有一段时间没有收到他们的消息了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你要不要去帮我收集一些情报？
这应该很简单，我希望你能搞定。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
Go find ^4d4dffRin^000000.
Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
在西南梦罗克，你会找到一家地下酒馆。
去找^4d4dff琳恩^000000。
告诉她是我派你来的，她会照顾你的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Let me explain one more time.
Go speak to Rin in an underground tavern at Southwest Morocc.
You won't miss the tavern if you look for a boy named Jack standing out the front.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
让我再解释一次。
去西南梦罗克地下酒馆找琳恩对话。
如果你在门口看到一个叫杰克的男孩，就不会错过那家酒馆了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Are you helping Rin?
..I see.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你在帮琳恩吗？
......我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I heard Rin is wounded and bedridden...
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我听说琳恩受伤了，卧床不起...
发生了什么事？

scripts.text: - Instead of an answer, you gave him Rin's journal and the bloody crystal.-
scripts.translation: - 你没有回答，而是把琳恩的日记和沾血的晶体递给了他。-

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...A journal? I see. Hopefully this'll help me understand the situation..
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......日记？我明白了。希望这能帮我了解情况。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
*Sigh*..
So Rayan has finally been located, huh?
There was a skirmish at the mountain, and.. a raid...
..So, how is she?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
*叹气*..
看来拉扬终于被找到了，是吗？
山上发生了一场小规模冲突，还有...一次突袭...
......那么，她现在情况如何？

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I mean Rin. How is she?
Is she seriously wounded?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我是说琳恩。她怎么样了？
伤势严重吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She needs to spend some time in bed,
but she's conscious and still in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她需要卧床休息一段时间，
但意识清醒，身体也没有大碍。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems to have no problem taking care of herself,
but I'm worried because sometimes she looks extremely exhausted. She mentioned that her vision blurs when she's very tired..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她看起来还能自理，
但我有点担心，因为她有时看起来极度疲惫。她提到自己非常累的时候视力会模糊...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry; I don't think it's serious because she still had the strength to yell while writing that journal.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心；我觉得不严重，因为她写那篇日记的时候还有力气大喊大叫。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Wh.. Who said I'm worried?
I asked about her because I don't want her injury to interfere with our schedule.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...谁...谁说我担心了？
我问她是因为我不希望她的伤势影响我们的日程。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
As for you, I want you to come back later.
You're my assistant, remember?
I need you to substitute for Rin until she recovers..
Is that understood?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
至于你，我让你稍后再回来。
别忘了，你是我的助手。
我需要你代替琳恩，直到她康复...
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Hm, thanks for all your help.
Now, would you leave me alone for a while? I need to write a report based on the findings in this journal.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
嗯，谢谢你的帮忙。
现在，能让我一个人待一会儿吗？我需要根据这本日记的发现写一份报告。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I was supposed to give him the 'Morocc Pursuit Journal' and a 'Bloody Crystal of the Darkness'...
Err? Where have they gone? I need to find them.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我本该把《莫洛克追踪日记》和一颗“黑暗的结晶体”交给他...
咦？它们去哪了？我得找找看。）

scripts.text:
Kidd is standing at the side of the space gap, leafing through the journal's pages and taking notes.
The 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' is sitting aside, and remains untouched.
scripts.translation:
基德站在空间裂缝旁，翻阅着日记的页面并做着笔记。
“黑暗的结晶体”放在一旁，未被触碰。

scripts.text:
I feel the crystal resonating with the space gap.
I suddenly have the urge to touch the crystal...
scripts.translation:
我感觉结晶体在与空间裂缝产生共鸣。
我突然有一种想要触碰结晶体的冲动...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Err? What are you trying to do?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
咦？你想做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing.
I'm sorry if I bothered you while you were writing your report.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，没什么。
抱歉打扰你写报告了。

scripts.text: - Kidd stopped you from touching the crystal, but somehow, it still captivates you. -
scripts.translation: - 基德阻止了你触碰结晶体，但不知为何，它依然吸引着你。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Are.. Are you alright?
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你...你没事吧？
刚才发生了什么？

scripts.text: Err.. Huh?!

[{0}]
..Err?
..Kidd? Someone was calling my name...
Rin! Where's Rin? What about Rayan?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...咦？
...基德？有人在叫我的名字...
琳恩！琳恩在哪？拉扬呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Rin? Rayan?
What are you talking about?
Where the hell have you been?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
琳恩？拉扬？
你在说什么？
你到底去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean..
Where I've been?
..Oh yeah, I saw Rin fighting Rayan.
She was defeated by magic, and then disappeared...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你什么意思..
我去哪了？
...哦对，我看到琳恩在和拉扬战斗。
她被魔法击败，然后消失了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah?! Ah! Right!
I heard your voice once I found a strange scroll.
The scroll!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？啊！对了！
当我找到一张奇怪的卷轴时，我听到了你的声音。
那张卷轴！

scripts.text: - Ignoring the confused look on Mr. Kidd's face, you searched your pockets, and found the mysterious scroll. -
scripts.translation: - 无视基德先生困惑的表情，你摸了摸口袋，找到了那张神秘的卷轴。 -

scripts.text:
- It wasn't a dream after all... What you saw actually happened. -
- You show Kidd the scroll and tell him what happened. -
scripts.translation:
- 原来不是梦...你看到的确实发生了。 -
- 你向基德展示卷轴，并告诉他发生了什么。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
... ..
.. Basically,
you found this from a member of Rayan's gang?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
... ..
..基本上，
这是你从拉扬团伙的成员那里找到的？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I know what this is:
it's a scroll containing a magic spell that can be used by anyone, even if they aren't trained as mages.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我知道这是什么：
这是一张魔法卷轴，任何人都可以使用，即使他们没有受过魔法训练。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Hmm, this scroll is sealed and needs some kind of pass code to use it.
I'll consult with the camp scholars about this scroll later.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
嗯，这张卷轴被封印了，需要某种密码才能使用。
我稍后会咨询营地的学者关于这张卷轴的事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
By the way, I saw you touch this 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness.'
There was a bright flash of light around you, and then you were suddenly drawn into the space gap.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
顺便说一下，我看到你触碰了这个“黑暗的结晶体”。
你周围闪过一道亮光，然后你突然被吸入空间裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I thought I was just seeing things, but it's obvious now that it really happened.
You were actually in the past for a little while there.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我以为我在做梦，但现在很明显这是真的。
你刚才确实在过去待了一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm afraid this space gap hides bigger secrets than we thought.
..It not only warps space, but also time ...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
恐怕这个空间裂缝隐藏着我们未曾想到的更大秘密。
..它不仅扭曲空间，还扭曲时间 ...

scripts.text: It warps space and time?
scripts.translation: 它扭曲空间和时间？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Forget it. I was just thinking out loud.
From now on, we should be extra careful about letting anything into this space gap. I need to report this incident to upper management.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
算了。我只是随口说说。
从现在开始，我们应该格外小心，不要让任何东西进入这个空间裂缝。我需要向高层汇报这一事件。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm sorry, but can you ask a scholar about this spell scroll?
If you don't know which scholar you should consult, then you'd better ^4d4dffask Echinacea^000000
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
抱歉，你能去问问学者关于这张魔法卷轴的事吗？
如果你不知道该咨询哪位学者，最好去^4d4dff问问紫锥菊^000000

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Thanks in advance.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
提前谢谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Did you find a scholar to ask about the scroll?
Huh? Not yet?
If you don't know which scholar to consult, then you'd better ask Echinacea.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你找到学者询问卷轴的事了吗？
嗯？还没有？
如果你不知道该咨询哪位学者，最好去问问紫锥菊。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
So this scroll is from Arunafeltz, huh?
Is that why you're gathering items to unseal the scroll?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
所以这张卷轴来自阿鲁纳菲兹，是吗？
这就是为什么你在收集物品来解除卷轴的封印？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I see...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我明白了...

scripts.text:
- Kidd is lost in thought. -
- Let's bring Defaria the items to unseal the spell scroll. -
scripts.translation:
- 基德陷入了沉思。 -
- 让我们把解除魔法卷轴封印的物品带给德法里亚。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Keep up the good work, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
干得好，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
This must be the spell scroll, huh?
It contains a teleportation spell
that will send the user to a specific location.. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
这一定是那张魔法卷轴，是吗？
它包含一个瞬间移动法术，
会将使用者传送到特定地点.. 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
You said you've heard Rayan ordering others to come to a certain place.
If the spell of this scroll leads to that place..
.... . No, it's too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你说你听到拉扬命令其他人去某个地方。
如果这张卷轴的法术指向那个地方..
.... . 不，太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Then again.. Somebody will have to go there eventually..
... .. .. .
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
不过.. 迟早会有人得去那里..
... .. .. .

scripts.text: Why are you looking at me?!
scripts.translation: 你为什么那样看着我？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
You're my assistant, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你是我的助手，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
.Alright, then. Would you rather capture reincarnations of Morocc and collect their remnants?
Scholars suspect the recent space-time phenomenon has been caused by the 'Bloody Crystals of the Darkness,'
so they want to study the crystals, which they believe are remnants of the of Morocc's reincarnations.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
好吧。你是想捕捉莫罗克的转世体并收集它们的残骸吗？
学者们怀疑最近发生的时空现象是由“黑暗的血晶”引起的，
他们想要研究这些水晶，并认为它们是莫罗克转世体的残骸。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That sounds way more dangerous, doesn't it? Go check that place out instead.
Both those missions are dangerous, but I think you'll be risking your life less by checking out that place.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
听起来那个更危险，不是吗？还是去调查那个地方吧。
这两个任务都很危险，但我认为去调查那个地方风险会小一些。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Now, listen. Use the spell scroll to teleport there, and then investigate the area. Find some clues.
Don't fight them.
Don't put yourself in danger, and retreat when things get too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
听着。使用卷轴瞬间移动过去，然后调查那个区域。寻找一些线索。
不要战斗。
不要让自己陷入危险，情况太危险时就撤退。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
By the time you come back,
we should have figured out the cause of the strange phenomenon near this space gap.
We'll think about everything else after you come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
等你回来的时候，
我们应该已经查明这个空间裂隙附近奇怪现象的原因了。
等你回来我们再商量其他事情，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Where's the scroll? Did you use it?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
卷轴呢？你用了？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
那张卷轴包含瞬间移动法术。
使用它会把你带到一个与它们有关的地方。
你到了那里应该收集一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..I guess you haven't found any clues.
Do you remember the location of that place?
Why don't you go it check out again?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
看来你还没找到线索。
你还记得那个地方的位置吗？
为什么不再去检查一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm sure you'll find something.
Yes, there must be some sort of clue there.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我相信你会找到什么的。
是的，那里一定有某种线索。
你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
那张卷轴包含瞬间移动法术。
使用它会把你带到一个与它们有关的地方。
你到了那里应该收集一些线索。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you lost the scroll, I expect you to find that place at any cost.
Is that clear?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你弄丢了卷轴，我要求你无论如何都要找到那个地方。
听明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Did you find any clues?
What did you find over there?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你找到线索了吗？
你在那里发现了什么？

scripts.text: - You interrupted Mr. Kidd, and told him what you heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border. -
scripts.translation: - 你打断了基德先生，并告诉他你在国境线附近空屋地下室听到的消息。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Are you sure?
And the location is.. Okay, I got it.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你确定吗？
位置是... 好的，我知道了。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Can you go back and spy on them a bit more?
I'll follow you as soon as I report these findings to the higher-ups.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你能回去再监视他们一会儿吗？
我会尽快向高层汇报这些发现，然后跟上你。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
They must be having a serious internal dispute,
meaning it's the perfect time for us to raid them.
Keep monitoring them for me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
他们内部一定发生了严重的争执，
这意味着是我们突袭他们的最佳时机。
继续帮我监视他们，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Phew, now I've seen everything.
Oh, hey!
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...呼，现在我看清楚了。
哦，嘿！

scripts.text: Where's Rayan?
scripts.translation: 拉扬在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
He's locked up in the basement, and Rin is interrogating him.
You know, she's the best interrogator we've got. There'll be no escape for that guy ..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
他被关在地下室，琳恩正在审问他。
你知道的，她是我们要最好的审讯官。那个家伙别想逃...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Wait, what if the same thing happens..?
No way, that's not possible..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...等等，如果发生同样的事..？
不可能，那不可能发生..

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
The crystal no longer resonates with the space gap.
Now it's exactly the same as a regular Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
这块结晶体不再与空间裂缝产生共鸣了。
现在它和普通的黑暗的结晶体完全一样。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
That means, the phenomenon that you've experienced with the 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' can't be..
.........
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
也就是说，你之前遇到的“血腥黑暗的结晶体”的现象不可能...
.........

scripts.text: Can't be explained?
scripts.translation: 无法解释？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..I guess not. It might have resonated to your mana or wavelength.
Why don't you carry it with you? Let me know if you experience any strange phenomenon again.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...我想也是。它可能只是与你的玛娜或波长产生了共鸣。
你不妨把它带在身上。如果再遇到什么奇怪的现象，告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Oh, and please bring ^4d4dffthis journal to Rin^000000.
This will be your last assignment from me.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
哦，还有，请把^4d4dff这本日志带给琳恩^000000。
这是我交给你的最后一个任务。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: Is this an exchange journal?
scripts.translation: 这是交换日志吗？

scripts.text: Why should I carry the crystal?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要带着结晶体？

scripts.text: What is this last assignment?
scripts.translation: 这个最后任务是什么？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..No, not at all.
We're just using one journal to record each other's work.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...不，完全不是。
我们只是用同一本日志来记录彼此的工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why can't you use separate journals and then combine them later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么不能各用各的日志，之后再合并呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
......
Ask Echinacea. I'm just doing what the boss tells me to do.
Using one set journal is a good way to keep in contact and accumulate a history of work in chronological order.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
......
去问紫锥菊吧。我只是照老板说的做。
共用一本日志是保持联系并按时间顺序积累工作记录的好方法。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
We came up with the idea to share our experiences
and understand any relation between incidents
as quickly and easily as possible..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我们想出了共享经验的想法，
以便尽可能快速、轻松地理解事件之间的关联...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I know it's a little bit counterproductive, but I'm satisfied with the quality of information shared between us.
The notes that Rin has absent-mindedly written down can turn out to be great clues for me..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我知道这有点违背常理，但我对我们之间共享的资讯质量很满意。
琳恩心不在焉记下的笔记，对我来说往往能成为绝佳的线索...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Yeah, I agree that the journal looks pretty disorganized.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
是的，我也觉得这本日志看起来挺杂乱的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
... Intuition... I guess?
... These kind of things.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...直觉...我想吧？
...就是这类东西。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Rayan has already been caught, so the task to locate him and Rin is already done.
You were just an assistant to start with.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
拉扬已经被抓住了，所以寻找他和琳恩的任务已经完成了。
你一开始只是个助手。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Anyways, please deliver the journal to her safely.
I'm still not done yet; Echinacea already has another task for me..
..*Sigh*..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
总之，请安全地把日志交给她。
我还没忙完呢；紫锥菊已经给我安排了另一个任务...
..*叹气*..

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I asked you to deliver the journal to Rin.
You didn't forget it, did you?
...
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我让你把日志交给琳恩。
你没忘吧？
...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
By the way, I'm still not convinced that we've captured the real Rayan.
Will you tell Rin to write down the results of her interrogation in the journal?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
顺便说一句，我仍然不确信我们抓到的是真正的拉扬。
你能让琳恩把审讯结果记在日志里吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Of course, I'm pretty sure she'll do it without me reminding her.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
当然，我相当确信她不用我提醒也会做的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
You don't have to report everything to me.
I can check the journal later.
Why don't you go assist Rin for now?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
你不必事事向我汇报。
我稍后可以查看日志。
现在先去协助琳恩吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..Things didn't turn out exactly as we hoped, but there's nothing we can do for now.
Thank you for your service;
you've been of great help to us.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...事情并没有完全按照我们的预期发展，但现在也无能为力了。
感谢你的服务；
你帮了我们大忙。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
What's up?
I told you that I won't have any more work available for you. Well, for a good while, anyway..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
怎么了？
我告诉过你，我不会再给你安排更多工作了。好吧，至少很长一段时间内不会。

scripts.text: Want a snack?
scripts.translation: 想吃点零食吗？

scripts.text: Mr. Defaria has sent me.
scripts.translation: 德法里亚先生派我来的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
..I guess he's finally made a fire, huh?
Tell him thanks for these sweet potatoes.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...看来他终于生火了吧？
替我谢谢他送来的这些红薯。

scripts.text: Ask about Dandelion.
scripts.translation: 询问关于蒲公英的事。

scripts.text: Ask about Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: 询问关于阿鲁纳菲兹的事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'm indebted to them, but they all died before I had a chance to pay them back.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我欠他们人情，但他们都在我来得及报答之前去世了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
If you're asking about my political opinion, I'm not going to answer.
This isn't something with which I can interfere.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
如果你是在问我的政治观点，我不会回答。
这不是我能干涉的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
My personal opinion?
Let me tell you that, from their point of view; their one last chance was destroyed.
They're probably too ashamed to even talk about it.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我的个人观点？
让我告诉你，从他们的角度来看；他们最后的机会被摧毁了。
他们可能羞愧得连话都说不出口。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Let our diplomats use that fact to their advantage, alright?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
让我们的外交官利用这一事实，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Nothing.
I have no comments.
No conflicts have arisen recently, either.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
没什么。
我无话可说。
最近也没有发生任何冲突。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Besides, nationality isn't important to us.
What's important is whether or not they're our enemies, and whether or not they're the target of our missions.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
而且，国籍对我们来说并不重要。
重要的是他们是否是敌人，以及他们是否是我们任务的目标。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
Where can I get those?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？我没有两个美味红薯...
我该去哪里弄到它们？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Don't try to understand everything.
A mission is just a mission.
Don't get too emotional or curious about it.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
不要试图理解一切。
任务只是任务。
不要对此过于情绪化或好奇。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...You'd better not approach the space gap off the official route.
If you're not authorized, then turn away. This thing is too dangerous for capricious exploration.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...你最好不要偏离官方路线接近空间裂隙。
如果你没有授权，就请离开。这东西太危险了，不适合随意探索。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
{0}? {1}?!
Wake up!
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please step aside.
I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
.....
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
请让一下。
我现在正经历人生的转折点。
.....

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediatly blew out. -
scripts.translation: - 火苗刚刚点燃，随即就熄灭了。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...............
You know, that was my ninety-third attempt to make a fire with wet firewood.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...............
你知道吗，这是我第九十三次尝试用湿柴生火了。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Wait, was that the ninty fourth ot ninety fifth?
..I've.. I've lost count.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
等等，是第九十四次还是第九十五次？
..我..我数不清了。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please step aside.
I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
......
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
请让一下。
我现在正经历人生的转折点。
......

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediately blew out.-
scripts.translation: - 火苗刚刚点燃，随即就熄灭了。-

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...............
Are you also here...............
to make fun of my stupid attempt to roast these sweet potatoes with wet firewood?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...............
你也在这里...............
是为了嘲笑我用湿柴烤红薯的愚蠢尝试吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...No? Then what brings you here?
...Huh?
A spell scroll? May I see?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...不？那你来这里做什么？
...嗯？
法术卷轴？能让我看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Isn't... Isn't this?!
...Hmm...
Eek... So Echinacea referred you to me, huh?
...Does that means she knows everything...?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...这不是...这不是吗？！
...嗯...
天哪...所以是紫锥菊让你来找我的，对吧？
...这意味着她知道一切...？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Alright then, I'll tell you.
As you can see, this scroll is sealed.
It can only be unsealed by a secret method.
...And...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...好吧，我告诉你。
正如你所见，这个卷轴是被封印的。
只有使用秘密方法才能解除封印。
...而且...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...It is from....
...Arunafeltz?
The way it's sealed is the same method used by the temple...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...它来自....
...阿鲁纳菲兹？
它的封印方式与寺庙使用的方法相同...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I don't know how you've gotten this scroll,
...but I'll try to help you on behalf of the respectable scholars of Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我不知道你是怎么得到这个卷轴的，
...但我会代表阿鲁纳菲兹尊贵的学者们尽力帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
But remember; I'm not doing this officially. Please don't make me disgrace my country by helping you. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
但请记住；我并不是在履行官方职责。请不要让我因为帮助你而让国家蒙羞。你明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text: Got it.
scripts.translation: 明白了。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Good. Then I expect you to help me by gathering the items I need to unseal the scroll:
^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
很好。那么我希望你能帮我收集解除卷轴封印所需的物品：
^4d4dff30圣水、黑暗符文和血色的轮^000000。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我会在这里等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
At first, you looked like someone who is reliable and understands the difference between official and private matters.
Your answer just proved me wrong.
Echinacea must be getting desperate if she's asking people like you for help.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
起初，你看起来像个可靠且懂得区分公事与私事的人。
你的回答证明我错了。
紫锥菊一定很绝望，才会向像你这样的人求助。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Oh, you've brought everything!
Good, it wasn't hard, was it?
Okay, can you come back in a little bit?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
哦，你带齐了所有东西！
很好，这并不难，对吧？
好的，你能过一会儿再回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
To unseal the scroll,
I need ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of the Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
Don't forget to bring the spell scroll along with them.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
要解除卷轴的封印，
我需要^4d4dff30圣水、黑暗符文和血色的轮^000000。
别忘了把法术卷轴也一起带来。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
While you're gathering the items, I'll be roasting my sweet potatoes.
If I could only make this fire work...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
在你收集物品的这段时间里，我会继续烤我的红薯。
要是我能把这火生起来就好了...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Welcome back; you came at the perfect time.
First, this spell scroll contains a teleportation spell.
You know what teleportation is, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
欢迎回来；你来得正是时候。
首先，这个法术卷轴里包含一个瞬间移动法术。
你知道什么是瞬间移动，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
You know,
it's a spell that instantly moves you to a different location.
That's the spell contained in this scroll.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
你知道的，
这是一种能瞬间将你移动到不同地点的法术。
这张卷轴里包含的就是这种法术。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
The only difference is...
This scroll will teleport you to a specific location.
Such scrolls are generally used by ^4d4dfforganizations to gather their members^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
唯一的区别是...
这张卷轴会将你传送到一个特定的地点。
这类卷轴通常被^4d4dff组织用来召集其成员^000000。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I don't know where this scroll will lead you..
You'll be the one using this scroll. Am I right?
Here, please take this.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我不知道这张卷轴会把你带到哪里。
毕竟是你自己要用这张卷轴，对吧？
给，请收下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'To gather members...?'
...Right! I remember
Rayan mentioned a gathering somewhere!
So this scroll will take me to that meeting?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
'召集成员...？'
...对了！我记得
拉扬提到过要在某个地方聚会！
所以这张卷轴会带我去那个聚会吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Um, do you mind? Would you stop talking to yourself and just leave already?
I'm sorry, but this old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
呃，你介意吗？能不能别自言自语，赶紧离开？
抱歉，但这把老骨头需要休息一下，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Don't be so impatient.
You can come back later.
It'll take some time.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
别这么急躁。
你可以稍后再来。
这需要一些时间。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
What are you so worried about?
You'll see how it works as soon as you use it.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
你这么担心什么？
等你一使用它，就会知道它是如何运作的。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
..Huh? What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
..嗯？你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
..I know they're involved in this case, but
we shouldn't talk about them.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
..我知道他们与此事有关，但
我们不应该谈论他们。

scripts.text: Just tell me what you know.
scripts.translation: 告诉我你知道的一切。

scripts.text: Alright..
scripts.translation: 好吧..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Why should I go through all that trouble?
You can go and ask Echinaea.
This old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我为什么要费那个劲？
你可以去问问紫锥菊。
这把老骨头需要休息一下，好吗？

scripts.text: I'll do anything for you.
scripts.translation: 我为你做任何事。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Anything?
Are you serious?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
任何事？
你是认真的吗？

scripts.text: Haha, got you!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，上当了！

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
What th--! How dare you fool an old man!
You little punk!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
什...！你竟敢戏弄一个老人！
你这朽魔！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I may be old,
but I'm a representative of great Arunafeltz's scholars!
It's a mistake to trifle with me like that!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
虽然我老了，
但我可是伟大的阿鲁纳菲兹学者们的代表！
像这样戏弄我，可是大错特错！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Did you think I'm stupid just because I was trying to make a fire with wet firewood?!
..*Pant Pant*.. Phew, even yelling tires me out..
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
你以为我因为试图用湿柴生火就傻了吗？！
..*喘气 喘气*.. 呼，连喊叫都让我累了..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Then...
...Umm... Can you bring me some Logs?
...And some sweet potatoes too, if you don't mind.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
那么...
...呃... 你能帮我带些原木来吗？
...如果不介意的话，再带些红薯。

scripts.text: Sure thing. How many?
scripts.translation: 没问题。要多少？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Let's see...
I need sweet potatoes for me, Mr. Kidd, and Echi... Umm...
...And then I need... Yes!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...让我想想...
我需要红薯，给我、基德先生和艾奇... 呃...
...然后还需要... 对了！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000.
I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
请给我^4d4dff20个红薯和30根原木^000000。
我会等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
You seem to give up really easily.
I don't blame you. Sometimes giving up is the best decision,
not to mention that it takes a certain kind of courage.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
你似乎很容易放弃。
我不怪你。有时候放弃是最好的决定，
况且这需要某种勇气。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
For example, Tarous that know when to abandon their hopes of getting cheese, you know, the bait in traps, are the hardest ones to catch. You know?
..Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
比如，那些知道何时放弃对奶酪的希望的白鼠，你知道的，陷阱里的诱饵，是最难捕捉的。懂吗？
..哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Arunafeltz...?
Yes, I'm from Arunafeltz...
So what?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...阿鲁纳菲兹...？
是的，我来自阿鲁纳菲兹...
那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Be more specific about your question,
and stop being so ambiguous.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
把你的问题说得更具体一点，
别这么含糊其辞。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Oh, you've really brought what I wanted!
Please give them to me..
No, wait, can you pile them on the firewood over there?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
哦，你真的带来了我要的东西！
请把它们给我..
不，等等，你能把它们堆在那边的柴火堆上吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Make it a nice, neat pile, please.
Oh, you forgot to put the sweet potatoes on top.
Yes, good. That's perfect.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
请堆得整齐漂亮一点。
哦，你忘了把红薯放在上面。
是的，很好。完美。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Hopefully I can make a fire with your nice logs....
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
希望我能用你带来的漂亮原木生火....

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Oh, this is as great as I'd hoped!
I guess my magic hasn't gotten that rusty after all..
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
哦，这比我预期的还要好！
看来我的魔法并没有那么生疏..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
If you want me to do you a favor, then
you should bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000 in return.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
如果你想让我帮你个忙，那么
你应该作为回报给我^4d4dff20个红薯和30根原木^000000。

scripts.text: - Defaria is blowing on a roast sweet potato, peeling off it's skin. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亚正在吹烤红薯，剥掉它的皮。 -

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下，先生...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
What..?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
什...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Didn't you forget something?
... Dandelion? I wanted you to tell me what you knew.
I was hoping you'd remember something about Dandelion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你忘了什么吗？
... 蒲公英？我想让你告诉我你知道的事。
我希望你能想起一些关于蒲公英的事。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
So,
do you want me to confirm
if Dandelion is really supported by Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
那么，
你想让我确认
蒲公英是否真的得到阿鲁纳菲兹的支持吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Umm... I don't know what to say... I don't feel comfortable talking about politics.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
呃... 我不知道该说什么... 我不太想谈论政治。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
...Do you mind delivering these to Mr. Kidd?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
...你介意把这些交给基德先生吗？

scripts.text: - Defaria has given you 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亚给了你2个美味红薯。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Um, I just told you to deliver those sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
呃，我刚刚才让你把那些红薯交给基德先生。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Say, did he like them?
Hahaha...
... ...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
话说，他喜欢吗？
哈哈哈...
... ...

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Dandelion was like a ghost.
There are many different types of people in this world.
Some people want war while others are against it.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
蒲公英就像幽灵一样。
这个世界上有各种各样的人。
有些人想要战争，而有些人则反对战争。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
The Dandelions were the former case.
Those right-ists believed in a distorted patriotism. They thought shedding blood was the only way to make peace.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
蒲公英属于前者。
那些右翼分子信奉一种扭曲的爱国主义。他们认为流血是达成和平的唯一途径。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
They organized Dandelion,
and they happened to ally themselves with the warmongers in the government.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
他们组织了蒲公英，
并且恰好与政府中的战争狂热者结成了同盟。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
That's how they grew so strong.
At first, their purpose was limited to gathering intel and spying on other countries.
This is just what I think, but the right information can cause chaos in a country.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
他们就是这样变得强大的。
起初，他们的目的仅限于收集情报和监视他国。
这只是我的个人看法，但正确的情报足以让一个国家陷入混乱。

scripts.text: Then what..?
scripts.translation: 那么接下来呢..?

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Can't you see it by now? Isn't it obvious?
Well, if you can't take care of your own problems,
then you won't be able to handle your enemies.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
你现在还看不出来吗？这不是很明显吗？
好吧，如果你连自己的问题都解决不了，
那你也就无法对付你的敌人了。

scripts.text: So Arunafeltz planned all this!
scripts.translation: 所以是阿鲁纳菲兹策划了这一切！

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
No, it isn't that simple. The world isn't just black and white, you know?
Just bring these to Echinacea, will you?
They're cooked very well.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
不，事情没那么简单。世界不是非黑即白的，你知道吗？
把这些交给紫锥菊，好吗？
它们烤得很好。

scripts.text: - You have received 2 steaming hot Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 你收到了2个热气腾腾的美味红薯。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I told you to deliver those cooked sweet potatoes to Echinacea.
Don't eat them, alright?
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我让你把那些烤好的红薯交给紫锥菊。
别偷吃，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Muhahahaha!
Did Echinacea really say that?
She's an executive of the Rune-Midgarts army.
I can tell that what she said came from the bottom of her heart.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
紫锥菊真的那么说了吗？
她是卢恩·米德加兹军队的执行官。
我能感觉到，她说的话是发自内心的。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I'm relieved that things turned out this way.
After all, they're the reason why the three countries decided to cooperate.
Of course, it's too early to say if the cooperation will last long.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
事情能变成这样，我松了一口气。
毕竟，正是因为她们，三个国家才决定合作。
当然，现在说合作能持续多久还为时过早。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I just hope that the three countries will use this chance to form lasting, friendly relationships. Wouldn't that be great for the sake of everyone in the world?
Hrrm, but I'm not holding my breath for world peace.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我只希望三个国家能利用这次机会建立持久的友好关系。这对世界上所有人来说不是件好事吗？
哼，不过我对世界和平并不抱太大希望。

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
I'm just a mere human who can't foresee the future, you know?
..Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
我只是一个无法预见未来的普通人，你知道吗？
..哈哈哈..

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Ah, your sweet potatoes are now roasted very well.
Here, enjoy them.
