Thank you for trying so hard to please this whimsical old man.
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
啊，你的红薯现在烤得很好了。
拿去，好好享用吧。
谢谢你这么努力地讨好我这个古怪的老人。

scripts.text:
- Defaria is lost in thought, standing with a poker in one hand
and a sweet potato in the other. -
scripts.translation:
- 德法里亚若有所思地站着，一手拿着火钳，
一手拿着红薯。 -

scripts.text:
- Sometimes, he looks to the sky, sighs, and then says, 'I'm envious of young people these days ..'
or something like 'I don't care anymore, no matter what happens.' -
scripts.translation:
- 有时，他会望向天空，叹口气，然后说：
'我很羡慕现在的年轻人 ..'
或者类似'我不在乎了，不管发生什么'的话。 -

scripts.text: - It sounds like he's having some pretty deep moments, so let's not disturb him. -
scripts.translation: - 听起来他正在经历一些深刻的时刻，所以别打扰他了。 -

scripts.text:
[Defaria]
Please leave me alone unless you have extremely important business with me.
I have so many things that I want to do...
scripts.translation:
[德法里亚]
除非有极其重要的事情，否则请别打扰我。
我还有很多事情想做...

scripts.text:
You've found some half-burnt logs of high quality.
It seems somebody already roasted sweet potatoes with these logs.
scripts.translation:
你找到了一些燃烧了一半的高品质木柴。
看起来有人已经用这些木柴烤过红薯了。

scripts.text:
You've found camp firewood that is too wet to make a fire.
It seems somebody has been futilely attempting to make a fire with them.
scripts.translation:
你找到了一些太湿而无法生火的露营木柴。
看起来有人曾徒劳地试图用它们生火。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Almost half of this town has been destroyed,
and yet some people still come to visit.
I must say that it's amazing that our stronghold is still intact, and withstood all the devastation.
scripts.translation:
[杰克]
这座城镇几乎有一半被摧毁了，
却仍有人前来参观。
不得不说，我们的据点依然完好无损，经受住了所有的破坏，这真是令人惊叹。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
As you see, half of this town is gone. I guess there's no real reason to control access to this tavern.
Just feel free to go in.
scripts.translation:
[杰克]
正如你所见，这座城镇的一半已经消失了。我想没有必要再限制进入这家酒馆了。
请随意进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
I'm impressed by your courage to step into this hell.
scripts.translation:
[杰克]
我很佩服你敢于踏入这片地狱的勇气。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Oh, not everyone can enter that place...!
...
Nevermind.
scripts.translation:
[杰克]
哦，不是所有人都能进入那个地方...！
...
算了。

scripts.text:
[Jack]
Since everything has changed,
just feel free to enter wherever you want!
scripts.translation:
[杰克]
既然一切都变了，
请随意进入任何你想去的地方！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Welcome.
Care for a drink?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
欢迎光临。
要来杯饮料吗？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
What would you like to drink?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
您想喝点什么？

scripts.text: Order a Drink
scripts.translation: 点一杯饮料

scripts.text: About the mission
scripts.translation: 关于任务

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Karred]
We have Tropical Sograt
and Vermillion on the Beach.
Which one would you like to drink?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我们有热带的苏克拉特
和海滩上的朱红。
您想喝哪一种？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 热带的苏克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海滩

scripts.text: How about a free drink?
scripts.translation: 来杯免费的怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Are you sure you can even hold a glass of alcohol?
You're carrying too many things on you already.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你确定自己能拿稳酒杯吗？
你身上已经背了太多东西了。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I can give you a special discount, but
you don't have enough money to even pay the special price.
Why don't you check your money first?
This drink is only 800 zeny for Assassins!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我可以给你特别的低价买进，
但你的钱连这个特价都付不起。
为什么不先检查一下你的钱呢？
这杯饮料对刺客来说只要800 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I'll give you a special discount.
Here, drink up.
This drink is mainly made of fruit juice,
but you still shouldn't drink too much.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我会给你特别的低价买进。
拿去，喝吧。
这杯饮料主要是果汁做的，
但你还是不应该喝太多。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Do you even have any money?
Why don't you check your money first?
It's 1000 zeny for one glass.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你身上有钱吗？
为什么不先检查一下你的钱呢？
一杯要1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
There you go.
This drink is mainly made of fruit juice,
but you still shouldn't drink too much.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
给你。
这杯饮料主要是果汁做的，
但你还是不应该喝太多。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Are you sure you can even hold a glass of alcohol?
You're carrying too many things on you already.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你确定自己能拿稳酒杯吗？
你身上已经背了太多东西了。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I can give you a special discount, but
you don't have enough money to even pay the special price.
Why don't you check your money first?
This drink is only 800 zeny for Assassins!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我可以给你特别的低价买进，
但你的钱连这个特价都付不起。
为什么不先检查一下你的钱呢？
这杯饮料对刺客来说只要800 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I'll give you a special discount.
Here, enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我会给你特别的低价买进。
拿去，好好享用。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Do you even have any money?
Why don't you check your money first?
It's 1000 zeny for one glass.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你身上有钱吗？
为什么不先检查一下你的钱呢？
一杯要1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
There you go.
Don't drink too much, alright?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
给你。
别喝太多，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
.........
Get out.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
……
滚出去。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
How many I help you?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
我帮过你多少次了？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
...Rin? I see. So you're assisting Mr. Kidd.
Rin...she's in the room inside.
She was gravely injured not that long ago...
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
……琳恩？原来如此，你是来协助基德先生的。
琳恩……她在里面的房间。
她不久前受了重伤……

scripts.text:
[Karred]
You can't expect your job to always go smoothly.
Of course there will be risks.
Why don't you go pay her a visit?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你不能指望工作总是顺顺利利的。
当然会有风险。
你不妨去探望一下她？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Rin needs to rest for now. I hope you'll do what you can to help her out.
But please do take care of yourself as well.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
琳恩现在需要休息。希望你能尽力帮她一把。
但请你也照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
You and Rin are like my children to me, and such injuries...
Sigh...it's torture for me to see.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
你和琳恩对我来说就像我的孩子一样，看到这样的伤势……
唉……看着真是让人心痛。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I hope you'll come by more often. This place is open to you always, even if you don't have missions.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
希望你以后能常来。这里永远对你敞开大门，即使你没有任务在身。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Rin needs to rest in bed for a while. I hope you'll help her complete her duties.
...This is quite embarrassing to admit, but I see her like my own daughter.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
琳恩需要在床上休息一阵子。希望你能帮她完成职责。
……这话说出来有点不好意思，但我把她看作自己的女儿。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Ah, just forget what I said. That was out of line.
I guess I'm drunk after dealing with alcohol all day.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
啊，忘了我刚才说的话吧。那是我不对。
我想我喝醉了，毕竟整天都在跟酒打交道。

scripts.text:
[Karred]
How may I help you?
For your information, the 'recommendation' has lost its effect. You'd better go back.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
有什么可以帮你的吗？
顺便告诉你，那个“推荐”已经失效了。你最好还是回去吧。

scripts.text: I'm here for Rin!
scripts.translation: 我是来找琳恩的！

scripts.text:
[Karred]
...? Why are you looking for Rin?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
……？你为什么要找琳恩？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
I see. So you're a member of the Ash Vacuum expedition.
Rin is in the inner room.
...She's been badly injured and is resting in bed. Don't do anything to shock her, alright?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
原来如此，你是阿什真空探险队的成员。
琳恩在里面的房间。
……她受了重伤，正在床上休息。别做让她受惊的事，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Karred]
Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷德]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hey, wait.
Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room.
Hey Master, is it okay to let this guy in?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，等等。
只有授权人员才能进入里面的房间。
嘿，师父，让这家伙进去没问题吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I, um, I'm looking
for somebody named
Marjana? I learned
that she's around
here somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我，嗯，我在找一个叫玛尔雅娜的人？
我听说她就在附近某处？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Marjana? How did you
know that? Hey master,
what do I do with this guy?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
玛尔雅娜？你怎么知道这个名字的？
嘿，师父，我该怎么处理这家伙？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm. I sense no ill intent
from this adventurer. I've
also heard a rumor that the
Prontera Church needs to
investigate poison for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
嗯。我感觉到这位冒险者没有恶意。
我也听说普隆德拉教会因为某种原因
需要调查毒药。

scripts.text:
[Master]
However, there is no
way to tell if this person
has been sent by Prontera
Church. I suppose whether
this person can enter is
really up to you, Litheron.
scripts.translation:
[师父]
然而，没有办法确定这个人
是否是普隆德拉教会派来的。
我想，这个人能否进入
完全由你决定，利瑟隆。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Hah! Did you hear that?
Alright, how about this?
I'll let you in if you buy me
a drink. Besides, you can't risk making trouble here: this place
is full of deadly Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
哈！你听到了吗？
好吧，这样吧？
如果你请我喝一杯，我就让你进去。
而且，你不敢在这里惹事：
这里到处都是致命的刺客。

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Why should I?!
scripts.translation: 我为什么要？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Heh, that's what
I'm talking about!
Hey, bartender! Gimme
the usual! I like your
style, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嘿，这才像话！
嘿，调酒师！来老样子！
我喜欢你的风格，冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Huh...
Oh, you don't even
have enough zeny to
buy water here. Oh boy...
If you really want to enter,
make sure you have the cash!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
嗯...
哦，你连买水的Zeny都不够。天哪...
如果你真的想进来，
确保你带够了钱！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Alright, you can come
on in. But don't you dare
breathe a word about this
bar to another living soul.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
好吧，你可以进来了。
但你绝对不要对任何活人
透露这家酒吧的事。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
Not the saavy type,
are you...? Fine, fine.
If you're not gonna do
me any favors, then why
should I help you? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
你可不是那种会讨人喜欢的类型，
对吧……？算了，算了。
如果你不给我好处，
我为什么要帮你？滚开！

scripts.text:
[Bar Master]
If you keep outsiders away from the entrance, every drink you drink today will be on the house.
So keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[酒吧老板]
如果你能把外人挡在门口，今天你喝的所有酒都请客。
所以请继续努力。

scripts.text:
[Bar Master]
Yay! Did you hear that?
That's my cue to get you outta here!
scripts.translation:
[酒吧老板]
耶！你听到了吗？
这就是让我把你赶出去的信号！

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What, haven't you seen a Knight before?
You think Knights don't belong here?
Looks like this is a case of the pot calling the kettle black.
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
什么，你以前没见过骑士吗？
你觉得骑士不该出现在这里？
看来这是典型的“五十步笑百步”啊。

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
What, haven't you seen a Knight before?
You think Knights don't belong here?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
什么，你以前没见过骑士吗？
你觉得骑士不该出现在这里？

scripts.text:
[Litheron]
You know, I'm just here to take a break from the town restoration work.
There aren't many places that you can have a drink without being caught. You know?
scripts.translation:
[利瑟隆]
你知道的，我只是来这里休息一下，暂时逃离城镇重建的工作。
毕竟，能喝酒又不被发现的地方可不多。你懂的吧？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Welcome, meow.
Say, how's it like outside? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
欢迎光临，喵。
喂，外面怎么样了？喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Why are you here, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你来这里做什么，喵？

scripts.text: Is Marjana in?
scripts.translation: 玛尔雅娜在吗？

scripts.text: I'm here to see you, Tao.
scripts.translation: 我是来找你的，陶。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
She's in the room on your left, meow~
But then, how d'you know she's here, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
她在左边的房间里，喵~
不过，你怎么知道她在这里的，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
This is no place for playing, meow..
... Hey, it's awkward you looking at me like that, meow..
scripts.translation:
[陶]
这里可不是玩耍的地方，喵..
... 喂，你这样盯着我看，让我很不自在，喵..

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Tao knows what you're thinking, meow~ You're here to see big sister Rin, am I right, meow? 
Hehe, where is she, I wonder, meow~
scripts.translation:
[陶]
陶知道你在想什么，喵~ 你是来找琳恩姐姐的，对吧，喵？
呵呵，不知道她在哪呢，喵~

scripts.text:
[Tao]
If you don't have any reason to be here, you should leave, meow!
Not everyone can enter this place, meow.
Somehow you're here, but you can't go in the room.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
如果你没有正当理由来这里，就请离开，喵！
不是谁都能进入这个地方的，喵。
虽然你进来了，但不能进房间。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
No, wait... I think you may be able to go in... I don't know, meow!
Tao is tired of being a door keeper, meow! Meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
不，等等... 我觉得你可以进去... 我也不清楚，喵！
陶受够了当看门人了，喵！喵！

scripts.text: Hey kid, are you alone?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小孩，你一个人吗？

scripts.text: What are you, meow?!
scripts.translation: 你是什么东西，喵？！

scripts.text: Why do you keep meowing?!
scripts.translation: 你为什么一直喵喵叫？！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Who are you calling a kid?
Tao is a good door keeper!
Don't call me a kid!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
谁是小鬼？
陶是个优秀的看门人！
别叫我小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
I can tell you've got some reason for being here, but you've put yourself in trouble!
You're mistaken if you thought I would tell you
Master and Marjana are in the left room. Grrr.. Meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
我能看出你来这里是有原因的，但你给自己惹麻烦了！
如果你以为我会告诉你
师父和玛尔雅娜在左边的房间，那你就错了。呜呜.. 喵！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Are you making fun of me being a door keeper, meow?!
Grrr...
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你是在嘲笑我是看门人吗，喵？！
呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Tao]
You make me mad, meow. Get lost!!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你让我很生气，喵。滚开！！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
It's a long story, meow.
It's been a long time since I started meowing one day..
That day, Tao wanted to have a Big Ribbon so badly.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
说来话长，喵。
从有一天我开始喵喵叫，已经过去很久了..
那天，陶非常非常想要一条红蝶发带。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
So Tao went to find Wild Roses.
Meow?! Why am I telling you this, meow?!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
所以陶去找狂暴野猫了。
喵？！我为什么要告诉你这些，喵？！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Grrr!
What are you, meow?!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
呜呜！
你是什么东西，喵？！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
出去！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Ah, that place is protected
by security magic, so you'll
only have ^4D4DFF4 minutes^000000 to remain
there. Don't waste time, meow!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
啊，那个地方有魔法保护，
所以你只有^4D4DFF4分钟^000000的时间待在那里。
别浪费时间，喵！

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Sooo sorry, meow~
Someone else is already
inside. Just come back
again later, meow?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
真...真抱歉，喵~
里面已经有人了。
请稍后再来，喵？

scripts.text:
[Tao]
Who are you, meow?!
Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room, meow!
You are not authorized!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[陶]
你是谁，喵？！
只有授权人员才能进入内室，喵！
你没有权限！
出去！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
What is it? I have nothing to ask you to do.
Could you please leave me alone? I have a bad headache.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
什么事？我没有让你做什么。
请让我安静一会儿好吗？我头痛得厉害。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
...Sorry, but could you please leave?
I'm really stressed out right now.
If you're here for the request that we made earlier, you can just forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
...抱歉，请离开好吗？
我现在压力很大。
如果你是来找我之前委托的那件事的，就忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I'll ask you for a help some other time.
You look pretty passionate after all.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
改天我会请你帮忙的。
毕竟你看起来挺热情的。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
You have ^4d4dff4 minutes^000000
to finish your quest, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
这个房间也被安全魔法封印了，喵。
你有^4d4dff4分钟^000000的时间完成任务，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
里面已经有客人了。
你可以等等，或者稍后再来，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
You have ^4d4dff4 minutes^000000
to finish your quest, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
这个房间也被安全魔法封印了，喵。
你有^4d4dff4分钟^000000的时间完成任务，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
里面已经有客人了。
你可以等等，或者稍后再来，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
You have ^4d4dff4 minutes^000000
to finish your quest, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
这个房间也被安全魔法封印了，喵。
你有^4d4dff4分钟^000000的时间完成任务，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation:
[陶]
里面已经有客人了。
你可以等等，或者稍后再来，喵。

scripts.text:
[Tao]
This is the patient's room, meow.
Why don't you leave the patient alone to rest?
scripts.translation:
[陶]
这是病人的房间，喵。
不如让病人独自休息吧？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
...{0}...?
It's been a long time. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
...{0}...？
好久不见。最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Who are you? Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你是谁？只有授权人员才能进入这个区域。

scripts.text: Mr. Kidd sent me.
scripts.translation: 基德先生派我来的。

scripts.text: Just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
...?
...Ah.. Ahh, I see.
I haven't contacted him for a while, and so he's sent you to me...
*Sigh*.. *Cough*.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
...？
...啊...啊，我明白了。
我已经很久没联系他了，所以他派你来找我...
*叹气*.. *咳嗽*。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
As you see, I've been feeling under the weather. I'm in no condition to contact him.
...Let me think. Where I should start..?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你也看到了，我最近身体不舒服。我现在没精力联系他。
...让我想想。我该从哪里说起呢..？

scripts.text: I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是否知道，在魔王梦罗克复活之前，这个城镇发生过一场灾难。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉扬”，进行了一场仪式来打破魔王梦罗克的封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我们召集了一群人阻止他完成仪式，
虽然封印没有被打破，但他成功削弱了封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
就在我们抓住他之后不久，一群魔物袭击了这个城镇，
空气中回荡着魔王梦罗克愤怒的咆哮声。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.
He caused everything that's happening now.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉扬”，是这一系列事件的罪魁祸首。
现在发生的一切都是他造成的。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我不知道你是否知道，在魔王梦罗克复活之前，这个城镇发生过一场灾难。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉扬”，进行了一场仪式来打破魔王梦罗克的封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我们召集了一群人阻止他完成仪式，
虽然封印没有被打破，但他成功削弱了封印。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
就在我们抓住他之后不久，一群魔物袭击了这个城镇，
空气中回荡着魔王梦罗克愤怒的咆哮声。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.
He caused everything that's happening now.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
R，也就是“拉扬”，是这一系列事件的罪魁祸首。
现在发生的一切都是他造成的。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Our job is primarily investigating Satan Morocc's whereabouts
as well as the relation between the space gap and Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我们的主要任务是调查魔王梦罗克的下落，
以及空间裂缝与魔王梦罗克之间的关系...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
We, however, couldn't let Rayan get away with what he's done
I've been focusing on pursuing Rayan.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
然而，我们不能让拉扬对他所做的一切逍遥法外。
我最近一直在全力追捕拉扬。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
If we capture him, we might also find out some information about Satan Morocc:
we might be able to learn where he tried to summon Satan Morocc, and where we should send Satan Morocc back to...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
如果我们能抓住他，也许还能打听到关于魔王梦罗克的一些情报：
我们或许能得知他试图在哪里召唤魔王梦罗克，以及我们应该把魔王梦罗克送回哪里...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I really want to know how the space gap is linked to Satan Morocc...
*Pant Pant*... ...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我真的很想知道空间裂缝与魔王梦罗克之间有什么联系...
*喘气*... ...

scripts.text: And then what?
scripts.translation: 然后呢？

scripts.text: Don't strain yourself.
scripts.translation: 别太勉强自己。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I'm sorry, but I'm not yet fully recovered... I need to speak slowly. Please bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
抱歉，我还没有完全恢复... 我需要慢慢说话。请多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Thank you for your kindness.
...*Pant Pant*...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
谢谢你的体贴。
...*喘气*...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I received these injuries from Rayan and his gang. I finally located them after a long stakeout and pursuit...
......... ...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
这些伤是拉扬和他的同伙造成的。经过长时间的潜伏和追踪，我终于找到了他们...
......... ...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Yes... I need to write this down...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
是的... 我需要把这些写下来...

scripts.text: - Mumbling something, she took down notes in an old notebook as she spoke. -
scripts.translation: - 她一边低声念叨着，一边在旧笔记本上做着记录。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
The Dandelions.. They're Rayan's puppets.
I was ambushed by them in a mountain far from a village...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
蒲公英... 他们是拉扬的傀儡。
我在远离村庄的一座山上被他们伏击了...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
When I woke up, I was here.
Since then, my vision's been blurry. I guess that must have been caused by my injuries...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
当我醒来时，我就在这里了。
从那以后，我的视力一直模糊不清。我想那应该是受伤导致的...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
How'd you like to conduct an investigation around that area? We might find something..
Like important clues or where they've headed...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你愿意去那个区域附近调查一下吗？我们可能会发现一些东西..
比如重要的线索，或者他们逃往的方向...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
^4d4dffIf you're interested in helping me, I'll continue talking.^000000
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
^4d4dff如果你愿意帮我，我就继续说下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Did you just come by for no reason?
...God, I can't believe just let you come here!
Grr.. I need to teach them a lesson. Why can't they let me rest for God's sake!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你是无缘无故跑来的吗？
...天哪，我真不敢相信竟然让你进来了！
哼... 我得好好教训他们一顿。拜托了，他们就不能让我休息一下吗！

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I'm sorry, but I'm extremely tired and cranky.
If you don't have anything important to tell me, then I'd like you to leave.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
抱歉，我现在极度疲惫且脾气暴躁。
如果你没有重要的事情要告诉我，请离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
So, are you interested in helping me?
I remember the location was... Southwest from a village called Hugel.
Do you know where to find Abyss Lake, where the Dragons reside?.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
那么，你愿意帮我吗？
我记得那个地点在... 毁葛西南方。
你知道龙居住的深渊湖在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
^4d4dffWhen you pass Abyss Lake and head west,^000000 you'll arrive at stiff mountains.
I was ambushed somewhere ^4d4dffsouth of the second hill from the top of the mountain^000000
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
^4d4dff穿过深渊湖向西走，^000000就会到达陡峭的山脉。
我在^4d4dff山顶往下数第二座山丘的南侧^000000遭到伏击。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
They ganged up on me, but I put up a good fight...
I'm sure I at least made them drop something..
Please try to find something there that might serve as a clue.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
他们围攻了我，但我奋力抵抗了...
我确信至少让他们掉落了一些东西。
请试着在那里找找看，也许能找到线索。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
While you're gone, I'll be preparing a document to send to Mr. Kidd.
Be safe, and look out for yourself, okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
趁你不在的时候，我会准备一份文件寄给基德先生。
保重，照顾好自己，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I remember the location was...
somewhere south of the second hill of a mountain west from Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我记得那个地点是...
深渊湖西边某座山的第二座山丘南侧。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
What are you looking at?
How do I remember the location so clearly?
It's the last location where I searched for Rayan. How can I not remember?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你在看什么？
我怎么会记得这么清楚？
那是最后搜索拉扬的地方，我怎么可能不记得？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Don't underestimate me; I'm an elite member of my guild.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
别小看我，我是公会的精英成员。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Have you found anything?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你找到什么了吗？

scripts.text:
- You told her you couldn't find anything regarding their whereabouts,
but you found the ''Bloody Crystal of Darkness'' in the bushes.
scripts.translation:
- 你告诉她你没能找到关于他们行踪的任何线索，
但在灌木丛里发现了“血腥的黑暗结晶体”。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..This is...it.
You can feel the evil spirit just by looking at it.
This...there's no doubt. It's the same kind of crystal as the ones found on Satan Morocc and his minions.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..这是...它。
只要看一眼就能感受到邪恶的气息。
这...毫无疑问。它与在魔王梦罗克及其手下身上发现的结晶体是同一种类。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
But...this crystal...left there..
..Was it them who dropped it?
So it seems Rayan and Satan Morocc...there really is something going on between those two.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
但是...这个结晶体...被留在那里..
..是他们掉落的吗？
看来拉扬和魔王梦罗克...这两人之间确实有些关联。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
You've worked hard. Thank you.
Ha...
Just lying here, not being able to do anything...it's so frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
辛苦了。谢谢你。
哈...
只能躺在这里，什么也做不了...真让人沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Here, take this journal to Mr. Kidd.
It should've been done a while ago.
Oh, bring this crystal to him as well.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
拿着，把这个日志带给基德先生。
这本该早就完成的。
哦，把这个结晶体也一起带给他。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Ah..the journal..Yes, I should record this incident onto the journal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
啊..日志..是的，我应该把这次事件记录在日志里。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
All done. Here you go.
Here's the journal and the crystal.
Take them to Mr. Kidd for me.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
写好了。给你。
这是日志和结晶体。
请帮我带给基德先生。

scripts.text:
- You received the journal from Rin.
Instead of a journal, it's more like a bunch of documents being exchanged. -
scripts.translation:
- 你从琳恩那里收到了日志。
与其说是日志，不如说是一堆交换的文件。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..A bloody Crystal of the Darkness?
Can you show it to me?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..血腥的黑暗结晶体？
能给我看看吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't have it with me. I'll go bring it right away.
^4d4dff(Wait, what did I do with it? I didn't sell it or anything, did I?)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我身上没带。我马上去取。
^4d4dff（等等，我把它放哪了？我没卖掉它吧？）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Hurry up; deliver the journal and crystal to Mr. Kidd.
That's your job, isn't it?
*Pant* I need to rest now..
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
快点；把日志和结晶体交给基德先生。
这不是你的工作吗？
*喘气* 我现在需要休息了..

scripts.text:
[Rin]
My eyes are blurry...
*Pant Pant*...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我的视线模糊了...
*喘气 喘气*...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..Argh.. I'm still recovering .. I'm not supposed to move~
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..啊...我还在恢复中...我不该乱动的~

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Hey, you've come back at just the right time.
Look at him; this is ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
嘿，你回来的正是时候。
看看他；这太荒唐了。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
I know what I did is unforgivable, no matter how good my reason might be.
..But... *Sigh*... It's too late to regret it now, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
我知道我所做的一切不可原谅，无论我的理由多么正当。
..但是... *叹气*...现在后悔也来不及了，不是吗？

scripts.text: Who is this?
scripts.translation: 他是谁？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Don't you know? He's Rayan Moore who dared to release Satan Morocc, deceive everyone, and bring havoc to this world.
And you know what?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你不知道吗？他是拉扬·摩尔，那个胆敢释放魔王梦罗克、欺骗所有人并给这个世界带来浩劫的人。
而且你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Not only that, he slaughtered his own comrades without mercy!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
不仅如此，他还毫不留情地屠杀了自己的同志！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
...Waaah!
..I.. I.. I killed them with my own hands!
*Sob*..
I'm.. I'm sorry..
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
...哇啊！
..我...我...是我亲手杀了他们！
*抽泣*..
我...我很抱歉..

scripts.text:
- Rayan is shivering in fear.
He still hasn't gotten over the fact that he killed all of his comrades.-
scripts.translation:
- 拉扬因恐惧而颤抖。
他仍然无法接受自己杀死了所有同志的事实。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
He doesn't look like the Rayan I know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是怎么回事？
他看起来不像我认识的那个拉扬。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I don't know. This Rayan seems to be a completely different individual than the one we know.
I guess this is what they call Multiple Personality Disorder.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我不知道。这个拉扬似乎和我们认识的那个完全是不同的人。
我想这就是他们所说的多重人格障碍吧。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
This Rayan isn't the Rayan Moore that plotted the conspiracy,
but another personality hidden inside of him.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
这个拉扬不是策划阴谋的拉扬·摩尔，
而是隐藏在他体内的另一个人格。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Hey, calm down. Why don't you speak slowly?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
嘿，冷静点。你为什么不慢慢说？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..It was me.. I was only going to pretend to break the seal of Satan Morocc...
Don't you see? I meant for it to just be an act! I was going to throw the town in panic...
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
..是我...我原本只是想假装解除魔王梦罗克的封印...
你没看出来吗？那只是我的表演！我打算让城镇陷入恐慌...

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..That would be my chance to spread the teachings of Freya, our messiah.
Then something went wrong...
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
..那样就是我的机会，去传播我们救世主弗蕾雅的道义。
然后事情出了差错...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
What?
Man, how can you be so stupid?!
*Sigh* Continue.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
什么？
天哪，你怎么能这么愚蠢？！
*叹气* 继续说。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
I was studying some documents for my plan, and then I found something by accident.
That was when I became a completely different person.. *Sob*
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
我在研究计划的一些文件，然后偶然发现了某样东西。
就在那时，我变成了一个完全不同的人.. *抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..My plan.. It was like I wasn't myself anymore. I wanted to release Satan Morocc for real.
I kidnapped children.. Threatened my comrades.
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
..我的计划..感觉我不再是我自己了。我想要真正释放魔王梦罗克。
我绑架了孩子..威胁了我的同志。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..I held the true ritual to break the seal and release Satan Morocc...
Wah.. My.. My head hurts.. This.. No, you can't.. Waaah!
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
..我主持了真正的仪式来解除封印并释放魔王梦罗克...
哇..我的..我头疼..这个..不，你不能..哇啊！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
..Grr.. You.. You foolish weaklings..
..I shall kill you.. No... Nooo!
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
..嘎...你们...你们愚蠢的弱者..
..我要杀了你们..不...不！！

scripts.text:
- Suddenly Rayan started talking nonsense and then pulled his hair out in anguish.
It seems as if he is trying to resist the evil personality within him. -
scripts.translation:
- 突然，拉扬开始胡言乱语，然后痛苦地抓挠自己的头发。
看起来他正在试图抵抗体内的邪恶人格。 -

scripts.text: Smack his head.
scripts.translation: 打他的头。

scripts.text: Punch his stomach.
scripts.translation: 打他的肚子。

scripts.text: Slap his face.
scripts.translation: 打他的脸。

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you smacked the back of his head with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground. Nice job! -
scripts.translation: - 为了阻止拉扬进入狂暴状态，你用笔记本敲了他的后脑勺。拉扬踉跄了一下，然后倒在了地上。干得好！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you sucker punched him in the 'ole bread basket. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground...! -
scripts.translation: - 为了阻止拉扬进入狂暴状态，你狠狠揍了他的肚子。拉扬踉跄了一下，然后倒在了地上...！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you slapped his face with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell onto the ground. Wah! -
scripts.translation: - 为了阻止拉扬进入狂暴状态，你用笔记本扇了他的脸。拉扬踉跄了一下，然后倒在了地上。哇！ -

scripts.text: - By your sudden violent move, the Bloody Crystal of Darkness flew out of your jacket, and rolled on the ground toward Rayan. -
scripts.translation: - 由于你突然的暴力动作，黑暗的结晶体从你的夹克里飞了出来，滚到了拉扬身边。 -

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Ahh....
....? Isn't.. Isn't this?!....

[Rin]
Wah! What's going on?
Why is it suddenly..?!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
哇！发生什么事了？
为什么突然...？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this a time-space phenomenon?!
Why..? There's no gap here..?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是时空现象吗？！
为什么...？这里没有裂缝啊...？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Haha.. Muhahaha!
Muhahahahaha!!
He's come.. My master has arrived!!
As you command, master. I'm here to serve you!
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！！
他来了...我的主人到了！！
遵命，主人。我来为您效命！

scripts.text:
[Voice from Rayan]
^FF0000You insignificant humans!
I'll be back at full strength,
and I'll pay you back for locking me in the darkness for hundreds of years!^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉扬传来的声音]
^FF0000你们这些卑微的人类！
我会以完全的力量回来，
为被你们囚禁在黑暗中的数百年讨回公道！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rin]
What... What just happened?
Are you Rayan? Or are you someone else now?!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
刚才...刚才发生了什么？
你是拉扬吗？还是说你现在是别人了？！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
You're too late. My master has already departed!
I'm his loyal servant.
You're too foolish to understand his great will.
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
太迟了。我的主人已经离开了！
我是他忠诚的仆人。
你们太愚蠢了，无法理解他伟大的意志。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Haha... Muhahaha!
He's calling me!
He needs me now!
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！
他在呼唤我！
他现在需要我！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
You're Rin, right?
This is the last time you'll ever see me.
Haha... Muhahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
你是琳恩，对吧？
这是你最后一次见到我了。
哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Rin]
............
....Huh...?
What just happened?

[{0}]
...I don't know...
...I think he's gone...?

[Rin]
What's up?
I'm kind of busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
怎么了？
我现在有点忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
..I've brought back the journal and something else..
..Er, sorry. I forgot to bring the journal! I'll be right back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
..我带回了笔记本和别的东西..
..呃，抱歉。我忘了带笔记本！我马上回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should we do now?
You know, that voice.. Do you think it was Satan Morocc...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们现在该怎么办？
你知道，那个声音...你觉得那是魔王梦罗克...？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..Maybe.
B.ased on what the more normal Rayan has told us,
it seems that another personality within him was forcibly created by Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..也许吧。
根据那个比较正常的拉扬告诉我们的话，
似乎是他体内被魔王梦罗克强行创造出的另一个人格。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Satan Morocc must have chosen Rayan to break his seal.
He's been controlling Rayan from deep inside his mind..
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
魔王梦罗克一定是选中了拉扬来打破封印。
他一直在拉扬内心深处控制着他..

scripts.text:
[Rin]
And... That Mad Rayan seems to have a connection with your Bloody Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
而且...那个疯狂的拉扬似乎与你的黑暗的结晶体有某种联系。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I didn't see that side of Rayan until you came; he was very cooperative and feeble up until then.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
在你到来之前，我从未见过拉扬那一面；在此之前他都非常配合且虚弱。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
The original Rayan seemed to remember everything that happened while he was controlled by that mad personality..
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
原本的拉扬似乎记得在被那个疯狂人格控制期间发生的一切..

scripts.text:
[Rin]
He was in shock after learning that he's killed all his comrades with his own hand.
He started acting differently once you approached him. I must record all of this in the journal.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
得知自己亲手杀死了所有同志后，他陷入了震惊。
当你靠近他时，他开始变得不一样了。我必须把这些都记录在笔记本里。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Right. He completely changed once he touched the crystal, as if he himself became Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
没错。当他触碰到结晶体后，他完全变了，仿佛他自己变成了魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
..Damn it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
..该死。

scripts.text: What should we do now?
scripts.translation: 我们现在该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Don't worry.
I've marked Rayan's body in case he ran away.
We can trace him down.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
别担心。
我在拉扬的尸体上做了标记，以防他逃跑。
我们可以追踪到他。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
I'll give you the pattern number of his magic wavelength. Can you give the number to Echinacea?
She'll take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
我会给你他的魔法波长模式编号。你能把这个编号给紫锥菊吗？
剩下的她会处理。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
The pattern number is...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000
Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
模式编号是...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000
不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Here, bring this journal with you.
Please don't forget the pattern number. Alright? Make sure that Echinacea gets it.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
拿着，带上这本笔记本。
请别忘了模式编号。好吗？一定要让紫锥菊收到。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
去阿什真空向紫锥菊汇报，并把模式编号给她。
模式编号是 ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
去阿什真空向紫锥菊汇报，并把模式编号给她。
模式编号是 ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
The pattern number is ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
去阿什真空向紫锥菊汇报，并把模式编号给她。
模式编号是 ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Ouch, my head...
Yes? Why are you back again?
What...you forgot the pattern number?
Sigh...Oh well.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
哎哟，我的头...
是的？你怎么又回来了？
什么...你忘了模式编号？
唉...算了。

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Make sure you don't forget it again. The pattern number is...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
这次可别再忘了。模式编号是...
^4d4dff[{0}]^000000。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？
记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Sigh. Get going, then...
I need to take a break...
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
唉。那你快去吧...
我需要休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
Ahhh~ I'm a sick person. I need to rest!
I don't want to do anything else~
Hurry up and go, don't bother me~
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
啊哈~ 我生病了，需要休息！
我什么都不想做~
快走吧，别打扰我~

scripts.text: - For some reason, Rayan is shivering in fear. -
scripts.translation: - 不知为何，拉扬正瑟瑟发抖。 -

scripts.text:
[Rin]
He's not being himself for some reason.
I'm just glad that he's sane enough to speak to me.
I don't know what's going on with him.
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
他不知为何变得不像他自己了。
还好他神智清醒，还能和我说话。
我不知道他到底怎么了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
You have found a pile of dirt and deep tracks under thick bushes.
There are deep footprints and spilled blood around the area.
scripts.translation:
你在茂密的灌木丛下发现了一堆泥土和深深的痕迹。
周围有深深的脚印和洒落的血迹。

scripts.text:
Some desperate fighting definitely happened here.
There are some broken branches to the side of a set of footprints that look like they're skidding backwards...
Somebody must have been fallen down on the ground, or...
scripts.translation:
这里显然发生过激烈的战斗。
在一串向后滑行的脚印旁，有一些折断的树枝...
有人一定是摔倒在地的，或者...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've been having a strange feeling around this area...
It feels like faint mana.. ?!... Yes, I can barely see an aura.
...What is this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在这附近一直有种奇怪的感觉...
感觉像是微弱的玛娜.. ?!... 是的，我隐约能看到灵气。
...这是什么？

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: Take a careful look.
scripts.translation: 仔细查看

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. This place must be where Rin fought with Rayan's gang.
I don't see anything that looks important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯.. 这里应该是琳恩和拉扬的手下战斗的地方。
我没看到什么重要的东西。

scripts.text:
As you took a careful look,
you notice something shining in the ground.
scripts.translation:
当你仔细查看时，
你注意到地面上有东西在闪闪发光。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have found a 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你发现了一个“血腥的黑暗的结晶体”。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I'll find anything else here...
I should go back now.
I hope Rin will understand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得这里不会再找到其他东西了...
我该回去了。
希望琳恩能理解。

scripts.text:
There are traces of a battle here, including spilled blood.
There's also a pile of dirt that seems out of place.
scripts.translation:
这里有战斗的痕迹，包括洒落的血迹。
还有一堆看起来格格不入的泥土。

scripts.text: There are traces of a battle here, and spilled blood.
scripts.translation: 这里有战斗的痕迹，以及洒落的血迹。

scripts.text:
You find many footprints on the ground.
Considering all the blood on the ground, a battle must have occurred here fairly recently.
The footprints continue over the hill.
scripts.translation:
你在地面上发现了许多脚印。
考虑到地上大量的血迹，这里最近一定发生过战斗。
脚印一直延伸到山丘那边。

scripts.text: You found some footprints.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一些脚印。

scripts.text:
Somebody left a mark under this small tree.
The mark is weathered and faded,
but it is an arrow pointing southwest.
scripts.translation:
有人在这棵小树下面留下了标记。
标记已经风化褪色，
但它是一个指向西南方的箭头。

scripts.text:
There's some scribbling on the tree,
but you can't decipher what it means.
scripts.translation:
树上有一些涂鸦，
但你无法辨认出它的含义。

scripts.text: A mysterious force is repelling you, and you're unable to push forward into this area.
scripts.translation: 一股神秘的力量正在排斥你，你无法继续向前进入这个区域。

scripts.text:
As soon as you touched the crystal,
you feel your body being pulled into the space gap.
You remember Kidd's confused voice, screaming your name.
scripts.translation:
当你一触碰到结晶体，
你就感觉身体被拉入了空间裂隙。
你记得基德困惑的声音，正在尖叫你的名字。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, where am I?
Argh.. My head hurts...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
话说回来，我在哪里？
啊...我的头好痛...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
.. ? Wh... What's going on?
I can't see things.. I'm getting dizzy...
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...？什...发生了什么？
我看不清...头好晕...
刚才到底怎么了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Are they fighting?
I can hear a crowd of people coming...
Argh! It's too dark to see...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？他们在打架吗？
我听到人群走来的声音...
啊！太黑了，什么都看不见...！

scripts.text:
[Familiar Female Voice]
Shut up! It's creepy that you all look alike. Bring it on! I'm not afraid of you!
I'm not going to let you run away again!
scripts.translation:
[熟悉的女声]
闭嘴！你们长得都一样，真让人毛骨悚然。来吧！我才不怕你们呢！
这次我绝不会再让你们逃走了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... !!!!
Rin!!!!
Why? Why is Rin here? Wait, where am I?
Argh.. I can't move at all...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...！！！！
琳恩！！！！
为什么？琳恩为什么会在这里？等等，我在哪里？
啊...我完全动不了...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
You're not alone. So what?
You're still coming with me!
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
你不是一个人又怎样？
你还是得跟我走！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Hah, how impressive! You run like a rabbit!
I should have you killed you when I had the chance.
I didn't expect you to be so persistent...
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
哈，真厉害啊！你跑得跟兔子一样快！
我本该趁早杀了你的。
没想到你竟然这么执着...

scripts.text:
[Rin]
That's what I wanted to say!
You played me like a chess piece,
and now I want to tear you apart in five pieces. Why don't you just shut up and surrender before I kill you?
scripts.translation:
[琳恩]
这正是我想说的！
你把我当棋子一样摆布，
现在我要把你撕成五块。你最好乖乖投降，不然我就杀了你？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Hah.. You still have no idea, huh? You already lost this game, lady.
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
哈...你还是不明白吗？这场游戏你已经输了，女士。

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
I'm sorry that I have to do this.
...
Kill her.
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
很抱歉，我不得不这么做。
...
杀了她。

scripts.text:
You feel helpless: you can do nothing but watch her slowly get overpowered..
Then, the pressure on your body suddenly dissipates.
scripts.translation:
你感到无能为力：你只能眼睁睁看着她被逐渐压制...
然后，压在你身上的力量突然消失了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
You have found a laceration on the dead body;
he must have been killed by Rin.
scripts.translation:
你在尸体上发现了一道撕裂伤；
他一定是被琳恩杀死的。

scripts.text: Check his pockets.
scripts.translation: 检查他的口袋

scripts.text: Shake the corpse.
scripts.translation: 摇晃尸体

scripts.text: It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to check his pockets for any clues.
scripts.translation: 摸尸体虽然让人毛骨悚然，但你决定检查他的口袋，看看有没有什么线索。

scripts.text:
It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to shake and turn the body
to find any possible clues
And...
scripts.translation:
摸尸体虽然让人毛骨悚然，但你决定摇晃并翻转尸体，以寻找任何可能的线索。
然后...

scripts.text:
A scroll flew out of the body's jacket pocket.
You're not sure what this scroll is for, but obviously it seems pretty important.
scripts.translation:
一张卷轴从尸体的夹克口袋里飞了出来。
你不确定这张卷轴是做什么用的，但显然它看起来非常重要。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffYou have obtained a Sealed Magic Scroll.
Let's bring this to Kidd.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff你获得了一张封印魔法卷轴。
让我们把它带给基德。^000000

scripts.text: You have found a Dandelion Member who was killed by Rin.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一名被琳恩杀死的蒲公英成员。

scripts.text: It's just a corpse, but there seems to be something unnatural about it.
scripts.translation: 这只是一具尸体，但似乎有什么不自然的地方。

scripts.text:
Now's not the time to examine corpses.
You better take care of your living enemies first!
scripts.translation:
现在不是检查尸体的时候。
你最好先处理活着的敌人！

scripts.text:
- You find a side door that leads to the basement.
A faint light is shining through the hinges.
There are people inside, talking loudly. -
scripts.translation:
- 你发现了一扇通往地下室的小门。
门缝里透出微弱的光。
里面有人，正在大声说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Hey Rayan, say something.
We did everything you asked,
but...
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
嘿，拉扬，说点什么吧。
我们做了你要求的一切，
但是...

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
...This is totally wrong.
We did something that we shouldn't have.
Come on, reconsider this.
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
...这完全错了。
我们做了不该做的事。
拜托，重新考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Rayan, Rayan!
All we wanted was just to shake up the town just a little bit,
not summon Satan Morocc! The ritual failed like we first planned, but...
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
拉扬，拉扬！
我们只是想稍微搞乱一下城镇，
不是要召唤魔王梦罗克！仪式像我们最初计划的那样失败了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Voices]
That's right. It failed, but what happened? Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
He'll bring the end of this world.
What have we done?!
We can't even go back to our country now!
scripts.translation:
[众声]
没错。它失败了，但结果呢？魔王梦罗克复活了。
他将带来这个世界的终结。
我们做了什么？！
我们现在甚至无法回到自己的国家！

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
...We all knew that we would be disposed after we stopped being useful.. Just like pawns in a chess match.
But I'm curious.
Rayan...
scripts.translation:
[焦虑的声音]
...我们都知道，一旦我们不再有用，就会被处理掉。就像棋盘上的棋子一样。
但我很好奇。
拉扬...

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
Rayan, say something!
What the hell's wrong with you?
Why, can't you still forget the Assassin?
...Hey, tell us. What should we do now?
scripts.translation:
[焦虑的声音]
拉扬，说点什么吧！
你到底怎么了？
为什么，你难道还忘不了那个刺客吗？
...嘿，告诉我们。我们现在该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
Let me ask you one question.
...Did you... Did you really summon Satan Morocc?
Did you?
Did you really ask us to help you resurrect Satan Morocc?!
scripts.translation:
[焦虑的声音]
让我问你一个问题。
...你...你真的召唤了魔王梦罗克吗？
是吗？
你真的让我们帮你复活魔王梦罗克？！

scripts.text:
[Anxious Voice]
If your silence means yes, I'm out!
I didn't know then, but I know now. I'm leaving!
scripts.translation:
[焦虑的声音]
如果你的沉默意味着是，那我走了！
我当时不知道，但现在我知道了。我要离开！

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Incompetent weaklings.
I don't need you anymore.
Thank you for following my lead so far.
But you're nothing but puppets of the goddess.. *Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
无能的弱者。
我不再需要你们了。
谢谢你们一直听从我的指挥。
但你们不过是女神的傀儡罢了。*咯咯咯*

scripts.text:
[Male Voice]
Hey, hey! What are you doing?!
Why are you doing this?!
scripts.translation:
[男性的声音]
嘿，嘿！你在干什么？！
你为什么要这样做？！

scripts.text:
- You hear loud thuds and thumping in the midst of their yelling and screaming.
It sounds like they're having a serious dispute.-
scripts.translation:
- 在他们的叫喊声中，你听到沉重的撞击声。
听起来他们正在发生激烈的争执。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Rayan? ...Morocc? ...Resurrect...?
I have no idea what they're talking about. Why are they fighting?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...拉扬？...梦罗克？...复活...？
我完全不知道他们在说什么。他们为什么在打架？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
You ignorant puppets..
You're too stupid to understand my master's great will...
...Oh, right. I completely forgot about 'it.' It's time to take it back.
What do you say? *Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
无知的傀儡们..
你们太愚蠢了，无法理解我主人的伟大意志...
...哦，对了。我完全忘了“它”。是时候把它拿回来了。
你们觉得如何？*咯咯咯*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the?! Does he know I'm here?!
I'd better run!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？！他知道我在这里？！
我最好快跑！

scripts.text: - You used a Butterfly Wing.-
scripts.translation: - 你使用了一张蝴蝶翅膀。-

scripts.text:
- The side to the basement is open.
You can enter if you want. -
scripts.translation:
- 通往地下室的小门开了。
如果你想，可以进去。 -

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text: You have decided to not enter the basement.
scripts.translation: 你决定不进入地下室。

scripts.text:
- This door seems to lead to the basement,
but it's locked pretty securely. -
scripts.translation:
- 这扇门似乎通往地下室，
但被锁得很紧。 -

scripts.text: A man covered in blood is standing at a corner with a mysterious grin.
scripts.translation: 一个浑身是血的男人站在角落里，脸上带着诡异的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I guess it was the right timing.
By the way, who is this guy?
He looks kind of.. He's insane, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
看来时机刚刚好。
顺便问一下，这家伙是谁？
他看起来有点...他疯了吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Woah! Where did you come from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇！你从哪冒出来的？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...From somewhere.
Anyways...
What happened?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...从某个地方。
总之...
发生了什么事？
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Man]
...Who am I...?
...I think I forgot...
They're all dead.. I've killed them.
Hehehe, I just followed the will of my master.
Muhahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
...我是谁...？
...我想我忘了...
他们都死了...是我杀了他们。
嘿嘿嘿，我只是听从了师父的意志。
穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No... No way!
Rayan?!
scripts.translation: 拉扬？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
What? Is this really the Rayan we've been chasing?
..... !!!
Right, you said Rayan was having a dispute with his buddies..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
什么？这真的是我们要追捕的拉扬吗？
..... ！！
没错，你说过拉扬和他的伙伴们发生了争执..

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
...Ray... Rayan? That's my name? That's right...
I'm Rayan. Rayan Moore.
Who are you..?
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
...拉...拉扬？那是我的名字？没错...
我是拉扬。拉扬·摩尔。
你们是谁..？

scripts.text:
[Rayan]
Where am I? What's all this blood?!
...Huh? Where am I? What happened to my friends?
scripts.translation:
[拉扬]
我在哪？这些血是怎么回事？！
...咦？我在哪？我的朋友们怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
...I guess I was right. He really is Rayan Moore.
What's wrong with him?
He seems... He seems really confused. Maybe even unstable.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
...看来我猜对了。他真的是拉扬·摩尔。
他怎么了？
他看起来...他看起来很困惑。甚至可能精神不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
Well, it's the perfect time to capture this guy before he can kill us.
Rin will know if this is the real Rayan because I've never seen him without his mask..
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
好吧，趁他还没杀了我们，现在是抓住这家伙的最佳时机。
琳恩会知道这是否是真正的拉扬，因为我从未见过他不戴面具的样子..

scripts.text:
[Mr. Kidd]
I'll bring this guy to Rin so she can interrogate him.
I'll see you at the camp.
scripts.translation:
[基德先生]
我要把这家伙带给琳恩，让她审问他。
我在营地见。

scripts.text: - You watched Mr. Kidd arrest the unconscious Rayan and take out a teleportation item. You decide to return to town. -
scripts.translation: - 你看着基德先生逮捕了昏迷的拉扬，并拿出了一件瞬间移动道具。你决定返回城镇。 -

scripts.text:
[Man]
I live to serve my master!
Are you his enemy?
DIE!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我活着就是为了侍奉我的师父！
你是他的敌人吗？
去死吧！

scripts.text:
You find a horribly dismembered dead body.
It is disgusting to decribe the status of the Corpse!.
scripts.translation:
你发现了一具被肢解得惨不忍睹的尸体。
尸体的状况令人作呕！

scripts.text:
You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
that appears to have been crushed to death.
scripts.translation:
你发现了一具面目全非的尸体。
看起来是被压死的。

scripts.text:
You find a terribly mutated corpse.
R.I.P.
scripts.translation:
你发现了一具变异得可怕的尸体。
安息吧。

scripts.text:
You find a terribly mutilated corpse.
Rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
你发现了一具被残害得可怕的尸体。
愿逝者安息。

scripts.text:
You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
... . . . . . !!!
scripts.translation:
你发现了一具面目全非的尸体。
... . . . . . !!!
